title.zh: 卷8 本紀八 圣祖本紀三
title.raw: 卷8 本紀八 圣祖本紀三

sentences.zh: 四十一年壬午春正月壬寅，詔修國子監。

translations.literal: In the forty-first year, spring, first month, day renyin [of the sexagenary cycle], an edict ordered repair of the Imperial Academy.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-first year, on the first day of spring, an edict ordered repairs at the Imperial Academy.

sentences.zh: 丙午，詔繫囚經緩決者減一等。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, an edict ordered that prisoners held pending review under the delayed-execution procedure have their sentence reduced by one degree.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, prisoners awaiting clemency review had their sentences reduced one grade.

sentences.zh: 以雅爾江阿襲封簡親王。

translations.literal: Yarjiang'a was invested to succeed as Prince Jian of the First Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Yarjiang'a succeeded to the title Prince Jian.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，上巡幸五台山。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, the Emperor made an inspection tour to Mount Wutai.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, the Emperor toured Mount Wutai.

sentences.zh: 二月庚申，次射虎川。

translations.literal: Second month, day gengshen: the court halted at Shehu River.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on gengshen day, the entourage stopped at Shehu River.

sentences.zh: 士民請於菩薩頂建萬壽亭祝釐，不許。

translations.literal: Officials and commoners asked to build a Wanshou Pavilion at Pusa Peak to offer blessings; this was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Locals asked to erect a longevity pavilion on Pusa Peak for blessings; the Emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，上巡視子牙河。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, the Emperor inspected the Ziya River.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, the Emperor inspected the Ziya River works.

sentences.zh: 三月壬午，上還京。

translations.literal: Third month, day renwu: the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on renwu day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 以瓦爾岱為滿洲都統，吳達禪、馬思哈、滿丕為蒙古都統。

translations.literal: Wardai was appointed Manchu commander-in-chief; Wudashan, Masih'a, and Manpi were appointed Mongol commanders-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Wardai became Manchu commander-in-chief; Wudashan, Masih'a, and Manpi became Mongol commanders-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，上御經筵。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, the Emperor attended the Classics lecture.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, the Emperor held the Classics lecture.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲戌，賜致仕大學士王熙御書匾對，傳旨曰：「卿先朝舊臣，其強餐食，慎醫藥，以慰朕念。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jiaxu: the retired Grand Secretary Wang Xi was granted an imperial calligraphic plaque and couplet, with an edict saying: "You are an old minister of the previous reign; take hearty meals, be careful with medicine, to comfort Our mind."
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, the retired Grand Secretary Wang Xi received an imperial plaque and message urging him to eat well and care for his health.

translations.literal: " (closing quotation mark in the source.)
translations.idiomatic: The edict continued.

sentences.zh: 五月癸巳，定發配人犯歸籍僉遣，流犯死配所，妻子許還鄉里。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day guisi: regulations were fixed for exiled convicts to be sent home under native-place assignment; when a transported convict died at the place of exile, his wife and children were permitted to return to their home district.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, rules were set for exiles to be sent home by native place; if a convict died in exile, his family could return.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，顯親王丹臻薨，遣皇子及大臣治喪，賜銀萬兩，諡曰密，子衍璜襲。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Prince Xianqin Danzhen died; princes and high ministers were sent to manage the funeral, ten thousand taels of silver were granted, the posthumous title Mi was given, and his son Yanhuang succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Xianqin Danzhen died; the court arranged his funeral, granted silver, gave the posthumous name Mi, and his son Yanhuang inherited the title.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，先是，廉州府連山瑤人作亂，御史參奏，命都統嵩祝率禁旅會討，並命尚書范承勛勘狀。

translations.literal: On day renyin: earlier, Yao people of Lianshan in Lianzhou prefecture had risen in revolt; censors memorialized, and the commander-in-chief Song Zhu was ordered to lead the guards in joint suppression, and Minister Fan Chengxun was ordered to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Yao rebels had risen in Lianzhou; the court sent Song Zhu with the guards and Fan Chengxun to investigate.

sentences.zh: 至是，嵩祝奏官兵一到，瑤人乞降，先後投出瑤人一萬九千餘名。

translations.literal: At this time Song Zhu reported that as soon as government troops arrived the Yao begged to surrender, and in all more than nineteen thousand Yao persons came forward.
translations.idiomatic: Song Zhu reported that the Yao surrendered as soon as troops arrived, with over nineteen thousand turning themselves in.

sentences.zh: 獻出戕官黎貴等九人，即于軍前正法。

translations.literal: They handed over nine men including Li Gui who had killed officials, who were at once executed before the army.
translations.idiomatic: Nine men who had killed officials, including Li Gui, were executed on the spot.

sentences.zh: 降瑤安插，交總督料理。

translations.literal: The surrendered Yao were resettled and the matter was turned over to the governor-general to handle.
translations.idiomatic: Surrendered Yao were resettled under the governor-general's care.

sentences.zh: 范承勛奏瑤人滋事，副將杜芳傷死，總兵劉虎先行退回，應擬斬，提督殷化行應革職。

translations.literal: Fan Chengxun memorialized that in the Yao disturbance the vice commander Du Fang was killed in action, and the regional commander Liu Hu had withdrawn in advance and should be sentenced to decapitation; the provincial commander Yin Huaxing should be dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Chengxun reported Du Fang killed in action and urged decapitation for Liu Hu, who had retreated early, and dismissal for Yin Huaxing.

sentences.zh: 得旨：「殷化行有戰功，改原品致仕。

translations.literal: An edict was received: "Yin Huaxing has battle merit; let him retire at his original rank.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor ruled that Yin Huaxing, for past merit, might retire at his former rank.

sentences.zh: 劉虎免死。

translations.literal: Liu Hu's death sentence is remitted."
translations.idiomatic: Liu Hu's death sentence was remitted."

sentences.zh: 」丙午，召廷臣至保和殿，頒賜御書。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, court ministers were summoned to the Hall of Preserving Harmony and imperial calligraphy was bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, ministers were summoned and given imperial calligraphy.

sentences.zh: 六月壬子，貴州葛彝寨苗人為亂，官軍討平之。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day renzi: Miao people of Ge Yi stockade in Guizhou rebelled; government troops suppressed and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Guizhou Miao rebels were suppressed.

sentences.zh: 戊午，上制訓飭士子文，頒發直省，勒石學宮。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, the Emperor composed an admonitory essay for scholars and ordered it issued to all provinces and carved on stone at the schools.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor issued an admonition to scholars for every province and had it carved at the schools.

sentences.zh: 乙未，上奉皇太后幸熱河。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, the Emperor accompanied the Empress Dowager to Rehe.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager to Rehe.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，四川提督岳升龍疏報大涼山裸目馬比必率眾內附，請授土千戶，給印信。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Sichuan provincial commander Yue Shenglong memorialized that Mabi of the Luomu tribe in Great Liangshan, leading his people, had submitted and asked that he be made a native thousand-household with seal and patent.
translations.idiomatic: Yue Shenglong reported that Mabi of Great Liangshan had submitted and was made a native thousand-household.

sentences.zh: 閏六月辛丑，木鴉番民萬九千餘戶內附，請置安撫使、副使、土百戶等職，均從之。

translations.literal: Intercalary sixth month, day xinchou: more than nineteen thousand households of the Muya tribe submitted; posts of pacification commissioner, vice commissioner, and native hundred-household were requested and all granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary sixth month, nineteen thousand Muya households submitted and native offices were established.

sentences.zh: 八月庚辰朔，增順天、浙江、湖廣鄉試中額。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day gengchen, first day of the month: the quota for successful candidates at the provincial examinations in Shuntian, Zhejiang, and Huguang was increased.
translations.idiomatic: On the first of the eighth month, provincial examination quotas were raised for Shuntian, Zhejiang, and Huguang.

sentences.zh: 戊申，上奉皇太后還宮。

translations.literal: On day wushen, the Emperor accompanied the Empress Dowager back to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, the Emperor returned with the Empress Dowager to the palace.

sentences.zh: 九月辛亥，以李正宗、盧崇耀、馮國相為漢軍都統。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day xinhai: Li Zhengzong, Lu Chongyao, and Feng Guoxiang were appointed Han Chinese commanders-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Li Zhengzong, Lu Chongyao, and Feng Guoxiang became Han commanders-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 壬子，定五經中式例。

translations.literal: On day renzi, the quota rule for success in the Five Classics was fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, rules for passing the Five Classics examination were set.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，停本年秋決。

translations.literal: On day guichou, the autumn executions were suspended for this year.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, autumn executions were halted for the year.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以齊世、嵩祝為滿洲都統，莽喀為漢軍都統，車納福為蒙古都統。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Qi Shi and Song Zhu were made Manchu commanders-in-chief, Mangka Han commander-in-chief, and Chena Fu Mongol commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Qi Shi and Song Zhu became Manchu commanders-in-chief; Mangka Han and Chena Fu Mongol commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 甲子，詔：「南巡閱河，所過停供張，禁科斂。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, an edict said: "On the southern tour to inspect the rivers, wherever We pass, local supplies are to cease, and exactions are forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that on the southern river inspection tour no lavish supplies or levies be imposed.

sentences.zh: 官吏無相餽遺，百姓各守本業。

translations.literal: Officials must not exchange gifts; the people are each to keep to their own occupation.
translations.idiomatic: Officials were forbidden to exchange gifts; commoners were to remain at their trades.

sentences.zh: 督撫布告，使明知朕意。

translations.literal: Governors and governors-general are to proclaim this so that all clearly know Our intent."
translations.idiomatic: Provincial authorities were to publish the edict so all understood the Emperor's intent."

sentences.zh: 」己巳，以席哈納為大學士，敦拜為吏部尚書，席爾達為禮部尚書，溫達為左都御史，管源忠為廣州將軍。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Xi Hana was made Grand Secretary, Dunbai Minister of Personnel, Xierda Minister of Rites, Wenda Censor-in-chief of the Left, and Guan Yuanzhong general at Guangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Xi Hana became Grand Secretary; Dunbai, Xierda, Wenda, and Guan Yuanzhong received new posts.

sentences.zh: 鎮筸諸生李豐等叩閽言紅苗殺人，有司不問。

translations.literal: Students of Zhenting memorialized at the palace gate that the Red Miao were killing people and the authorities did not inquire.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenting students petitioned that Red Miao killings went unpunished.

sentences.zh: 詔侍郎傅繼祖、甘國樞，巡撫趙申喬馳驛按問。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Vice Minister Fu Jizu and Gan Guoshu, and Governor Zhao Shenqiao, to travel post-haste to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Jizu, Gan Guoshu, and Zhao Shenqiao were sent to investigate at once.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，上南巡啟鑾。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, the Emperor set out on the southern tour.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, the southern tour began.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬午，次德州。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day renwu: the court halted at Dezhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, the entourage stopped at Dezhou.

sentences.zh: 皇太子胤礽有疾，上迴鑾。

translations.literal: Crown Prince Yinreng was ill; the Emperor turned the imperial carriage back.
translations.idiomatic: The Crown Prince fell ill and the Emperor turned back.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，上還宮。

translations.literal: On day guimao, the Emperor returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, the Emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以郭世隆為廣東廣西總督，金世榮為浙江福建總督。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Guo Shilong was made governor-general of Guangdong and Guangxi, and Jin Shirong governor-general of Zhejiang and Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Shilong and Jin Shirong were appointed governors-general of the south and southeast.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙辰，詔免陝西、安徽明年額賦。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day bingchen: an edict remitted next year's land tax quota for Shaanxi and Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Shaanxi and Anhui were granted tax relief for the coming year.

sentences.zh: 甲子，大學士伊桑阿乞休，命致仕。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Grand Secretary Yisang'a asked to retire; he was ordered to leave office.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretary Yisang'a retired from office.

sentences.zh: 壬申，廣西巡撫蕭永藻疏劾布政使教化新虧空倉穀，應令賠補。

translations.literal: On day renshen, Guangxi Governor Xiao Yongzao memorialized impeaching Provincial Administration Commissioner Jiao Huaxin for a shortfall in stored grain that should be made good.
translations.idiomatic: Guangxi's governor reported a grain shortfall by Commissioner Jiao Huaxin.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「米穀必有收貯之地，乃可經久。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "Grain and rice must have storage places if they are to last.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said grain must be stored properly to last.

sentences.zh: 若無倉廒，積於空野，難免朽爛，況南方卑濕之地乎？

translations.literal: If there are no granaries and grain is piled in open fields, it cannot escape rotting—how much more in the low, damp south?
translations.idiomatic: Without granaries, grain in open fields rots—especially in the damp south.

sentences.zh: 其別定例以聞。

translations.literal: Draw up a separate regulation and report."
translations.idiomatic: He ordered a separate regulation drawn up."

sentences.zh: 」命修禹陵。

translations.literal: An order was issued to repair the tomb of Yu.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered repairs at Yu's tomb.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬辰，廷臣以明年五旬萬壽，請上尊號。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day renchen: court ministers, because the next year would be the Emperor's fiftieth birthday, asked that a honorific title be conferred.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, ministers sought a honorific title for the Emperor's fiftieth birthday.

sentences.zh: 上不許。

translations.literal: The Emperor did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 戶部議駁奉天報災。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Revenue rejected a disaster report from Fengtian.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Revenue rejected Fengtian's disaster report.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「晴雨原無一定，始者雨水調和，其後被災，亦常事耳。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "Rain and drought are originally not fixed; at first the rains were harmonious, and afterward there was disaster—this too is a common thing.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said weather is uncertain and later disaster was not unusual.

sentences.zh: 可准其奏。

translations.literal: Their memorial may be approved."
translations.idiomatic: He approved the memorial after all."

sentences.zh: 」乙未，改趙申喬為偏沅巡撫，以趙弘燦為廣東提督，王世臣為浙江提督，孫徵灝為漢軍都統。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Zhao Shenqiao was changed to governor of Bian and Yuan, Zhao Hongcan made provincial commander of Guangdong, Wang Shichen of Zhejiang, and Sun Zhenghao Han commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Shenqiao, Zhao Hongcan, Wang Shichen, and Sun Zhenghao received new appointments.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，厄魯特丹津阿拉布坦來朝，厚賚之，封為郡王，賜地游牧。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Erut leader Danjin Alabutan came to court; he was richly rewarded, enfeoffed as Prince of the Commandery, and granted pasture lands.
translations.idiomatic: Erut leader Danjin Alabutan was received at court, enfeoffed as prince, and given pasture lands.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免江南、河南、浙江、湖廣、甘肅等省十州縣災賦有差。

translations.literal: This year, disaster land tax for ten prefectures and counties in Jiangnan, Henan, Zhejiang, Huguang, Gansu, and other provinces was remitted in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Tax relief was granted for disaster areas across several provinces.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、琉球入貢。

translations.literal: Korea and Ryukyu sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea and Ryukyu paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 四十二年癸未春正月壬子，大學士諸臣賀祝五旬萬壽，恭進「萬壽無疆」屏。

translations.literal: Forty-second year, spring, first month, day renzi: Grand Secretaries and other ministers congratulated the Emperor on his fiftieth birthday and respectfully presented a "Boundless Longevity" screen.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-second year, ministers congratulated the Emperor on his fiftieth birthday with a longevity screen.

sentences.zh: 卻之，收其寫冊。

translations.literal: He declined it and accepted only the written album.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor declined the gift but kept the album.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，上南巡閱河。

translations.literal: On day renxu, the Emperor set out on the southern tour to inspect the rivers.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, the Emperor began the southern river inspection tour.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以俞益謨為湖廣提督。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, Yu Yimou was made provincial commander of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Yimou became Huguang provincial commander.

sentences.zh: 庚午，次濟南，觀珍珠泉，賦三渡齊河詩。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, the court halted at Jinan, viewed Pearl Spring, and composed a poem on three crossings of the Qi River.
translations.idiomatic: At Jinan the Emperor viewed Pearl Spring and wrote poetry on crossing the Qi River.

sentences.zh: 壬申，次泰安，登泰山。

translations.literal: On day renshen, the court halted at Tai'an and ascended Mount Tai.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, the Emperor climbed Mount Tai from Tai'an.

sentences.zh: 詔免蹕路所經及歉收各屬去年逋賦。

translations.literal: An edict remitted last year's overdue taxes for districts along the imperial route and for those with poor harvests.
translations.idiomatic: Arrears were remitted along the tour route and in districts with poor harvests.

sentences.zh: 二月丁丑，運漕米四萬石賑濟寧、泰安。

translations.literal: Second month, day dingchou: forty thousand shi of tax-grain transport was sent to relieve Jining and Tai'an.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, forty thousand shi of grain were sent to relieve Jining and Tai'an.

sentences.zh: 閱宿遷堤工。

translations.literal: The Suqian dike works were inspected.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor inspected the Suqian dikes.

sentences.zh: 己卯，自桃源登舟，遍閱河堤。

translations.literal: On day jimao, from Taoyuan he boarded a boat and inspected the river dikes throughout.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, he took a boat from Taoyuan and inspected the dikes.

sentences.zh: 甲申，渡江登金山。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, he crossed the river and ascended Jinshan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, he crossed the Yangzi and climbed Jinshan.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，次蘇州。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, the court halted at Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, the entourage stopped at Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 遣官奠大學士宋德宜墓。

translations.literal: An officer was sent to offer sacrifice at the tomb of the late Grand Secretary Song Deyi.
translations.idiomatic: An officer sacrificed at Grand Secretary Song Deyi's tomb.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，上駐杭州閱射。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, the Emperor halted at Hangzhou and reviewed archery.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, the Emperor held an archery review at Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，次江寧。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, the court halted at Jiangning.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, the entourage stopped at Jiangning.

sentences.zh: 三月戊申，上閱高家堰、翟家壩堤工。

translations.literal: Third month, day wushen: the Emperor inspected the Gaojia Embankment and Zhaijiaba dike works.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, the Emperor inspected dikes at Gaojia and Zhaijiaba.

sentences.zh: 己酉，上閱黃河南龍窩、煙墩等堤。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, the Emperor inspected the Yellow River dikes at Longwo and Yandun south of the river.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, he inspected Yellow River dikes at Longwo and Yandun.

sentences.zh: 庚申，上還京。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，萬壽節，上朝皇太后宮，免廷臣朝賀。

translations.literal: On day guihai, the birthday of long life: the Emperor attended the Empress Dowager's palace and exempted court ministers from congratulatory audience.
translations.idiomatic: On his birthday, the Emperor visited the Empress Dowager and excused ministers from court congratulations.

sentences.zh: 頒恩詔，錫高年，蠲額賦，察孝義，恤困窮，舉遺逸，罪非常赦所不原者，咸赦除之。

translations.literal: A grace edict was issued, granting favors to the aged, remitting tax quotas, examining filial conduct and righteousness, relieving the distressed, recommending the overlooked, and pardoning all crimes not covered by ordinary amnesties.
translations.idiomatic: A grace edict remitted taxes, honored the aged and virtuous, relieved the poor, and granted a broad pardon.

sentences.zh: 頒賜親王、郡王以下文武百官有差。

translations.literal: Gifts were bestowed in varying amounts on princes, commandery princes, and civil and military officials below them.
translations.idiomatic: Princes, nobles, and officials received graded gifts.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以洞鄂襲封信郡王。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, Tong'e succeeded as Prince Xin of the Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Tong'e succeeded as Prince Xin of the Commandery.

sentences.zh: 辛未，上御經筵。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, the Emperor attended the Classics lecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, the Emperor held the Classics lecture.

sentences.zh: 賜內廷修書舉人汪灝、何焯、蔣廷錫進士，一體殿試。

translations.literal: Imperial examination licentiates of the inner court book compilation, Wang Hao, He Chuo, and Jiang Tingxi, were granted jinshi status and admitted to the palace examination on equal terms.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Hao, He Chuo, and Jiang Tingxi, compiler licentiates, were granted jinshi and palace examination status.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛巳，賜王式丹等一百六十三人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day xinsi: Wang Shidan and one hundred sixty-three others were granted jinshi and other ranks with distinctions.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Wang Shidan and 163 others received jinshi degrees.

sentences.zh: 四川威州龍溪十八寨生番歸化納糧。

translations.literal: Raw tribesmen of the eighteen stockades of Longxi, Weizhou, Sichuan, submitted and paid grain tax.
translations.idiomatic: Eighteen Longxi stockades in Sichuan submitted and paid tax.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，大學士熊賜履乞休，命解官食俸，留備顧問。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, Grand Secretary Xiong Cilü asked to retire; he was ordered relieved of office while retaining salary, remaining available for consultation.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretary Xiong Cilü retired with salary but remained available for consultation.

sentences.zh: 傅繼祖等察審湖廣紅苗搶掠一案。

translations.literal: Fu Jizu and others investigated the case of Red Miao plundering in Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Jizu and colleagues investigated Red Miao raids in Huguang.

sentences.zh: 得旨：「總督郭琇、提督杜本植隱匿不報，均革職。

translations.literal: An edict was received: "Governor-General Guo Xiu and Provincial Commander Du Benzhi concealed reports and did not memorialize; both are dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor dismissed Governor-General Guo Xiu and Commander Du Benzhi for concealing Red Miao raids.

sentences.zh: 巡撫金璽降官。

translations.literal: Governor Jin Xi was reduced in rank."
translations.idiomatic: Governor Jin Xi was demoted."

sentences.zh: 」以喻成龍為湖廣總督。

translations.literal: Yu Chenglong was made governor-general of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Chenglong became governor-general of Huguang.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，致仕大學士王熙卒，予祭葬，諡文靖。

translations.literal: On day guisi, the retired Grand Secretary Wang Xi died; sacrificial rites and burial honors were granted, posthumous title Wenjing.
translations.idiomatic: Retired Grand Secretary Wang Xi died and received posthumous name Wenjing.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以陳廷敬為大學士兼吏部尚書。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Chen Jing'ai was made Grand Secretary and concurrent Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Jing'ai became Grand Secretary and Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，詔原任侍郎任克溥年逾九十，洵為耆碩，加尚書銜。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, an edict said the former Vice Minister Ren Kebo, over ninety years old, is truly a venerable elder; the rank of minister was added.
translations.idiomatic: Former Vice Minister Ren Kebo, over ninety, received ministerial rank.

sentences.zh: 以李光地為吏部尚書，仍巡撫直隸。

translations.literal: Li Guangdi was made Minister of Personnel while continuing as governor of Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: Li Guangdi became Minister of Personnel and remained Zhili governor.

sentences.zh: 以莽喀為荊州將軍，諾羅布為杭州將軍，宗室愛音圖為漢軍都統，孫渣齊、翁俄里為蒙古都統。

translations.literal: Mangka was made general at Jingzhou, Nuolobu at Hangzhou, the imperial clansman Aiyintu Han commander-in-chief, and Sun Zhaji and Weng E'eli Mongol commanders-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Mangka, Nuolobu, Aiyintu, Sun Zhaji, and Weng E'eli received military appointments.

sentences.zh: 己亥，諭八旗人等：「朕不惜數百萬帑金為旗丁償逋贖地，籌畫生計。

translations.literal: On day jihai, an edict to the Eight Banners people said: "We do not begrudge millions from the treasury to pay bannermen's debts and redeem land, planning their livelihood.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor told the banners he had spent millions to clear debts and restore their livelihoods.

sentences.zh: 爾等能人人以孝弟為心，勤儉為事，則足仰慰朕心矣。

translations.literal: If you can all take filial piety and brotherly duty to heart and diligence and frugality as your business, that is enough to comfort Our mind.
translations.idiomatic: He asked them to live frugally and filially to comfort him.

sentences.zh: 倘不知愛惜，仍前遊盪飲博，必以嚴法處之。

translations.literal: If you do not know how to cherish this but continue as before in roaming, drinking, and gambling, We shall certainly deal with you by severe law.
translations.idiomatic: He warned that idleness and gambling would be punished severely.

sentences.zh: 親書宣諭，其尚欽遵！

translations.literal: The Emperor personally wrote this proclamation—revere and obey it!
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor wrote this proclamation himself and ordered strict obedience.

translations.literal: "" (closing quotation mark in the source.)
translations.idiomatic: The edict continued.

sentences.zh: 五月壬子，裕親王福全有疾，上連日視之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day renzi: Prince Yu Fuquan was ill, and the Emperor visited him daily for several days.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on renzi day, Prince Yu Fuquan fell ill; the Emperor attended him day after day.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，內大臣索額圖有罪，拘禁於宗人府。

translations.literal: On day guihai, Inner Minister Songgotu was found guilty and detained in the Imperial Clan Court.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, Inner Minister Songgotu was imprisoned in the Imperial Clan Court for his crimes.

sentences.zh: 己巳，上巡幸塞外。

translations.literal: On day jisi, the Emperor made an inspection tour beyond the passes.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, the Emperor toured the northern frontier.

sentences.zh: 六月辛巳，恭親王常寧薨，命皇子每日齊集，賜銀一萬兩，遣官造墳立碑。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day xinsi: Prince Gong Changning died; princes were ordered to assemble daily, ten thousand taels of silver were granted, and officials were sent to build the tomb and erect a stele.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Prince Gong Changning died; princes were ordered to gather daily, ten thousand taels of silver were granted, and officials were sent to build his tomb and stele.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，裕親王福全薨，上聞之，兼程回京。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Prince Yu Fuquan died; when the Emperor heard of it, he hurried back to the capital day and night.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Prince Yu Fuquan died; hearing the news, the Emperor rushed back to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙巳朔，上臨裕親王喪，哭之慟，自蒼震門入居景仁宮。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, first day of the month on day yisi: the Emperor attended Prince Yu's mourning, wept bitterly, and lodged at Jingren Palace, entering by Cangzhen Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On the first of the seventh month, the Emperor attended Prince Yu's funeral, wept deeply, and lodged at Jingren Palace by way of Cangzhen Gate.

sentences.zh: 王大臣請還乾清宮，上曰：「居便殿乃祗遵成憲也。

translations.literal: Princes and ministers asked him to return to the Qianqing Palace; the Emperor said: "To lodge in the side hall is to revere and follow the established statutes.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers urged him to return to Qianqing Palace; the Emperor said, "Staying in the side hall honors ancestral precedent.

sentences.zh: 」居五日，命皇長子等持服，命御史羅占造墳建碑，諡曰憲。

translations.literal: " After residing five days, he ordered the eldest imperial son and others to wear mourning garments, ordered Censor Luo Zhan to build the tomb and erect a stele, and gave the posthumous title Xian.
translations.idiomatic: He remained five days, ordered princes into mourning, had Censor Luo Zhan build the tomb and stele, and conferred the posthumous name Xian.

sentences.zh: 子保泰嗣爵。

translations.literal: His son Baotai succeeded to the title.
translations.idiomatic: His son Baotai inherited the princedom.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以山東大雨，遣官分賑。

translations.literal: On day wushen, because of great rain in Shandong, officials were dispatched to distribute relief by region.
translations.idiomatic: Heavy rains in Shandong prompted regional relief missions on wushen day.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，上巡幸塞外。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, the Emperor made an inspection tour beyond the passes.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, the Emperor again toured the northern frontier.

sentences.zh: 己巳，發帑金三十萬兩，截漕五十萬石賑山東。

translations.literal: On day jisi, three hundred thousand taels from the treasury were issued, and five hundred thousand shi of grain transport were diverted to relieve Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: The court released three hundred thousand taels and diverted five hundred thousand shi of tribute grain to Shandong.

sentences.zh: 山東有司不理荒政，停其升轉。

translations.literal: Shandong officials who neglected famine administration had their promotions and transfers suspended.
translations.idiomatic: Shandong officials who failed famine duty were barred from promotion.

sentences.zh: 八月癸巳，停本年秋審。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day guisi: autumn judicial review was suspended for this year.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, autumn executions were halted for the year.

sentences.zh: 九月壬子，予故侍郎高士奇、勵杜訥祭葬。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day renzi: sacrificial rites and burial honors were granted to the late Vice Ministers Gao Shiqi and Li Dun'e.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, the late Vice Ministers Gao Shiqi and Li Dun'e received sacrificial and burial honors.

sentences.zh: 己巳，命尚書席爾達督辦紅苗。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Minister Xierda was ordered to supervise handling of the Red Miao.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, Minister Xierda was put in charge of the Red Miao campaign.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸未，上西巡啟鑾。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day guiwei: the Emperor set out on the western tour.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, the western tour began.

sentences.zh: 命給事中滿普、御史顧素在後行，查僕從生事，即時鎖拿。

translations.literal: Supervising secretary Man Pu and censor Gu Su were ordered to travel behind the procession, investigate servants causing trouble, and immediately arrest them.
translations.idiomatic: Man Pu and Gu Su were sent to trail the entourage and arrest any servants who made trouble.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，喇嘛請廣洮州衛廟，上曰：「取民地以廣廟宇，有△民生。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, lamas asked to expand the temple at Taozhou Guard; the Emperor said: "To take the people's land to enlarge temple buildings harms the people's livelihood.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, lamas sought to enlarge the Taozhou temple; the Emperor refused, saying seizing land for temples harmed the people.

sentences.zh: 其永行禁止。

translations.literal: This is to be permanently forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Such requests were permanently forbidden.

sentences.zh: 」癸巳，過井陘，次柏井驛。

translations.literal: " On day guisi, passing Jingxing, the court halted at Baijing Post Station.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day the entourage passed Jingxing and stopped at Baijing Post Station.

sentences.zh: 驛向乏泉，至是井泉涌溢。

translations.literal: The post station had long lacked springs; at this time well water gushed forth abundantly.
translations.idiomatic: The station had long lacked water; now the wells overflowed.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，駐太原。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, the court halted at Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, the entourage stopped at Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，詔免山西逋賦。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, an edict remitted overdue taxes in Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Shanxi's tax arrears were remitted.

sentences.zh: 百姓集行宮前籲留車駕，上為再停一日。

translations.literal: Commoners gathered before the traveling palace and begged the imperial carriage to stay; the Emperor accordingly stopped one more day.
translations.idiomatic: Locals pleaded before the traveling palace for the Emperor to stay; he granted them another day.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙巳，上次洪洞。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day yisi: the court halted at Hongdong.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, the entourage stopped at Hongdong.

sentences.zh: 遣官祭女媧陵。

translations.literal: Officials were sent to sacrifice at the tomb of Nüwa.
translations.idiomatic: An officer sacrificed at the tomb of Nüwa.

sentences.zh: 壬子，渡黃河，次潼關。

translations.literal: On day renzi, the court crossed the Yellow River and halted at Tong Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, the entourage crossed the Yellow River and stopped at Tong Pass.

sentences.zh: 遣官祭西嶽。

translations.literal: Officials were sent to sacrifice at the Western Peak.
translations.idiomatic: An officer sacrificed at Mount Hua, the Western Peak.

sentences.zh: 賜迎駕百歲老人白金。

translations.literal: White silver was granted to centenarians who welcomed the imperial procession.
translations.idiomatic: Centenarians who greeted the tour received gifts of silver.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，次渭南。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, the court halted at Weinan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, the entourage stopped at Weinan.

sentences.zh: 閱固原標兵射，賜提督潘育龍以下加一級。

translations.literal: The archery of the Guyuan Green Standard troops was reviewed; Provincial Commander Pan Yulong and those below were granted one rank of promotion.
translations.idiomatic: At Guyuan the Emperor reviewed Green Standard archery and promoted Pan Yulong and his officers one grade.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，上駐西安。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, the Emperor lodged at Xi'an.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, the Emperor reached Xi'an.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，閱駐防官兵射。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, the archery of the garrison troops was reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, he reviewed the garrison's archery.

sentences.zh: 遣官祭周文王、武王，祭文書御名。

translations.literal: Officials were sent to sacrifice to King Wen and King Wu of Zhou; the sacrificial documents bore the imperial signature.
translations.idiomatic: Officers sacrificed to the Zhou founders; the memorials carried the imperial name.

sentences.zh: 遣官奠提督張勇、梁化鳳墓。

translations.literal: Officials were sent to offer libations at the tombs of Provincial Commanders Zhang Yong and Liang Huafeng.
translations.idiomatic: Officers made offerings at the tombs of Zhang Yong and Liang Huafeng.

sentences.zh: 己未，上大閱於西安，賜將軍博濟御用弓矢。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, the Emperor held a grand review at Xi'an and granted the general Boji imperial bows and arrows.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, the Emperor held a grand review at Xi'an and gave General Boji imperial bows and arrows.

sentences.zh: 賜官兵宴。

translations.literal: A banquet was granted to officers and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Officers and soldiers were feasted.

sentences.zh: 軍民集行宮前籲留，上為留一日。

translations.literal: Soldiers and civilians gathered before the traveling palace and begged him to stay; the Emperor stayed one day.
translations.idiomatic: Troops and townspeople begged the Emperor to remain; he stayed another day.

sentences.zh: 賜盩厔徵士李顒御書「操志清潔」匾額。

translations.literal: The reclusive scholar Li Yu of Zhouzhi was granted an imperial plaque reading "Upright in Conduct and Pure in Purpose."
translations.idiomatic: The recluse Li Yu of Zhouzhi received an imperial plaque praising his upright character.

sentences.zh: 免陝、甘逋賦。

translations.literal: Overdue taxes in Shaanxi and Gansu were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Tax arrears in Shaanxi and Gansu were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，上迴鑾。

translations.literal: On day guihai, the Emperor returned from the tour.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, the western tour ended.

sentences.zh: 己巳，次陝州。

translations.literal: On day jisi, the court halted at Shanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, the entourage stopped at Shanzhou.

sentences.zh: 命皇三子胤祉往閱三門底柱。

translations.literal: The third imperial son Yinzhi was ordered to go inspect the Three Gates and Dixing Pillars.
translations.idiomatic: The third prince Yinzhi was sent to inspect the Three Gates and Dixing Pillars.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙亥，上次修武。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day yihai: the court halted at Xiuwu.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, the entourage stopped at Xiuwu.

sentences.zh: 閱懷慶營伍不整，逮總兵官王應統入京論死。

translations.literal: The Huaiqing troops were reviewed and found disorderly; regional commander Wang Yingtong was seized and sent to the capital for sentencing to death.
translations.idiomatic: Huaiqing troops proved disorderly; Wang Yingtong was sent to the capital and sentenced to death.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，次磁州。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, the court halted at Cizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, the entourage stopped at Cizhou.

sentences.zh: 御書「賢哲遺休」額懸先賢子貢墓。

translations.literal: Imperial calligraphy reading "Legacy of Worthy Sages" was hung at the tomb of the ancient sage Zigong.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor's inscription "Legacy of Worthy Sages" was placed at Zigong's tomb.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，上還京。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，定外任官在本籍五百里內者迴避。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, it was fixed that officials appointed outside the capital must avoid posts within five hundred li of their native place.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, outside appointees were barred from serving within five hundred li of home.

sentences.zh: 封常寧子海善為貝勒。

translations.literal: Changning's son Haishan was enfeoffed as beile.
translations.idiomatic: Changning's son Haishan was made a beile.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸、江南、山東、河南、陝西、浙江、湖廣等省九十一州縣災賦有差。

translations.literal: This year, disaster land tax for ninety-one prefectures and counties in Zhili, Jiangnan, Shandong, Henan, Shaanxi, Zhejiang, Huguang, and other provinces was remitted in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Tax relief was granted for disaster areas across ninety-one districts in several provinces.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、琉球、安南入貢。

translations.literal: Korea, Ryukyu, and Annam sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea, Ryukyu, and Annam paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 四十三年甲申春正月辛酉，詔曰：「朕諮訪民瘼，深悉力作艱難。

translations.literal: Forty-third year, spring, first month, day xinyou: an edict said: "We have inquired into the people's afflictions and deeply understand how hard manual labor is.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-third year, an edict declared that the Emperor had studied the people's hardships and knew how grueling their labor was.

sentences.zh: 耕三十畝者，輸租賦外，約餘二十石。

translations.literal: One who cultivates thirty mu, apart from paying rent and tax, has roughly twenty shi remaining.
translations.idiomatic: A farmer working thirty mu might keep about twenty shi after rent and taxes.

sentences.zh: 衣食丁徭，取給於此。

translations.literal: Food, clothing, corvée, and levies are drawn from this.
translations.idiomatic: Food, clothing, and corvée all came from that surplus.

sentences.zh: 幸逢廉吏，猶可有餘。

translations.literal: If fortunate enough to meet an upright official, one may still have a surplus.
translations.idiomatic: With an honest magistrate, a household might still get by.

sentences.zh: 若誅求無藝，則民無以為生。

translations.literal: If extortion knows no limit, the people have no means to live.
translations.idiomatic: Endless exactions left the people nothing to live on.

sentences.zh: 是故察吏所以安民，要在大吏實心體恤也。

translations.literal: Therefore inspecting officials is how the people are secured; the essential lies in senior officials sincerely sympathizing with them."
translations.idiomatic: Sound rule therefore depended on honest oversight—and on governors who truly cared for the people."

sentences.zh: 」戊辰，詔漢軍一傢俱外任者，酌改京員。

translations.literal: " On day wuchen, an edict said that when an entire Banner Han Chinese household went on outside appointment, Beijing posts were to be adjusted accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, an edict ordered that when a whole Han Banner family took outside posts, their Beijing offices be reassigned.

sentences.zh: 己巳，上謁陵。

translations.literal: On day jisi, the Emperor visited the imperial tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, the Emperor paid his respects at the imperial tombs.

sentences.zh: 二月甲戌，封淮神為長源佑順大淮之神，御書「靈瀆安瀾」額懸之。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiaxu: the Huai River deity was enfeoffed as Great God of the Huai, Source of Long Flow, Helper and Acceptor; imperial calligraphy reading "Spirit Estuary, Calm Waves" was hung there.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, the Huai god received a grand title and an imperial plaque reading "Spirit Estuary, Calm Waves."

sentences.zh: 癸巳，上還宮。

translations.literal: On day guisi, the Emperor returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, the Emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 以李基和為江西巡撫，能泰為四川巡撫。

translations.literal: Li Jihe was made governor of Jiangxi, and Nengtai governor of Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jihe became Jiangxi governor; Nengtai became Sichuan governor.

sentences.zh: 三月辛丑，上御經筵。

translations.literal: Third month, day xinchou: the Emperor attended the Classics lecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, the Emperor held the Classics lecture.

sentences.zh: 己酉，詔停熱審。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, an edict suspended the summer judicial review.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, the summer judicial review was halted.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以吳洪為甘肅提督。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Wu Hong was made provincial commander of Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, Wu Hong became Gansu provincial commander.

sentences.zh: 資送山東飢民回籍。

translations.literal: Starving people of Shandong were given travel funds to return to their native districts.
translations.idiomatic: Shandong famine refugees were given funds to return home.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以溫達為工部尚書。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, Wenda was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, Wenda became Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸酉，命侍衛拉錫察視河源。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day guiyou: guard Laxi was ordered to inspect the source of the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, guard Laxi was sent to find the Yellow River's source.

sentences.zh: 己卯，上幸棽髻山，遂閱永定河、子牙河。

translations.literal: On day jimao, the Emperor visited Fenji Mountain, then inspected the Yongding and Ziya rivers.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, the Emperor visited Fenji Mountain and inspected the Yongding and Ziya rivers.

sentences.zh: 丙申，上還京。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 五月辛酉，以於准為貴州巡撫。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day xinyou: Yu Zhun was made governor of Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Yu Zhun became Guizhou governor.

sentences.zh: 六月乙亥，上巡幸塞外。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day yihai: the Emperor made an inspection tour beyond the passes.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, the Emperor toured the northern frontier.

sentences.zh: 秋九月癸卯，詔督撫調員違例者罪之。

translations.literal: Autumn, ninth month, day guimao: an edict said that governors and governors-general who transferred personnel in violation of regulations would be punished.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, an edict threatened punishment for illegal transfers by provincial authorities.

sentences.zh: 侍郎常授招撫廣東海盜阿保位等二百三十七名，就撫為兵。

translations.literal: Vice Minister Chang Shou induced the surrender of two hundred thirty-seven Guangdong pirates including A Baowei, who were enrolled as soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister Chang Shou persuaded two hundred thirty-seven Guangdong pirates, including A Baowei, to surrender and join the army.

sentences.zh: 戊午，刑部尚書王士禛以失出降官。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, Minister of Justice Wang Shizhen was demoted for a procedural error in release.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, Minister of Justice Wang Shizhen was demoted for mishandling a release.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，上還宮。

translations.literal: On day guihai, the Emperor returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, the Emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，侍衛拉錫察視河源，還自星宿海，繪圖以進。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, guard Laxi, having inspected the river source, returned from Lake Xingxiu and presented a map.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, Laxi returned from Lake Xingxiu with a map of the river's source.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊辰朔，濬楊村舊河。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, first day on wuchen: the old river channel at Yangcun was dredged.
translations.idiomatic: On the first of the tenth month, the old channel at Yangcun was dredged.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，詔免順天、河間二府及山東、浙江二省明年稅糧。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, an edict remitted next year's grain tax for Shuntian and Hejian prefectures and for Shandong and Zhejiang provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, next year's grain tax was forgiven for Shuntian, Hejian, Shandong, and Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以李振裕為禮部尚書，徐潮為戶部尚書，屠粹忠為兵部尚書，王掞為刑部尚書，吳涵為左都御史。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, Li Zhenyu was made Minister of Rites, Xu Chao Minister of Revenue, Tu Cuizhong Minister of War, Wang Yan Minister of Justice, and Wu Han Censor-in-chief of the Left.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, Li Zhenyu, Xu Chao, Tu Cuizhong, Wang Yan, and Wu Han received new ministerial posts.

sentences.zh: 癸未，頒內製銅斗銅升於戶部，命以鐵制頒行。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, domestically made bronze bushels and sheng were issued to the Ministry of Revenue, with orders to promulgate iron versions.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day, standard bronze measures were sent to the Ministry of Revenue, with iron copies ordered for general use.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以趙弘燮為河南巡撫。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, Zhao Hongxie was made governor of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, Zhao Hongxie became Henan governor.

sentences.zh: 己丑，命濬汾、渭、賈魯諸河。

translations.literal: On day jichou, orders were issued to dredge the Fen, Wei, Jia Lu, and other rivers.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, the court ordered dredging of the Fen, Wei, Jia Lu, and related rivers.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，上閱永定河。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, the Emperor inspected the Yongding River.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, the Emperor inspected the Yongding River.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁酉朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, first day on dingyou: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first of the eleventh month, a solar eclipse occurred.

sentences.zh: 上還宮。

translations.literal: The Emperor returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 上以儀器測驗與七政歷不符，欽天監官請罪，免之。

translations.literal: Because instrument tests did not match the Seven Regulators calendar, officials of the Directorate of Astronomy begged forgiveness and were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: When observatory instruments disagreed with the official calendar, the Astronomical Bureau officials were dismissed.

sentences.zh: 郎中費仰嘏以貪婪棄市。

translations.literal: Bureau director Fei Yanggu was executed in the marketplace for greed.
translations.idiomatic: Bureau director Fei Yanggu was executed for corruption.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，定吏部行取知縣例，停督撫保薦。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, regulations were fixed for the Ministry of Personnel's selection of district magistrates; governors' recommendations were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, rules were set for promoting magistrates through the Ministry of Personnel, ending provincial nominations.

sentences.zh: 戊午，湖廣巡撫劉殿衡建御書樓，上斥其糜費，並嚴禁藉修建侵帑累民者。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, Huguang Governor Liu Dianheng built an Imperial Calligraphy Pavilion; the Emperor rebuked the waste and strictly forbade using construction to seize treasury funds and burden the people.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, Liu Dianheng's costly calligraphy pavilion drew imperial rebuke and a ban on wasteful building that drained the treasury and oppressed the people.

sentences.zh: 四川陝西總督博霽疏參涼州總兵官魏勛年老，上曰：「魏勛前有軍功，兵民愛戴，與師帝賓、麥良璽、潘育龍俱系舊臣，難得，何可參耶？

translations.literal: Sichuan-Shaanxi Governor-General Bo Ji memorialized impeaching Liangzhou regional commander Wei Xun for advanced age; the Emperor said: "Wei Xun had military merit before; troops and people esteem him. Together with Shi Dibin, Mai Liangxi, and Pan Yulong he is an old minister—hard to replace—how can he be impeached?"
translations.idiomatic: Bo Ji urged removing aged Wei Xun as Liangzhou commander; the Emperor refused, praising Wei Xun's merit and grouping him with veteran generals too valuable to lose.

sentences.zh: 」壬戌，誡修明史史臣覈公論，明是非，以成信史。

translations.literal: " On day renxu, an admonition was issued to those compiling the History of Ming to verify public judgment, clarify right and wrong, and complete a trustworthy history.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, historians compiling the Ming History were admonished to weigh evidence fairly and write a credible record.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙酉，天津總兵官藍理請沿海屯田，從之。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day yiyou: Tianjin regional commander Lan Li asked to establish coastal garrison farming; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Lan Li's proposal for coastal garrison farms near Tianjin was approved.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以御制詩集賜廷臣。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, the Emperor's collected poems were bestowed on court ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, the Emperor gave his collected poems to the court.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸、江南、山東、湖廣、廣東等省一百九州縣災賦有差。

translations.literal: This year, disaster land tax for one hundred nine prefectures and counties in Zhili, Jiangnan, Shandong, Huguang, Guangdong, and other provinces was remitted in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Tax relief was granted for disaster areas across one hundred nine districts in several provinces.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮入貢。

translations.literal: Korea sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 四十四年乙酉春正月戊午，古文淵鑒成，頒賜廷臣，及於官學。

translations.literal: Forty-fourth year, spring, first month, day wuwu: the Guwen Yuanjian was completed and bestowed on court ministers and the official schools.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-fourth year, the Guwen Yuanjian was finished and distributed to ministers and the official schools.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，上幸湯泉。

translations.literal: On day guihai, the Emperor visited the hot springs.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, the Emperor went to the hot springs.

sentences.zh: 二月乙丑朔，上還宮。

translations.literal: Second month, first day of the month, day yichou: the Emperor returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the first of the second month, the Emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，上南巡閱河。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, the Emperor set out on the southern tour to inspect the rivers.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, the southern river inspection tour began.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「朕留意河防，屢行閱視，獲告成功。

translations.literal: An edict said: "We have paid close attention to river defense, repeatedly going to inspect, and are told of success.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said the Emperor had often inspected the rivers and been told the works had succeeded.

sentences.zh: 茲黃水申昜流，尚須察驗形勢，即循河南下。

translations.literal: Now the Yellow River flows in a broad course; the terrain must still be examined, and We shall then follow the river south downstream.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River current had spread wide, so the court would survey conditions and continue south along the river.

sentences.zh: 所至勿繕行宮，其有科斂累民者，以軍法治罪。

translations.literal: Where We pass, travel palaces are not to be repaired; whoever levies exactions that burden the people shall be punished by military law.
translations.idiomatic: No travel palaces were to be built along the route, and officials who levied burdens on the people would face military punishment.

sentences.zh: 」壬午，次靜海。

translations.literal: " On day renwu, the court halted at Jinghai.
translations.idiomatic: The edict ended. On renwu day, the entourage stopped at Jinghai.

sentences.zh: 遣官奠故侍郎勵杜訥墓，予諡文恪。

translations.literal: An officer was sent to offer sacrifice at the tomb of the late Vice Minister Du Ne; the posthumous title Wenke was granted.
translations.idiomatic: An officer sacrificed at Vice Minister Du Ne tomb and granted him the posthumous name Wenke.

sentences.zh: 三月己亥，諭山東撫臣曰：「百姓歡迎道左者日數十萬人，計日迴鑾，正當麥秀，其各務稼穡，毋致妨農。

translations.literal: Third month, day jihai: the Emperor instructed the Shandong governor, saying: "Common people welcoming Us by the roadside number hundreds of thousands each day; counting the days until the imperial return, it will be right when wheat is in ear—each of you must attend to farming and not cause harm to agriculture.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, the Emperor told the Shandong governor that crowds lining the road must not be kept from the harvest.

sentences.zh: 」乙巳，上駐揚州。

translations.literal: " On day yisi, the Emperor halted at Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The instruction ended. On yisi day, the Emperor stopped at Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 授河臣張鵬翮方略。

translations.literal: Strategic instructions were given to the river official Zhang Penghe.
translations.idiomatic: River commissioner Zhang Penghe received the imperial engineering instructions.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，上駐蘇州。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, the Emperor halted at Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, the entourage stopped at Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 命選江南、浙江舉、貢、生、監善書者入京修書。

translations.literal: An order was issued to select those skilled in calligraphy among provincial graduates, tribute students, students, and imperial academy students from Jiangnan and Zhejiang to enter the capital to compile books.
translations.idiomatic: Skilled calligraphers from Jiangnan and Zhejiang were chosen to compile books in Beijing.

sentences.zh: 賜公福善，大學士張玉書、陳廷敬，在籍大學士張英，都統愛音圖白金。

translations.literal: Silver was granted to Gong Fushan, Grand Secretaries Zhang Yushu and Chen Tingjing, retired Grand Secretary Zhang Ying, and Commander-in-chief Aiyintu.
translations.idiomatic: Gong Fushan, Zhang Yushu, Chen Tingjing, Zhang Ying, and Aiyintu received gifts of silver.

sentences.zh: 賜大學士馬齊等皇輿表。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Ma Qi and others were granted the "Imperial Carriage" table.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretary Ma Qi and colleagues received imperial writing tablets.

sentences.zh: 己未，次松江閱射。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, the court halted at Songjiang and reviewed archery.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, the Emperor held an archery review at Songjiang.

sentences.zh: 上書「聖跡遺徽」額賜青浦孔氏。

translations.literal: The Emperor wrote and bestowed the plaque "Sacred Traces, Enduring Eminence" on the Kong clan of Qingpu.
translations.idiomatic: The Kong family of Qingpu received an imperial plaque reading "Sacred Traces, Enduring Eminence."

sentences.zh: 賜故侍郎高士奇諡文恪。

translations.literal: The late Vice Minister Gao Shiqi was granted the posthumous title Wenke.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister Gao Shiqi received the posthumous name Wenke.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙寅，上駐杭州閱射。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day bingyin: the Emperor halted at Hangzhou and reviewed archery.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, the Emperor held an archery review at Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚午，詔赦山東、江蘇、浙江、福建死罪減一等。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, an edict pardoned death sentences by one degree in Shandong, Jiangsu, Zhejiang, and Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: Death sentences in four eastern provinces were reduced one grade.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，御書「至德無名」額懸吳太伯祠，並書季札、董仲舒、焦先、周敦頤、范仲淹、蘇軾、歐陽修、胡安國、米芾、宗澤、陸秀夫各匾額懸其祠。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, imperial calligraphy "Supreme Virtue Without a Name" was hung at the shrine of Wu Taibo, and plaques for Ji Zha, Dong Zhongshu, Jiao Xian, Zhou Dunyi, Fan Zhongyan, Su Shi, Ouyang Xiu, Hu An'guo, Mi Fu, Zong Ze, and Lu Xiufu were written and hung at their respective shrines.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor inscribed plaques for Wu Taibo and eleven other worthies and hung them at their shrines.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，上駐江寧。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, the Emperor halted at Jiangning.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, the entourage stopped at Jiangning.

sentences.zh: 閏四月癸卯，上閱高家堰堤工。

translations.literal: Intercalary fourth month, day guimao: the Emperor inspected the Gaojia Embankment dike works.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary fourth month, the Emperor inspected dikes at Gaojia Embankment.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，上還京。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 五月戊寅，上親鞫郎中陳汝弼一案，原汝弼罪。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day wuyin: the Emperor personally tried the case of Director Chen Rubi and pardoned Chen Rubi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, the Emperor tried Director Chen Rubi in person and pardoned him.

sentences.zh: 刑部尚書安布祿、左都御史舒輅以失獄免職。

translations.literal: Minister of Justice Anbulu and Censor-in-chief of the Left Shu Lu were dismissed from office for losing a case in court.
translations.idiomatic: Anbulu and Shu Lu were removed for mishandling the Chen Rubi trial.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以貝和諾為雲南貴州總督。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, Bei Henuo was made governor-general of Yunnan and Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Bei Henuo became governor-general of Yunnan and Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，上巡幸塞外。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, the Emperor toured the outer marches.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, the Emperor toured beyond the passes.

sentences.zh: 六月甲午，命行取知縣非再任者不得考選科道。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiawu: an order was issued that magistrates selected for promotion who had not served a second term might not be examined for appointment as censor or branch head.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, magistrates without a second term were barred from censorial selection.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，停廣東開礦。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, mining in Guangdong was halted.
translations.idiomatic: Guangdong mining was suspended.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，上駐蹕熱河。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, the Emperor halted at Rehe.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, the entourage stopped at Rehe.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬申，河決清水溝、韓庄，命河臣察居民田舍以聞。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day renshen: the Yellow River broke at Qingshuigou and Hanzhuang; river officials were ordered to inspect resident houses and fields and report.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, the river breached at Qingshuigou and Hanzhuang, and officials were sent to survey the damage.

sentences.zh: 八月甲午，免八旗借支兵饟銀七十萬兩。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiawu: seven hundred thousand taels of silver in banner advances on military pay were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, 700,000 taels of banner military advances were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 戊午，喻成龍免，以石文晟為湖廣總督。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, Yu Chenglong was relieved; Shi Wensheng was made governor-general of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Chenglong left office and Shi Wensheng became Huguang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 庚申，上發博洛河屯，閱牧群。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, the Emperor departed Boluohetun and reviewed the herds.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, the Emperor left Boluohetun to inspect the pastures.

sentences.zh: 九月己巳，進張家口。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jisi: the court advanced to Zhangjiakou.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, the entourage reached Zhangjiakou.

sentences.zh: 丙子還京。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以希福納為左都御史，達佳為江寧將軍。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, Xi Hana was made Censor-in-chief of the Left, and Dajia made general at Jiangning.
translations.idiomatic: Xi Hana became left censor-in-chief and Dajia Jiangning general.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛卯朔，重修華陰西嶽廟成，上制碑文。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, first day of the month, day xinmao: reconstruction of the West Peak temple at Huayin was completed, and the Emperor composed the stele inscription.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, the rebuilt Huayin West Peak temple was finished and the Emperor wrote its stele text.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以富寧安為漢軍都統。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Fu Ning'an was made Han Chinese commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Ning'an became Han commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛酉，命蒙古公丹濟拉備兵推河，察視策旺阿拉布坦。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day xinyou: the Mongol prince Danjila was ordered to ready troops to push back the river and observe Tsewang Arabtan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Danjila was told to prepare forces against the river breach and watch Tsewang Arabtan.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以李光地為大學士，宋犖為吏部尚書，調趙弘燮為直隸巡撫。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Li Guangdi was made Grand Secretary, Song Luo Minister of Personnel, and Zhao Hongcan transferred to be governor of Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: Li Guangdi became Grand Secretary; Song Luo and Zhao Hongcan received new posts.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，詔免湖廣明年額賦及以前逋賦。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, an edict remitted next year land tax quota for Huguang and all previous arrears.
translations.idiomatic: Huguang was granted relief from the next year quota and past tax arrears.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，國子監落成，御書「彝倫堂」額。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, the Imperial Academy was completed; the Emperor wrote the plaque "Hall of Constant Norms."
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Academy opened and the Emperor inscribed "Hall of Constant Norms."

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以汪灝為河南巡撫。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, Wang Hao was made governor of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Hao became Henan governor.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，上謁陵。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, the Emperor visited the imperial tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, the Emperor paid respects at the tombs.

sentences.zh: 巡幸近塞。

translations.literal: He toured the near marches.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor toured the nearby frontier.

sentences.zh: 戊子，設雲南廣南、麗江二府學官，許土人應試。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, school officials were established for Guangnan and Lijiang prefectures in Yunnan, and native people were permitted to take the examinations.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan Guangnan and Lijiang gained schools so local people could sit for exams.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬寅，上臨裕親王福全葬。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day renyin: the Emperor attended the burial of Prince Yu Fuquan.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, the Emperor went to the funeral of Prince Yu Fuquan.

sentences.zh: 以阿靈阿兼理籓院尚書。

translations.literal: Aling'a was concurrently made Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Aling'a also took charge of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 己酉，上還宮。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, the Emperor returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, the Emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以祖良璧為福州將軍。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Zu Liangbi was made general at Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zu Liangbi became Fuzhou general.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸、江南、湖廣、廣東等省四十六州縣災賦有差。

translations.literal: This year, disaster land tax for forty-six districts in Zhili, Jiangnan, Huguang, Guangdong, and other provinces was remitted in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Tax relief was granted for disaster areas in forty-six districts across several provinces.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、琉球入貢。

translations.literal: Korea and Ryukyu sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea and Ryukyu paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 四十五年丙戌春正月乙酉，命孫渣齊、徐潮督濬淮揚引河。

translations.literal: Forty-fifth year, spring, first month, day yiyou: Sun Zhaji and Xu Chao were ordered to supervise dredging of the Huai-Yang diversion channels.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-fifth year, Sun Zhaji and Xu Chao were assigned to dredge the Huai-Yang canals.

sentences.zh: 順天考官戶部侍郎汪霦、贊善姚士藟以取士不公褫職。

translations.literal: The Shuntian examination officials, Vice Minister of Revenue Wang Fei and Reader-academician Yao Shiyun, were dismissed from office for unfair selection of candidates.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Fei and Yao Shiyun lost their posts for biased Shuntian examination selections.

sentences.zh: 二月癸巳，上巡幸畿甸。

translations.literal: Second month, day guisi: the Emperor toured the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, the Emperor toured the metropolitan district.

sentences.zh: 丁未，次靜海，閱子牙河。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, the court halted at Jinghai and inspected the Ziya River.
translations.idiomatic: At Jinghai the Emperor inspected the Ziya River.

sentences.zh: 壬子，還駐南苑。

translations.literal: On day renzi, the court returned and halted at the Southern Park.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, the entourage returned to the Southern Park.

sentences.zh: 以諸滿為江寧將軍。

translations.literal: Zhu Man was made general at Jiangning.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Man became Jiangning general.

sentences.zh: 以王然為浙江巡撫。

translations.literal: Wang Ran was made governor of Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ran became Zhejiang governor.

sentences.zh: 江南江西總督阿山劾江寧知府陳鵬年安奉聖訓不敬，部議應斬。

translations.literal: Governor-General Ashan of Jiangnan and Jiangxi impeached Nanjing Prefect Chen Pengnian for disrespect in carrying out imperial instructions; the ministry recommended decapitation.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Ashan accused Nanjing prefect Chen Pengnian of disrespect; the ministry urged his execution.

sentences.zh: 先是，乙酉年南巡，陳鵬年遵旨不治行宮，阿山故假他事劾之。

translations.literal: Earlier, on the yiyou-year southern tour, Chen Pengnian had obeyed orders not to build travel palaces; Ashan therefore used other charges to impeach him.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Pengnian had refused to build palaces on an earlier tour, so Ashan trumped up other charges.

sentences.zh: 上命入京修書。

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered him to enter the capital to compile books.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor spared him and sent him to Beijing to work on the book project.

sentences.zh: 戊午，上還宮。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, the Emperor returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, the Emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 三月庚申，上御經筵。

translations.literal: Third month, day gengshen: the Emperor attended the Classics lecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, the Emperor held the Classics lecture.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，賜施雲錦等二百八十九人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, Shi Yunjin and two hundred eighty-nine others were granted jinshi and other ranks with distinctions.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Yunjin and 289 others received jinshi degrees with graded honors.

sentences.zh: 詔直省建育嬰堂。

translations.literal: An edict ordered every province to establish infant-care halls.
translations.idiomatic: Provinces were ordered to build foundling hospitals.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊子朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, first day of the month, day wuzi: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, a solar eclipse occurred.

sentences.zh: 加貴州提督李芳述鎮遠將軍。

translations.literal: Guizhou Provincial Commander Li Fangshu was given the additional title Zhenyuan General.
translations.idiomatic: Li Fangshu of Guizhou also received the title Zhenyuan General.

sentences.zh: 乙未，吳涵罷，以梅鋗為左都御史。

translations.literal: On day yimao, Wu Han was dismissed; Mei Juan was made Censor-in-chief of the Left.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Han left office and Mei Juan became left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 五月己未，以金世榮為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jiwei: Jin Shirong was made Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Jin Shirong became Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，詔免直隸、山東逋賦。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, an edict remitted tax arrears in Zhili and Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: Zhili and Shandong were granted relief from overdue taxes.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以梁鼐為福建浙江總督。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, Liang Nai was made governor-general of Fujian and Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Nai became governor-general of Fujian and Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，上巡幸塞外。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, the Emperor toured the outer marches.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, the Emperor again toured beyond the passes.

sentences.zh: 六月丁亥朔，詔修功臣傳。

translations.literal: Sixth month, first day of the month, day dinghai: an edict ordered compilation of biographies of meritorious officials.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, the court ordered biographies of founding ministers compiled.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，命梅鋗、二鬲按容美土司田舜年獄。

translations.literal: On day guisi, Mei Juan and Erge were ordered to investigate the case of Rongmei native official Tian Shunnian.
translations.idiomatic: Mei Juan and Erge were sent to try Rongmei chieftain Tian Shunnian.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，命凡部寺咨取錢糧非由奏請者，戶部月會其數以聞。

translations.literal: On day renyin, an order was issued that whenever ministries and courts requisitioned funds and grain not by memorial request, the Ministry of Revenue each month tally the amounts and report.
translations.idiomatic: All off-memorial fund requests by ministries were to be tallied monthly by the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 以藍理為福建陸路提督。

translations.literal: Lan Li was made Fujian land-route provincial commander.
translations.idiomatic: Lan Li became Fujian land-route commander.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，四川巡撫能泰疏報安樂鐵索橋告成，移化林營千總駐守。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, Sichuan Governor Neng Tai memorialized that the Anle iron-chain bridge was completed and a thousand-household from the Hualin garrison was moved to garrison it.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan reported the Anle chain bridge finished and a garrison posted there.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚申，上駐蹕熱河。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day gengshen: the Emperor halted at Rehe.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, the entourage stopped at Rehe.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以德昭嗣封信郡王。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Dezhao succeeded as Prince Peng of the Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Dezhao inherited the title Prince Peng of the Commandery.

sentences.zh: 八月壬辰，高家堰車邏壩澗河河堤告成。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day renchen: the Gaojia Embankment Cheluo dam and Jianhe river dikes were reported complete.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, dikes at Gaojia Embankment and Jianhe were declared finished.

sentences.zh: 九月己亥，上還京。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jihai, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙酉朔，敦拜罷，以溫達為吏部尚書，希福納為工部尚書。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, first day of the month, day yiyou: Dunbai was dismissed; Wenda was made Minister of Personnel, and Xi Hana Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Dunbai left office; Wenda and Xi Hana received new ministries.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，武殿試。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, the military palace examination was held.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, the military jinshi examination took place.

sentences.zh: 諭曰：「今天下承平日久，曾經戰陣大臣已少，知海上用兵者益少。

translations.literal: An instruction said: "Now the empire has been at peace many years; ministers who have seen battle are already few, and those who know naval warfare are fewer still.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor warned that long peace had left few generals with battle or naval experience.

sentences.zh: 他日台灣不無可慮。

translations.literal: Someday Taiwan may give cause for concern.
translations.idiomatic: Taiwan might one day become a worry.

sentences.zh: 朕甲子南巡，由江寧登舟，至黃天盪，江風大作，朕獨立船頭射江豚，了不為意。

translations.literal: On Our jiazi southern tour, from Jiangning We boarded a boat; at Huangtiandang great river winds arose; We stood alone on the bow shooting river porpoises, wholly unperturbed.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi tour he had stood on the bow in a gale at Huangtiandang, shooting porpoises without fear.

sentences.zh: 迨後渡江，漸覺心動。

translations.literal: Later, when crossing the river, Our heart began to stir.
translations.idiomatic: Later crossings had unsettled him.

sentences.zh: 去歲渡江，則心悸矣。

translations.literal: Last year, when crossing the river, Our heart palpitated.
translations.idiomatic: The year before, crossing the river had left his heart racing.

sentences.zh: 皆年為之也。

translations.literal: All this is the work of age.
translations.idiomatic: Age alone explained it.

sentences.zh: 問之宿將亦然。

translations.literal: Asked veteran generals—they are the same.
translations.idiomatic: Old generals told him they felt the same.

sentences.zh: 今使高年奮勇效命，何可得耶？

translations.literal: Now to make the aged strive bravely to give their lives—how can it be obtained?
translations.idiomatic: How could he expect the elderly to fight as fiercely as before?

sentences.zh: 」壬寅，命大學士席哈納、侍郎張廷樞、蕭永藻覆按土司田舜年獄。

translations.literal: " On day renyin, Grand Secretary Xi Hana and Vice Ministers Zhang Tingshu and Xiao Yongzao were ordered to reinvestigate the case of native official Tian Shunnian.
translations.idiomatic: The address ended. Xi Hana, Zhang Tingshu, and Xiao Yongzao were ordered to retry Tian Shunnian.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以迓圖為滿洲都統。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, Yatu was made Manchu commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Yatu became Manchu commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 己酉，詔免山西、陝西、江蘇、安徽、江西、浙江、福建、湖北、湖南、廣東十省逋賦。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, an edict remitted tax arrears in Shanxi, Shaanxi, Jiangsu, Anhui, Jiangxi, Zhejiang, Fujian, Hubei, Hunan, and Guangdong—ten provinces.
translations.idiomatic: Ten provinces were granted relief from overdue taxes.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸酉，命尚書金世榮、侍郎巴錫、范承烈督濬清河。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day guiyou: Ministers Jin Shirong, Vice Ministers Baxi and Fan Chenglei were ordered to supervise dredging of the Qing River.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Jin Shirong, Baxi, and Fan Chenglei were assigned to dredge the Qing River.

sentences.zh: 免八旗官兵貸官未歸銀三百九十五萬六千六百兩有奇。

translations.literal: Banner officers and soldiers were remitted three million nine hundred fifty-six thousand six hundred-odd taels of silver borrowed from government and not yet repaid.
translations.idiomatic: Nearly four million taels of unpaid banner loans were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以阿山為刑部尚書。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, Ashan was made Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: Ashan became Minister of Justice.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，上謁陵。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, the Emperor paid respects at the imperial tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, the Emperor visited the imperial tombs.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以邵穆布為江南江西總督。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, Shao Mubu was made governor-general of Jiangnan and Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, Shao Mubu became governor-general of Jiangnan and Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以山東私鑄多，聽以小錢完正賦，責有司運京鼓鑄。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, because private coining was widespread in Shandong, permission was given to pay the regular tax in small coins, and officials were charged to transport them to the capital for recoining.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day, Shandong was allowed to pay taxes in small coin due to widespread private minting; officials were ordered to send it to Beijing for recoining.

sentences.zh: 甲申，上巡幸塞外。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, the Emperor toured beyond the passes.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, the Emperor toured the frontier.

sentences.zh: 西藏達賴喇嘛卒，其下第巴匿之，又立偽達賴喇嘛。

translations.literal: The Dalai Lama of Tibet died; his subordinate the Depa concealed it and installed a false Dalai Lama.
translations.idiomatic: Tibet's Dalai Lama died; the Depa hid the death and installed a false Dalai Lama.

sentences.zh: 拉藏汗殺第巴而獻其偽喇嘛。

translations.literal: Lhasang Khan killed the Depa and presented the false lama.
translations.idiomatic: Lhasang Khan killed the Depa and delivered the false lama to the court.

sentences.zh: 西寧喇嘛商南多爾濟以聞。

translations.literal: The Xining lama Shangnan Duo'erji reported it.
translations.idiomatic: The Xining lama Shangnan Duo'erji reported the matter.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬寅，上還宮。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day renyin: the Emperor returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on renyin day, the Emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 詔罪囚緩決至三四年者減一等。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that prisoners under the delayed-execution procedure for three or four years have their sentence reduced by one degree.
translations.idiomatic: An edict reduced sentences one grade for prisoners awaiting clemency review for three or four years.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，郭世隆罷，以趙弘燦為廣東廣西總督。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, Guo Shilong was dismissed; Zhao Hongcan was made governor-general of Guangdong and Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Shilong was dismissed and Zhao Hongcan became governor-general of Guangdong and Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸、江南、福建、江西、湖廣等省三十二州縣災賦有差。

translations.literal: This year, disaster land tax for thirty-two prefectures and counties in Zhili, Jiangnan, Fujian, Jiangxi, Huguang, and other provinces was remitted in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Tax relief was granted for disaster areas in thirty-two districts across several provinces.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮入貢。

translations.literal: Korea sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 四十六年丁亥春正月丁卯，詔：「南巡閱河，往返舟楫，不御室廬。

translations.literal: Forty-sixth year, spring, first month, day dingmao: an edict said: "On the southern tour to inspect the rivers, going and returning by boat, We shall not lodge in houses.
