translations.idiomatic: In the forty-sixth year, on the first day of spring, an edict ordered that on the southern river inspection tour the Emperor would travel by boat and not stay in houses.

sentences.zh: 所過勿得供億。

translations.literal: Where We pass, lavish supplies are forbidden."
translations.idiomatic: No lavish supplies were to be provided along the route."

sentences.zh: 」丁巳，梅鋗免，以蕭永藻為左都御史。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, Mei Yong was dismissed; Xiao Yongzao was made Censor-in-chief of the Left.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, Mei Yong left office and Xiao Yongzao became Left Censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 二月戊戌，次台庄，百姓來獻食物。

translations.literal: Second month, day wuxu: the court halted at Taizhuang; commoners came to present food.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, at Taizhuang, locals brought food as gifts.

sentences.zh: 召耆老前，詳詢農事生計，良久乃發。

translations.literal: He summoned elders before him, inquired in detail into farming and livelihood, and only after a long while set out again.
translations.idiomatic: He called elders forward, asked at length about farming and livelihood, then moved on.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，上閱溜淮套，由清口登陸，如曹家廟，見地勢毗連山嶺，不可疏鑿，而河道所經，直民廬舍墳墓，悉當毀壞。

translations.literal: On day guimao, the Emperor inspected the Huai diversion works; he landed at Qingkou and went to Cao Family Temple, saw the terrain joined to hills and could not be dredged open, while the channel route would have cut straight through commoners' houses and graves—all to be destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, inspecting Huai works, he found dredging at Cao Family Temple would ruin homes and graves on the route.

sentences.zh: 詰責張鵬翮等，遂罷其役，道旁居民驩呼萬歲。

translations.literal: He reprimanded Zhang Pengge and others, then halted the project; residents along the road cheered "Long live the Emperor!"
translations.idiomatic: He rebuked Zhang Pengge and halted the works; roadside residents cheered.

sentences.zh: 命別勘視天然壩以下河道。

translations.literal: He ordered a separate survey of the river channel below the natural barrier.
translations.idiomatic: A separate survey was ordered for the channel below the natural dam.

sentences.zh: 三月己未，上駐江寧。

translations.literal: Third month, day jiwei: the Emperor halted at Jiangning.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, the Emperor stayed at Jiangning.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，上駐蘇州。

translations.literal: On day yisi, the Emperor halted at Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, the Emperor stayed at Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲申，上駐杭州。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jiashen: the Emperor halted at Hangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, the Emperor stayed at Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「朕頃因視河，駐蹕淮上。

translations.literal: An edict said: "We have lately, because of inspecting the rivers, halted on the Huai.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said the Emperor had halted on the Huai while inspecting the rivers.

sentences.zh: 江、浙二省官民籲請臨幸，朕勉徇群情，涉江而南。

translations.literal: Officials and people of Jiangsu and Zhejiang begged Us to visit; We reluctantly yielded to the multitude's wish and crossed the river southward.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangsu and Zhejiang officials and people begged a visit; the Emperor reluctantly crossed south.

sentences.zh: 方今二麥垂熟，百姓沿河擁觀，不無踐踏。

translations.literal: Now the second wheat crop is nearly ripe; commoners crowding along the river to watch cannot but trample it.
translations.idiomatic: With the second wheat crop nearly ripe, crowds along the river risked trampling the fields.

sentences.zh: 其令停迎送，示朕重農愛民至意。

translations.literal: Order that welcoming and escort cease, to show Our intent of valuing agriculture and loving the people."
translations.idiomatic: Welcoming parties were ordered to cease, to show the Emperor's care for farmers."

sentences.zh: 」戊申，以鄂克遜為江寧將軍，殷泰為甘肅提督。

translations.literal: On day wushen, E'kexun was made general at Jiangning and Yin Tai provincial commander of Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: E'kexun became Jiangning general; Yin Tai became Gansu provincial commander.

sentences.zh: 五月壬子朔，上次山陽，示河臣方略。

translations.literal: Fifth month, first day renzi: the court halted at Shanyang; river officials were shown the strategic plan.
translations.idiomatic: On the first of the fifth month, at Shanyang, the Emperor briefed river officials on strategy.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，上還京。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 丙子，解阿山尚書，削張鵬翮宮保。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, Minister A Shan was dismissed from office; Zhang Pengge's designation as Palace Guardian was stripped.
translations.idiomatic: Minister A Shan was dismissed and Zhang Pengge lost his Palace Guardian title.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，贈故河道總督靳輔太子太保，予世職。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, the late river-course director-general Jin Fu was posthumously granted Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent and a hereditary office.
translations.idiomatic: Late director-general Jin Fu received posthumous Grand Guardian rank and a hereditary post.

sentences.zh: 加福建提督吳英威略將軍。

translations.literal: Fujian provincial commander Wu Ying was given the additional title Weilüe General.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Ying, Fujian commander, received the title Weilüe General.

sentences.zh: 贈死難運司高天爵官，予諡忠烈。

translations.literal: Transport Commissioner Gao Tianjue, who died in the line of duty, was granted an official rank and posthumous title Zhonglie.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Tianjue, killed in service, received rank and posthumous name Zhonglie.

sentences.zh: 以達爾佔為荊州將軍。

translations.literal: Da'erzhan was made general at Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Da'erzhan became Jingzhou general.

sentences.zh: 六月丁亥，上巡幸塞外。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day dinghai: the Emperor toured beyond the passes.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, the Emperor toured the frontier.

sentences.zh: 以巢可託為左都御史，起郭世隆為湖廣總督。

translations.literal: Chao Ketuo was made Censor-in-chief of the Left; Guo Shilong was recalled as governor-general of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: Chao Ketuo became Left Censor-in-chief; Guo Shilong was recalled as Huguang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 七月壬子，上駐蹕熱河。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day renzi: the Emperor halted at Rehe.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, the Emperor stayed at Rehe.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，車駕發喀拉河屯，巡幸諸蒙古部落。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, the imperial carriage set out from Karahotun to tour the Mongol tribes.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, the court left Karahotun to tour Mongol tribes.

sentences.zh: 外籓來朝，各賜衣幣。

translations.literal: Outer vassals came to court; each was granted robes and silks.
translations.idiomatic: Border vassals came to court and received robes and silks.

sentences.zh: 八月甲辰，次洮爾畢拉，賜迎駕索倫總管塞音察克、杜拉圖及打牲人銀幣。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiachen: the court halted at Tao'erbila; Supervisor Sengge Chaq and Dulatu of the Solon who welcomed the carriage, and hunters, were granted silver coins.
translations.idiomatic: At Tao'erbila, Solon leaders and hunters who welcomed the tour received silver.

sentences.zh: 貴州三江苗人作亂，討平之。

translations.literal: Miao of Sanjiang in Guizhou rebelled; they were suppressed and pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Guizhou Sanjiang Miao rebels were suppressed.

sentences.zh: 九月癸亥，上駐和爾博圖噶岔。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day guihai: the Emperor halted at He'erbotu Gacha.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, the Emperor halted at He'erbotu Gacha.

sentences.zh: 甲子，閱察哈爾、巴爾虎兵丁射。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Chakhar and Barhu troops were reviewed in archery.
translations.idiomatic: Chakhar and Barhu troops held an archery review.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛巳，以江蘇、浙江旱，發帑市米平糶，截漕放賑，免逋賦。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day xinsi: because Jiangsu and Zhejiang suffered drought, treasury funds were issued to buy grain for price-stabilizing sale, grain transport was diverted for relief, and overdue taxes were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Drought in Jiangsu and Zhejiang brought treasury grain sales, diverted transport grain for relief, and tax remissions.

sentences.zh: 外籓獻駝馬，卻之。

translations.literal: Outer vassals presented camels and horses; these were declined.
translations.idiomatic: Vassal gifts of camels and horses were refused.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，上還京。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 己亥，戶部議增雲南礦稅，命如舊額。

translations.literal: On day jihai, the Ministry of Revenue proposed increasing Yunnan mining tax; the order was to keep the old quota.
translations.idiomatic: A proposal to raise Yunnan mining tax was rejected; the old quota stood.

sentences.zh: 庚子，金世榮免，以蕭永藻為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Jin Shirong was dismissed; Xiao Yongzao was made Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: Jin Shirong left office; Xiao Yongzao became Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 十一月己酉朔，詔曰：「頃以江、浙旱災，隨命減稅、蠲逋、截漕。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, first day jiwei: an edict said: "Lately, because of drought disaster in Jiangsu and Zhejiang, We at once ordered tax reduction, remission of arrears, and diversion of transport grain.
translations.idiomatic: An edict noted recent Jiangsu and Zhejiang drought relief: tax cuts, arrears remitted, transport grain diverted.

sentences.zh: 其江、浙兩省明年應出丁錢，悉予蠲免。

translations.literal: The poll-tax money due next year from both Jiangsu and Zhejiang provinces is entirely remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Next year's poll tax in both provinces was fully remitted.

sentences.zh: 被災之處，並免正賦。

translations.literal: In disaster areas, the regular land tax is also remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Regular land tax was also remitted in affected districts.

sentences.zh: 使一年之內，小民絕跡公庭，優遊作息，副朕惠愛黎元至意。

translations.literal: So that within one year common people never appear at government yamens and may rest at ease—fulfilling Our intent of showing favor and love to the black-haired people."
translations.idiomatic: The aim was for commoners to avoid yamens and rest easy for a year."

sentences.zh: 」己未，詔台灣客民乏食，原歸者聽附公務船內渡。

translations.literal: An edict said that Taiwan sojourners lacking food who wished to return home might cross on official vessels.
translations.idiomatic: Taiwan settlers without food could return home on official ships.

sentences.zh: 以汪悟禮為漢軍都統。

translations.literal: Wang Wuli was made Han commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Wuli became Han commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 己亥，詔江、浙諸郡縣興修水利備旱澇。

translations.literal: On day jihai, an edict ordered Jiangsu and Zhejiang prefectures and counties to repair waterworks against drought and flood.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangsu and Zhejiang were ordered to repair waterworks against drought and flood.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙戌，以溫達為大學士，馬爾漢為吏部尚書，耿額為兵部尚書，巢可託為刑部尚書，富寧安、王九齡為左都御史。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day bingxu: Wenda was made Grand Secretary, Ma'erhan Minister of Personnel, Geng'e Minister of War, Chao Ketuo Minister of Punishments, and Fu Ning'an and Wang Jiuling Censors-in-chief of the Left.
translations.idiomatic: Wenda, Ma'erhan, Geng'e, Chao Ketuo, Fu Ning'an, and Wang Jiuling received high appointments.

sentences.zh: 丙午，賜親王以次內大臣、侍衛白金有差。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, princes, inner ministers from the rank of prince downward, and guards were granted silver in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Princes, inner ministers, and guards received graded silver gifts.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸、江南、江西、福建、湖廣等省三十二州縣衛災賦有差。

translations.literal: This year, disaster land tax for thirty-two prefectures, counties, and garrisons in Zhili, Jiangnan, Jiangxi, Fujian, Huguang, and other provinces was remitted in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Tax relief was granted for thirty-two disaster districts across several provinces.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、琉球入貢。

translations.literal: Korea and Ryukyu sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea and Ryukyu paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 四十七年戊子春正月庚午，浙江大嵐山賊張念一、朱三等行劫慈谿、上虞、嵊縣，官兵捕平之。

translations.literal: Forty-seventh year, spring, first month, day gengwu: bandits Zhang Nianyi, Zhu San, and others of Great Lanshan in Zhejiang raided Cixi, Shangyu, and Sheng counties; government troops captured and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-seventh year, Lanshan bandits Zhang Nianyi and Zhu San raided Zhejiang counties and were suppressed.

sentences.zh: 辛未，重修南嶽廟成，御制碑文。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, reconstruction of the Southern Sacred Peak temple was completed; the Emperor composed the stele text.
translations.idiomatic: The Southern Peak temple restoration was finished with an imperial inscription.

sentences.zh: 以覺羅孟俄洛為奉天將軍。

translations.literal: Aisin Gioro Meng'eluo was made general at Fengtian.
translations.idiomatic: Aisin Gioro Meng'eluo became Fengtian general.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，詔截留湖廣、江西漕糧四十萬石，留於江南六府平糶。

translations.literal: On day yihai, an edict ordered that four hundred thousand shi of transport grain from Huguang and Jiangxi be held back and kept in six Jiangnan prefectures for price-stabilizing sale.
translations.idiomatic: Four hundred thousand shi of Huguang and Jiangxi grain were held in six Jiangnan prefectures for relief sales.

sentences.zh: 二月庚寅，上御經筵。

translations.literal: Second month, day gengyin: the Emperor attended the Classics lecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, the Emperor held the Classics lecture.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，遣侍郎穆丹按大嵐山獄，學士二鬲按紅苗獄。

translations.literal: On day renchen, Vice Minister Mu Dan was sent to investigate the Great Lanshan case; Academician Erge the Red Miao case.
translations.idiomatic: Mu Dan was sent to investigate the Lanshan case; Erge the Red Miao case.

sentences.zh: 甲午，上巡畿甸。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, the Emperor toured the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, the Emperor toured the capital region.

sentences.zh: 丙午，詔暹羅使臣挈帶土貨，許隨處貿易，免徵其稅。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, an edict said that Siamese envoys bringing native goods might trade wherever they went, exempt from tax.
translations.idiomatic: Siamese envoys might trade local goods tax-free wherever they traveled.

sentences.zh: 三月丙辰，上還駐申昜春園。

translations.literal: Third month, day bingchen: the Emperor returned and halted at the Shenyang Spring Garden.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, the Emperor returned to the Shenyang Spring Garden.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以希思哈、李繩宗為漢軍都統。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, Xisiha and Li Shengxun were made Han commanders-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Xisiha and Li Shengxun became Han commanders-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 閏三月戊寅朔，重修北鎮廟成，御制碑文。

translations.literal: Intercalary third month, first day wuyin: reconstruction of the Northern Peak temple was completed; the Emperor composed the stele text.
translations.idiomatic: The Northern Peak temple restoration was finished with an imperial inscription.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以施世驃為廣東提督，席柱為西安將軍。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Shi Shibiao was made provincial commander of Guangdong and Xi Zhu general at Xi'an.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Shibiao became Guangdong commander; Xi Zhu became Xi'an general.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己酉，宋犖罷，以徐潮為吏部尚書，以齊世武為四川陝西總督。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jiyou: Song Luo was dismissed; Xu Chao was made Minister of Personnel and Qi Shiwu governor-general of Sichuan and Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Song Luo left office; Xu Chao became Minister of Personnel and Qi Shiwu Sichuan-Shaanxi governor-general.

sentences.zh: 戊午，山東巡撫趙世顯報捕獲朱三父子，解往浙江。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, Shandong Governor Zhao Shixian reported capturing Zhu San and his sons; they were sent under escort to Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Shandong reported Zhu San and his sons captured and sent to Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「朱三父子遊行教書，寄食人家。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "Zhu San and his sons roam teaching; they lodge and eat at others' homes.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said Zhu San's family were itinerant teachers living on hospitality.

sentences.zh: 若因此捕拿，株連太多，可傳諭知之。

translations.literal: If people are seized for this, too many will be implicated by association—transmit this instruction so all know."
translations.idiomatic: He warned against sweeping arrests that would implicate too many innocents."

sentences.zh: 」辛酉，湖廣提督俞益謨密請剿除紅苗。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Huguang provincial commander Yu Yimou secretly requested extermination of the Red Miao.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Yimou secretly asked to exterminate the Red Miao.

sentences.zh: 上以紅苗無大罪，不許。

translations.literal: The Emperor, because the Red Miao had committed no great crime, did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor refused, as the Red Miao had not committed major crimes.

sentences.zh: 以阿喇衲為蒙古都統，李林盛為漢軍都統。

translations.literal: Alana was made Mongol commander-in-chief; Li Linsheng Han commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Alana became Mongol commander-in-chief; Li Linsheng Han commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 內大臣明珠卒，命皇三子胤祉奠茶酒，賜馬四匹。

translations.literal: Inner minister Mingzhu died; the third imperial son Yin Zhi was ordered to offer libations; four horses were granted.
translations.idiomatic: Minister Mingzhu died; Prince Yin Zhi offered libations and four horses were granted.

sentences.zh: 五月甲申，以王鴻緒為戶部尚書，富寧安為禮部尚書，穆和倫為左都御史。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jiashen: Wang Hongxu was made Minister of Revenue, Fu Ning'an Minister of Rites, and Mu Helun Censor-in-chief of the Left.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Hongxu, Fu Ning'an, and Mu Helun received ministerial appointments.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，上巡幸塞外。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, the Emperor toured beyond the passes.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, the Emperor toured the frontier.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔免大嵐山賊黨太倉人王昭駿伯叔兄弟連坐罪。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, an edict remitted the guilt-by-association punishment for Wang Zhaojun of Taicang and his uncles and brothers, associates of the Great Lanshan bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Guilt-by-association for Wang Zhaojun's kin in the Lanshan case was remitted.

sentences.zh: 六月丁未，上駐蹕熱河。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day dingwei: the Emperor halted at Rehe.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, the Emperor stayed at Rehe.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，九卿議覆大嵐山獄上，得旨：「誅其首惡者，朱三父子不可宥，緣坐可改流徙。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, the Nine Ministers reported on the Great Lanshan case and received the rescript: "Execute the chief culprits; Zhu San and his sons cannot be pardoned; those implicated by association may be changed to exile.
translations.idiomatic: The Lanshan case verdict: execute ringleaders; Zhu San family not pardoned; associates exiled instead.

sentences.zh: 巡撫王然、提督王世臣俱留任，受傷官兵俱議敘。

translations.literal: Governor Wang Ran and provincial commander Wang Shichen are both retained in office; wounded officers and soldiers are all to receive commendation in the records."
translations.idiomatic: Governor Wang Ran and Commander Wang Shichen kept their posts; wounded troops were to be honored."

sentences.zh: 」丁卯，清文鑒成，上制序文。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, the Manchu literary mirror was completed; the Emperor composed the preface.
translations.idiomatic: The Manchu literary mirror was completed with an imperial preface.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁丑，諭刑部，免死流人在配犯罪者按誅之。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day dingchou: the Ministry of Punishments was instructed that exiles who had been spared death but committed crimes while serving sentence are to be punished according to capital law.
translations.idiomatic: Exiles spared death who reoffended while serving sentence were to face capital punishment.

sentences.zh: 癸未，平定朔漠方略成，上親制序文。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, the strategic account of pacifying the northern deserts was completed; the Emperor personally composed the preface.
translations.idiomatic: The northern desert pacification record was completed with an imperial preface.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，上行圍。

translations.literal: On day renchen, the Emperor went on the hunting encirclement.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, the Emperor went hunting.

sentences.zh: 二鬲奏按紅苗殺人之廖老宰等斬梟，擅自遣兵前往苗寨之守備王應瑞遣戍，從之。

translations.literal: Erge reported on the Red Miao case: Liao Laozai and others who killed people were beheaded and exposed; Garrison Commander Wang Yingrui, who had sent troops to Miao stockades on his own authority, was sent into exile—these were approved.
translations.idiomatic: Erge's Red Miao verdict: Liao Laozai executed; Commander Wang Yingrui exiled for unauthorized troop deployment.

sentences.zh: 八月甲辰朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Eighth month, first day jiachen: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first of the eighth month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，上迴鑾，駐永安拜昂阿。

translations.literal: On day renxu, the Emperor returned from the tour and halted at Yong'an Bai'ang'a.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, the Emperor returned and halted at Yong'an Bai'ang'a.

sentences.zh: 九月乙亥，上駐布爾哈蘇台。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day yihai: the Emperor halted at Burha Sutai.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, the Emperor halted at Burha Sutai.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，召集廷臣行宮，宣示皇太子胤礽罪狀，命拘執之，送京幽禁。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, court ministers were summoned to the traveling palace; the crimes of Crown Prince Yinreng were proclaimed; he was ordered seized and sent to the capital for close confinement.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers were summoned; Crown Prince Yinreng's crimes were proclaimed; he was seized and sent to Beijing for confinement.

sentences.zh: 己丑，上還京。

translations.literal: On day jichou, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，廢皇太子胤礽，頒示天下。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Crown Prince Yinreng was deposed; this was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Crown Prince Yinreng was deposed and the decree published empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲辰，削貝勒胤禩爵。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day jiachen: Beile Yin Zhen's title was stripped.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Beile Yin Zhen was stripped of his rank.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以王掞為工部尚書，張鵬翮為刑部尚書。

translations.literal: On day yimao, Wang Yan was made Minister of Works and Zhang Pengge Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yan became Minister of Works; Zhang Pengge Minister of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，上幸南苑行圍。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, the Emperor went to the Southern Park for the hunting encirclement.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, the Emperor hunted at the Southern Park.

sentences.zh: 以辛泰為蒙古都統。

translations.literal: Xintai was appointed Mongol commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Xintai became Mongol commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸酉朔，削直郡王胤禔爵，幽之。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, first day guiyou: Prince of the First Rank Yin Zhen was stripped of his title and confined.
translations.idiomatic: On the first of the eleventh month, Prince of the First Rank Yin Zhen was stripped of rank and imprisoned.

sentences.zh: 己卯，致仕大學士張英卒，予祭葬，諡文端。

translations.literal: On day jimao, the retired Grand Secretary Zhang Ying died; sacrificial rites and burial honors were granted, posthumous title Wenduan.
translations.idiomatic: Retired Grand Secretary Zhang Ying died and received posthumous name Wenduan.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，副都御史勞之辨奏保廢太子，奪職杖之。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, Vice Censor-in-chief Lao Zhibian memorialized to restore the deposed Crown Prince; he was dismissed from office and beaten with the rod.
translations.idiomatic: Lao Zhibian urged restoring the deposed Crown Prince; he was dismissed and flogged.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，召集廷臣議建儲貳。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, court ministers were summoned to deliberate on establishing an heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, ministers were summoned to debate naming an heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 阿靈阿、鄂倫岱、揆敘、王鴻緒及諸大臣以皇八子胤禩請，上不可。

translations.literal: Aling'a, Elundai, Kuaixu, Wang Hongxu, and other high ministers asked on behalf of the eighth imperial son Yinsi; the Emperor would not agree.
translations.idiomatic: Aling'a, Elundai, Kuaixu, Wang Hongxu, and others urged Yinsi as heir; the Emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 戊子，釋廢太子胤礽。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, the deposed Crown Prince Yinreng was released.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, the deposed Crown Prince Yinreng was freed from confinement.

sentences.zh: 己丑，王大臣請復立胤礽為皇太子。

translations.literal: On day jichou, princes and high ministers asked that Yinreng be reinstalled as Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, princes and ministers asked to restore Yinreng as Crown Prince.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以宗室發度為黑龍江將軍。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, the clansman Fadu was made general of Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Fadu of the imperial clan became Heilongjiang general.

sentences.zh: 庚子，復胤禩貝勒。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Yinsi was restored as beile.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Yinsi was restored to beile rank.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲辰，褒恤死難生員嵇永仁、王龍光、沈天成、范承譜，附祀范承謨祠，承謨子巡撫范時崇請之也。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiachen: the student martyrs Ji Yongren, Wang Longguang, Shen Tiancheng, and Fan Chengpu were posthumously honored; they were granted collateral sacrifice at Fan Chengmou's shrine at the request of Chengmou's son, Governor Fan Shichong.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, martyred students Ji Yongren and others were honored with collateral sacrifice at Fan Chengmou's shrine on Governor Fan Shichong's petition.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以陳詵為湖廣巡撫，蔣陳錫為山東巡撫，黃秉中為浙江巡撫，劉廕樞為貴州巡撫。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, Chen Shuo was made governor of Huguang, Jiang Chenxi governor of Shandong, Huang Bingzhong governor of Zhejiang, and Liu Yinshu governor of Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Shuo, Jiang Chenxi, Huang Bingzhong, and Liu Yinshu were appointed provincial governors.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免山東、福建、湖廣等省六十州縣災賦有差。

translations.literal: This year, disaster land tax for sixty prefectures and counties in Shandong, Fujian, Huguang, and other provinces was remitted in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Tax relief was granted for disaster areas in sixty districts across Shandong, Fujian, Huguang, and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮入貢。

translations.literal: Korea sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 四十八年己丑春正月癸巳，召集廷臣問舉立胤禩，孰為倡議者。

translations.literal: Forty-eighth year, spring, first month, day guisi: court ministers were summoned and asked who had initiated the proposal to install Yinsi as heir.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-eighth year, on the first day of spring, ministers were asked who had led the move to make Yinsi heir.

sentences.zh: 群臣皇恐莫敢對，乃進大學士張玉書而問之，對曰：「先聞之馬齊。

translations.literal: The ministers were terrified and dared not answer; the Grand Secretary Zhang Yushu was brought forward and questioned; he replied: "I first heard of it from Ma Qi.
translations.idiomatic: Terrified ministers were silent until Zhang Yushu was questioned; he said, "I first heard it from Ma Qi.

sentences.zh: 」上切責之。

translations.literal: " The Emperor sharply reprimanded him.
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor sharply rebuked him.

sentences.zh: 次日，列馬齊罪狀，宥死拘禁。

translations.literal: The next day Ma Qi's crimes were listed; he was spared death but imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: The next day Ma Qi was spared execution but imprisoned.

sentences.zh: 已而上徐察其誣，釋之。

translations.literal: Later the Emperor slowly examined the case and found it false, and released him.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor later found the charge false and released Ma Qi.

sentences.zh: 丙申，上幸南苑。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, the Emperor visited the Southern Park.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, the Emperor visited the Southern Park.

sentences.zh: 己亥，命侍郎赫壽駐藏，協辦藏事。

translations.literal: On day jihai, Vice Minister He Shou was ordered to be stationed in Tibet to assist in Tibetan affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He Shou was posted to Tibet to assist in frontier affairs.

sentences.zh: 初拉藏汗與青海爭立達賴喇嘛，不決，特命大臣往監臨之。

translations.literal: Earlier Lhabzang Khan and Qinghai had disputed the installation of the Dalai Lama without resolution; a minister was specially ordered to go and supervise.
translations.idiomatic: Lhabzang Khan and Qinghai had disputed the Dalai Lama's succession; the court sent a minister to supervise.

sentences.zh: 王鴻緒、李振裕免。

translations.literal: Wang Hongxu and Li Zhenyu were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Hongxu and Li Zhenyu left office.

sentences.zh: 二月己酉，上巡幸畿甸。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiyou: the Emperor toured the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, the Emperor toured the capital region.

sentences.zh: 以宗室楊福為黑龍江將軍，覺羅孟俄洛為寧古塔將軍，王文義為貴州提督。

translations.literal: The clansman Yang Fu was made general of Heilongjiang, Aisin Gioro Meng'eluo general of Ningguta, and Wang Wenyi provincial commander of Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Fu, Meng'eluo, and Wang Wenyi received frontier military appointments.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以嵩祝署奉天將軍。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, Songzhu was made acting general of Fengtian.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, Songzhu became acting Fengtian general.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，上還宮。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, the Emperor returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, the Emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以張鵬翮為戶部尚書，張廷樞為刑部尚書。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, Zhang Pengge was made Minister of Revenue and Zhang Tinglu Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Pengge became Minister of Revenue; Zhang Tinglu Minister of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 三月辛巳，復立胤礽為皇太子，昭告宗廟，頒詔天下。

translations.literal: Third month, day xinsi: Yinreng was reinstalled as Crown Prince; the ancestral temples were notified and an edict promulgated throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, Yinreng was restored as Crown Prince with empire-wide proclamation.

sentences.zh: 甲午，賜趙熊詔等二百九十二人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, Zhao Xiongzhao and two hundred ninety-two others were granted jinshi and other ranks with distinctions.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Xiongzhao and 292 others received jinshi degrees.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲辰，以富寧安為吏部尚書，穆和倫為禮部尚書，穆丹為左都御史。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jiachen: Funing'an was made Minister of Personnel, Mu Helun Minister of Rites, and Mu Dan Censor-in-chief of the Left.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Funing'an, Mu Helun, and Mu Dan received high appointments.

sentences.zh: 移禁胤禔於公所，遣官率兵監守。

translations.literal: Yin Zhen was moved to confinement in a public office; officials were sent with troops to guard him.
translations.idiomatic: Yin Zhen was confined under guard in a public office.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，上巡幸塞外。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, the Emperor toured beyond the passes.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, the Emperor toured the frontier.

sentences.zh: 五月甲戌，上駐蹕熱河。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jiaxu: the court halted at Rehe.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, the entourage stopped at Rehe.

sentences.zh: 六月戊午，康親王椿泰薨，諡曰悼，子崇安襲封。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day wuwu: Prince Kang Chuntai died; posthumous title Dao; his son Chong'an succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Kang Chuntai died; posthumous name Dao; his son Chong'an inherited the title.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚寅，以殷泰為四川陝西總督，噶禮為江南江西總督，江琦為甘肅提督，師懿德為江南提督。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day gengyin: Yin Tai was made governor-general of Sichuan and Shaanxi, Ge Li governor-general of Jiangnan and Jiangxi, Jiang Qi provincial commander of Gansu, and Shi Yide provincial commander of Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: Yin Tai, Ge Li, Jiang Qi, and Shi Yide received frontier and southern appointments.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，上行圍。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, the Emperor went on the hunting encirclement.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, the Emperor went hunting.

sentences.zh: 八月己亥朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Eighth month, first day jihai: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first of the eighth month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 加陝西提督潘育龍鎮綏將軍。

translations.literal: Pan Yulong, provincial commander of Shaanxi, was given the additional title Pacification General.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi commander Pan Yulong was made Pacification General.

sentences.zh: 九月庚寅，上還京。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day gengyin: the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 以年羹堯為四川巡撫。

translations.literal: Nian Gengyao was made governor of Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Nian Gengyao became Sichuan governor.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬寅，詔福建、廣東督撫保舉深諳水性熟知水師者。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day renyin: an edict ordered the governors-general and governors of Fujian and Guangdong to recommend men deeply versed in watercraft and thoroughly acquainted with naval forces.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Fujian and Guangdong authorities were ordered to recommend skilled naval officers.

sentences.zh: 戊午，冊封皇三子胤祉誠親王，皇四子胤禛雍親王，皇五子胤祺恆親王，皇七子胤祐淳郡王，皇十子胤蓪敦郡王，皇九子胤禟、皇十二子胤祹、皇十四子胤禵俱為貝勒。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, the third imperial son Yin Zhi was enfeoffed as Prince Cheng, the fourth son Yinzhen as Prince Yong, the fifth son Yinqi as Prince Heng, the seventh son Yinyou as Prince Chun of the Commandery, the tenth son Yin'e as Prince Dun of the Commandery, and the ninth son Yintang, twelfth son Yinti, and fourteenth son Yinti—all as beile.
translations.idiomatic: Yin Zhi, Yinzhen, Yinqi, Yinyou, and Yin'e received princely ranks; Yintang, Yinti, and Yinti were made beile.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，詔免江蘇被災之淮、揚、徐，山東之兗州，河南之歸德明年地丁額賦。

translations.literal: On day renxu, an edict remitted next year's land-and-poll tax quotas for the Huai, Yang, and Xu districts of disaster-struck Jiangsu, Yanzhou in Shandong, and Guide in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Tax quotas were remitted for disaster areas in Jiangsu, Shandong, and Henan.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙子，詔各省解部之款過多，可酌量截留，以備急需。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day bingzi: an edict said that remittances sent from the provinces to the central treasury were excessive and might be retained in part as local reserve for urgent needs.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, provinces were allowed to retain part of central remittances for emergencies.

sentences.zh: 安郡王馬爾渾薨，諡曰愨，子華颺襲。

translations.literal: Prince of the Commandery Ma'erhun died; posthumous title Que; his son Huayang succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of the Commandery Ma'erhun died; posthumous name Que; his son Huayang inherited.

sentences.zh: 己卯，加漕運總督桑額太子太保。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Sang'e, director-general of grain transport, was given the additional title Junior Mentor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Grain transport director Sang'e received the title Junior Mentor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，上與大學士李光地論水脉水源，泰、岱諸山自長白山來。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, the Emperor discussed with Grand Secretary Li Guangdi the courses of rivers and their sources, saying that Mount Tai and other peaks derive from the Changbai range.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, the Emperor discussed river sources with Li Guangdi, tracing major mountains to Changbai.

sentences.zh: 泲水伏流，黃河未到積石亦是伏流，蒙古人有書言之甚詳。

translations.literal: The Ji River runs underground; the Yellow River before Jishi also flows underground—Mongols have books describing this in great detail.
translations.idiomatic: He said the Ji and upper Yellow River run underground, as Mongol texts describe in detail.

sentences.zh: 江源亦自崑崙來，至於岷山乃不伏流耳。

translations.literal: The Yangzi's source likewise comes from Kunlun; only at Mount Min does it cease to be subterranean.
translations.idiomatic: The Yangzi too rises from Kunlun and surfaces at Mount Min.

sentences.zh: 遣張鵬翮、噶敏圖按江南宜思恭虧帑獄。

translations.literal: Zhang Pengge and Gamin Tu were ordered to investigate the case of treasury shortfalls by Yisi Gong of Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Pengge and Gamin Tu were sent to investigate Yisi Gong's Jiangnan treasury case.

sentences.zh: 十二月己亥，上謁陵。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jihai: the Emperor paid respects at the imperial tombs.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, the Emperor visited the imperial tombs.

sentences.zh: 己未，上還宮。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, the Emperor returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, the Emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 命馬齊管鄂羅斯貿易事。

translations.literal: Ma Qi was ordered to manage Russo trade affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Qi was put in charge of Russian trade.

sentences.zh: 刑部尚書巢可託免。

translations.literal: Minister of Punishments Chao Ketuo was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Minister Chao Ketuo left office.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸、江蘇、安徽、山東、河南、湖廣等省五十三州縣災賦有差。

translations.literal: This year, disaster land tax for fifty-three prefectures and counties in Zhili, Jiangsu, Anhui, Shandong, Henan, Huguang, and other provinces was remitted in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Tax relief was granted for disaster areas in fifty-three districts across several provinces.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、琉球入貢。

translations.literal: Korea and Ryukyu sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea and Ryukyu paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 四十九年庚寅春正月庚寅，命修滿蒙合璧清文鑒。

translations.literal: Forty-ninth year, spring, first month, day gengyin: orders were issued to compile the Manchu-Mongol bilingual Qing literary mirror.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-ninth year, work began on the Manchu-Mongol Qing literary mirror.

sentences.zh: 二月丁酉，上巡幸五台山。

translations.literal: Second month, day dingyou: the Emperor toured Mount Wutai.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, the Emperor toured Mount Wutai.

sentences.zh: 吏部尚書徐潮乞休，允之。

translations.literal: Minister of Personnel Xu Chao asked to retire; permission was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Personnel Minister Xu Chao retired.

sentences.zh: 三月己巳，上還京。

translations.literal: Third month, day jisi: the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，命編纂字典。

translations.literal: On day yihai, orders were issued to compile the character dictionary.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, compilation of the Kangxi Dictionary was ordered.

sentences.zh: 詔以故大學士李霨嫡孫主事李敏啟擢補太常寺少卿。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that Li Minqi, grandson of the late Grand Secretary Li Wei and a director in office, be specially promoted to Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Li Wei's grandson Li Minqi was promoted to Vice Director of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，敕封西藏胡必爾汗波克塔為六世達賴喇嘛。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, an imperial patent enfeoffed the Tibetan Hubi'er Khan Bokhta as the Sixth Dalai Lama.
translations.idiomatic: Bokhta was enfeoffed as the Sixth Dalai Lama.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，詔免浙江杭、湖二府未完漕米三萬九千餘石。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, an edict remitted more than thirty-nine thousand shi of unpaid transport grain for Hangzhou and Huzhou prefectures in Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Unpaid Zhejiang transport grain for Hang and Hu prefectures was remitted.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙巳，調蕭永藻為吏部尚書，王掞為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day yisi: Xiao Yongzao was transferred to Minister of Personnel and Wang Yan Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Yongzao became Minister of Personnel; Wang Yan Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 五月己酉朔，上巡幸塞外。

translations.literal: Fifth month, first day jiyou: the Emperor toured beyond the passes.
translations.idiomatic: On the first of the fifth month, the Emperor toured the frontier.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，次花峪溝。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, the court halted at Huayugou.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, the entourage stopped at Huayugou.

sentences.zh: 閱吉林、黑龍江官兵。

translations.literal: Troops of Jilin and Heilongjiang were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor reviewed Jilin and Heilongjiang troops.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，上駐蹕熱河。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, the court halted at Rehe.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, the entourage stopped at Rehe.

sentences.zh: 六月己亥，命諸皇子恭迎皇太后至熱河避暑。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jihai: the imperial sons were ordered to escort the Empress Dowager respectfully to Rehe for the summer retreat.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, princes were ordered to bring the Empress Dowager to Rehe.

sentences.zh: 戊午，刑部尚書張廷樞免。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, Minister of Punishments Zhang Tinglu was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Tinglu left the Ministry of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬午，按事湖南尚書蕭永藻等疏報巡撫提督互訐案，查審俱實。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day renwu: investigating affairs in Hunan, Minister Xiao Yongzao and others memorialized on the case of mutual impeachment between the governor and provincial commander; investigation found both charges true.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Yongzao reported a Hunan case in which governor and commander impeached each other; both charges were sustained.

sentences.zh: 得旨：「俞益謨休致，趙申喬革職留任。

translations.literal: The reply received said: "Yu Yimou is to retire; Zhao Shenqiao is dismissed from office but retained on duty.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor ruled that Yu Yimou should retire and Zhao Shenqiao be demoted yet kept on duty.

translations.literal: " (closing quotation mark in the source.)
translations.idiomatic: The edict continued.

sentences.zh: 閏七月甲寅，上行圍。

translations.literal: Intercalary seventh month, day jiayin: the Emperor went on the hunting encirclement.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary seventh month, the Emperor went hunting.

sentences.zh: 八月乙亥，詔福建漳、泉二府旱，運江、浙漕糧三十萬石賑之，並免本年未完額賦。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day yihai: an edict said Zhangzhou and Quanzhou in Fujian suffered drought; three hundred thousand shi of transport grain from Jiangsu and Zhejiang were sent for relief, and this year's unpaid quotas were also remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Drought relief grain was sent to Zhang and Quan in Fujian and local taxes remitted.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，上還駐熱河。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, the Emperor returned and halted at Rehe.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, the Emperor returned to Rehe.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以范時崇為福建浙江總督，額倫特為湖南提督。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Fan Shichong was made governor-general of Fujian and Zhejiang, and Elente provincial commander of Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Shichong became governor-general of Fujian and Zhejiang; Elente Hunan commander.

sentences.zh: 九月辛丑，上奉皇太后還宮。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day xinchou: the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager back to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, the Emperor returned with the Empress Dowager to the palace.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，希福納免。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, Xifuna was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Xifuna left office.

sentences.zh: 時戶部虧蝕購辦草豆銀兩事覺，積十餘年，歷任尚書、侍郎凡百二十人，虧蝕至四十餘萬。

translations.literal: At this time the Ministry of Revenue's deficit in funds for purchasing fodder and beans came to light; accumulated over more than ten years, one hundred twenty former ministers and vice ministers were involved, with losses reaching more than four hundred thousand taels.
translations.idiomatic: A decade-long Ministry of Revenue fodder-purchase deficit involving 120 officials totaled over 400,000 taels.

sentences.zh: 上寬免逮問，責限償完，希福納現任尚書，特斥之。

translations.literal: The Emperor waived prosecution, ordered repayment within a time limit, and especially dismissed Xifuna, then serving as minister.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor waived arrests but ordered repayment and dismissed serving Minister Xifuna.

sentences.zh: 以穆和倫為戶部尚書，貝和諾為禮部尚書。

translations.literal: Mu Helun was made Minister of Revenue and Bei Henuo Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Mu Helun became Minister of Revenue; Bei Henuo Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲子，詔曰：「朕臨御天下垂五十年，誠念民為邦本，政在養民。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day jiazi: an edict said: "We have ruled the realm for nearly fifty years, truly holding that the people are the foundation of the state and that government lies in nourishing the people.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, the Emperor issued an edict on fifty years of rule and care for the people.

sentences.zh: 迭次蠲租數萬萬，以節儉之所餘，為渙解之弘澤。

translations.literal: Time and again We have remitted taxes by tens of millions, using what frugality has saved to spread broad relief.
translations.idiomatic: He had repeatedly remitted tens of millions in taxes from imperial frugality.

sentences.zh: 惟體察民生，未盡康阜，良由生齒日繁，地不加益。

translations.literal: Yet observing the people's livelihood, prosperity is not yet complete—truly because population daily grows while land does not increase.
translations.idiomatic: Population growth outpaced land, he said, so prosperity was still incomplete.

sentences.zh: 宜沛鴻施，藉培民力。

translations.literal: It is fitting to pour forth great grace and thereby strengthen the people's strength.
translations.idiomatic: He would grant great grace to strengthen the people.

sentences.zh: 自康熙五十年始，普免天下錢糧，三年而遍。

translations.literal: Beginning in the fiftieth year of Kangxi, land-and-poll taxes throughout the realm are to be universally remitted, the cycle completing in three years.
translations.idiomatic: From Kangxi year 50, a three-year empire-wide land-tax remission would begin.

sentences.zh: 直隸、奉天、浙江、福建、廣東、廣西、四川、雲南、貴州九省地丁錢糧，察明全免。

translations.literal: For Zhili, Fengtian, Zhejiang, Fujian, Guangdong, Guangxi, Sichuan, Yunnan, and Guizhou—the nine provinces' land-and-poll taxes are to be investigated and wholly remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Nine provinces would have land taxes wholly remitted after investigation.

sentences.zh: 歷年逋賦，一體豁除。

translations.literal: Arrears accumulated over years are to be forgiven in one act.
translations.idiomatic: All arrears would be forgiven at once.

sentences.zh: 其五十一年、五十二年應蠲省分，屆時候旨。

translations.literal: As for provinces to be remitted in the fifty-first and fifty-second years, await Our order when the time comes.
translations.idiomatic: Other provinces would follow in years 51 and 52 as ordered.

sentences.zh: 地方大吏以及守令當體朕保乂之懷，實心愛養，庶幾昇平樂利有可徵矣。

translations.literal: Local governors and prefects must enter into Our mind of protecting the people, sincerely loving and nurturing them, so that ascending peace and shared benefit may truly be seen.
translations.idiomatic: Officials were urged to nurture the people so peace and prosperity might be real.

sentences.zh: 文到，其刊刻頒布，咸使聞知。

translations.literal: When this text arrives, engrave and promulgate it so that all may hear and know.
translations.idiomatic: The edict was to be carved on stone and published everywhere.

sentences.zh: 」丁卯，諭外籓已朝行在，勿庸朝正。

translations.literal: " On day dingmao, vassal rulers who had already attended court at the traveling palace were told they need not come for the New Year audience.
translations.idiomatic: The edict closed; on dingmao day, vassals at court were excused from the New Year audience.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以郭瑮為雲南貴州總督，以郭世隆為刑部尚書，鄂海為湖廣總督。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, Guo Zhen was made governor-general of Yunnan and Guizhou, Guo Shilong Minister of Punishments, and Ehai governor-general of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Zhen, Guo Shilong, and Ehai received high appointments.

sentences.zh: 癸未，諭大學士：「江南虧空錢糧多至數十萬兩，此或朕數次南巡，地方挪用。

translations.literal: On day guimao, the Grand Secretaries were instructed: "Jiangnan treasury shortfalls reach hundreds of thousands of taels—this may be because on Our several southern tours local funds were diverted.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, the Emperor told Grand Secretaries Jiangnan deficits might reflect costs of his southern tours.

sentences.zh: 張鵬翮謂俸工可以抵補。

translations.literal: Zhang Pengge says salary and labor allotments can be used to make up the deficit.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Pengge proposed covering deficits with salary and labor funds.

sentences.zh: 牧令無俸，仍以累民，莫若免之為善。

translations.literal: District magistrates have no salary, yet the burden still falls on the people—better to remit it entirely.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said magistrates had no salary and burdened the people; full remission was better.

sentences.zh: 其會議以聞。

translations.literal: Deliberate and memorialize."
translations.idiomatic: He ordered the matter discussed and reported."

translations.literal: " (closing quotation mark in the source.)
translations.idiomatic: The edict closed.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛卯朔，詔凡遇蠲賦之年，免業主七分，佃戶三分，著為令。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, first day of the month on day xinmao: an edict ordered that in years when land tax was remitted, landowners were exempted seven-tenths and tenant farmers three-tenths; this was established as a regulation.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the new moon of xinmao day, an edict fixed tax relief at seventy percent for landowners and thirty percent for tenants whenever levies were remitted.

sentences.zh: 大學士陳廷敬以老乞休，溫旨慰諭，命致仕。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Chen Tingjing asked to retire on account of age; a gracious edict comforted him, and he was ordered to leave office.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretary Chen Tingjing retired on account of age after a gracious imperial message.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，上謁陵。

translations.literal: On day yisi, the Emperor visited the imperial tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, the Emperor visited the tombs.

sentences.zh: 以蕭永藻為大學士，王掞為禮部尚書，徐元正為工部尚書。

translations.literal: Xiao Yongzao was made Grand Secretary, Wang Yan Minister of Rites, and Xu Yuanzheng Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Yongzao became Grand Secretary; Wang Yan Minister of Rites; Xu Yuanzheng Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以孫徵灝為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, Sun Zhenghao was made Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, Sun Zhenghao became Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以桑額為吏部尚書。

translations.literal: On day yimao, Sang'e was made Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, Sang'e became Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸酉，以赫壽為漕運總督。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day guiyou: He Shou was made grain-transport governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, He Shou was appointed grain-transport governor-general.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，上還京。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，詔曰：「朕因朝列舊臣漸次衰謝，順治年間進士去職在籍者，已無多人。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, an edict said: "Because the old ministers of the court are gradually passing away, those from the Shunzhi-era jinshi who left office and remain in their native places are now few.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, an edict said that few Shunzhi-era jinshi who had retired to their home districts still survived among the court's senior ministers.

sentences.zh: 王士禛、江皋、周敏政、葉矯然、徐淑嘉皆以公過屏廢，俱復還原官。

translations.literal: Wang Shizhen, Jiang Gao, Zhou Minzheng, Ye Jiaoran, and Xu Shujia had all been dismissed for minor offenses and were now all restored to their original offices.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Shizhen, Jiang Gao, Zhou Minzheng, Ye Jiaoran, and Xu Shujia, all earlier dismissed for minor faults, were restored to their former ranks.

sentences.zh: 」以趙申喬為左都御史。

translations.literal: " Zhao Shenqiao was made Censor-in-chief of the Left.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Shenqiao became Censor-in-chief of the Left.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸、江南等省七州縣災賦有差。

translations.literal: This year, disaster land tax for seven prefectures and counties in Zhili, Jiangnan, and other provinces was remitted in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Tax relief was granted for disaster areas in Zhili, Jiangnan, and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、安南入貢。

translations.literal: Korea and Annan sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea and Annan paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 五十年辛卯春正月癸丑，上巡畿甸，視通州河堤。

translations.literal: Fiftieth year, spring, first month, day guichou: the Emperor toured the capital region and inspected the Tongzhou river dikes.
translations.idiomatic: In the fiftieth year, on guichou day in the first month, the Emperor toured the capital region and inspected Tongzhou's river works.

sentences.zh: 二月辛酉，以班迪為滿洲都統，善丹為蒙古都統。

translations.literal: Second month, day xinyou: Bandi was made Manchu commander-in-chief and Shandan Mongol commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, Bandi became Manchu commander-in-chief and Shandan Mongol commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，閱筐兒港，命建挑水壩。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, the Emperor inspected Kuang'er Harbor and ordered construction of a water-lifting dam.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, the Emperor inspected Kuang'er Harbor and ordered a water-lifting dam built.

sentences.zh: 次河西務，上登岸步行二里許，親置儀器，定方向，釘椿木，以紀丈量之處。

translations.literal: Next at Hexiwu, the Emperor went ashore and walked more than two li, personally set instruments, fixed the direction, and nailed marker stakes to record the points of survey.
translations.idiomatic: At Hexiwu he went ashore, walked two li, set surveying instruments, fixed the direction, and drove marker stakes for the survey.

sentences.zh: 諭曰：「用此法可以測量天地、日月交食。

translations.literal: He instructed: "With this method one can measure heaven and earth and solar and lunar eclipses.
translations.idiomatic: He said this method could measure heaven and earth and predict eclipses.

sentences.zh: 算法原於易。

translations.literal: Calculation originates in the Changes.
translations.idiomatic: Calculation, he said, originated in the Book of Changes.

sentences.zh: 用七九之奇數，不能盡者，用十二、二十四之偶數，乃能盡之，即取象十二時、二十四氣也。

translations.literal: When the odd numbers seven and nine cannot exhaust all cases, use the even numbers twelve and twenty-four to exhaust them—that is, taking the image of the twelve hours and twenty-four seasonal nodes."
translations.idiomatic: Where seven and nine could not suffice, twelve and twenty-four completed the reckoning, matching the twelve hours and twenty-four qi.

sentences.zh: 」庚午，上還京。

translations.literal: " On day gengwu, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，上御經筵。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, the Emperor attended the Classics lecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, the Emperor held the Classics lecture.

sentences.zh: 三月庚寅，王大臣以萬壽節請上尊號。

translations.literal: Third month, day gengyin: Wang Dachen and others asked that an honorific title be conferred for the longevity festival.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, Wang Dachen and others sought an honorific title for the Emperor's longevity celebration.

sentences.zh: 自平滇以來，至是凡四請矣。

translations.literal: Since the pacification of Yunnan, by now there had been four such requests in all.
translations.idiomatic: Since Yunnan was pacified, this was the fourth such request.

sentences.zh: 上謙挹有素，終不之許。

translations.literal: The Emperor had long been modest by nature and ultimately did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor, modest as ever, again refused.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚申，徐元正養親回籍，以陳詵為工部尚書。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day gengshen: Xu Yuanzheng returned home to care for his parents, and Chen Shi was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Xu Yuanzheng went home to care for his parents and Chen Shi became Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，上奉皇太后避暑熱河。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager to Rehe for the summer.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager to Rehe.

sentences.zh: 乙未，命禮部祈雨。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, the Ministry of Rites was ordered to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, the Ministry of Rites was ordered to conduct rain prayers.

sentences.zh: 庚子，大雨。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, there was heavy rain.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, heavy rain fell.

sentences.zh: 丙午，留京大學士張玉書卒，上悼惜，賦詩一篇，遣官治喪，賜銀一千兩，加祭葬，諡文貞。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Beijing Grand Secretary Zhang Yushu died; the Emperor mourned him, composed a poem, sent officers to manage the funeral, granted one thousand taels of silver, added sacrificial burial honors, and gave the posthumous title Wen Zhen.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretary Zhang Yushu died in Beijing; the Emperor mourned him, composed a poem, granted funeral honors and one thousand taels of silver, and gave the posthumous name Wen Zhen.

sentences.zh: 己酉，詔免江蘇無著銀十萬兩有奇。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, an edict remitted more than one hundred thousand taels of Jiangsu unaccounted silver.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Jiangsu was granted remission of over one hundred thousand taels in unaccounted silver.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，召致仕大學士陳廷敬入閣辦事。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, the retired Grand Secretary Chen Tingjing was summoned to enter the Grand Secretariat and handle affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, retired Grand Secretary Chen Tingjing was recalled to the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 增鄉、會試五經中額。

translations.literal: The quota for successful candidates who passed the Five Classics at the provincial and metropolitan examinations was increased.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial and metropolitan examination quotas for Five Classics passers were raised.

sentences.zh: 六月戊辰，設廣西西隆州儒學訓導。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day wuchen: a Confucian school instructor was established for Xilong Prefecture in western Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, a school instructor was established at Xilong Prefecture in Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙辰，上行圍。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day bingchen: the Emperor went on the hunting encirclement.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, the Emperor went hunting.

sentences.zh: 八月庚午，高宗純皇帝生。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day gengwu: the Chun Emperor Gaozong was born.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, the future Qianlong Emperor was born.

sentences.zh: 以王原祁為掌院學士。

translations.literal: Wang Yuanqi was made Academy Chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yuanqi became Academy Chancellor.

sentences.zh: 設先賢子游後裔五經博士。

translations.literal: A Five Classics Doctor was established for a descendant of the sage Ziyou.
translations.idiomatic: A Five Classics doctorate was established for a descendant of Ziyou.

sentences.zh: 九月戊申，上奉皇太后還宮。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day wushen: the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager back to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, the Emperor returned with the Empress Dowager to the palace.

sentences.zh: 藍理有罪免，以楊琳為福建陸路提督，馬際伯為四川提督。

translations.literal: Lan Li was dismissed for crimes; Yang Lin was made Fujian land-route provincial commander, and Ma Jibo Sichuan commander.
translations.idiomatic: Lan Li was dismissed; Yang Lin became Fujian land-route commander and Ma Jibo Sichuan commander.

sentences.zh: 停本年秋決。

translations.literal: Autumn executions for this year were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn executions were halted for the year.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙辰，詔免台灣五十一年應徵稻穀。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day bingchen: an edict remitted the rice levy due from Taiwan for the fifty-first year.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Taiwan's grain levy for the fifty-first year was remitted.

sentences.zh: 貝和諾免，以嵩祝為禮部尚書。

translations.literal: Bei Henuo was dismissed, and Song Zhu was made Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Bei Henuo was dismissed and Song Zhu became Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 戊午，詔前旨普免天下錢糧，五十一年輪及山西、河南、陝西、甘肅、湖北、湖南六省，地丁錢糧及逋欠俱行蠲免。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, an edict said: "By the earlier decree land tax throughout the empire was universally remitted in rotation every three years; the fifty-first year reached Shanxi, Henan, Shaanxi, Gansu, Hubei, and Hunan, and land-poll tax and arrears in those six provinces were all remitted."
translations.idiomatic: An edict extended the empire-wide tax remission rotation to Shanxi, Henan, Shaanxi, Gansu, Hubei, and Hunan, remitting land tax and arrears there.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以碩鼐為滿洲都統，瑚世巴、馬爾賽為蒙古都統。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, Shuonai was made Manchu commander-in-chief, and Hu Shiba and Ma'ersai Mongol commanders-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, Shuonai became Manchu commander-in-chief; Hu Shiba and Ma'ersai Mongol commanders-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，免朝鮮白金豹皮歲貢。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, Korea's annual tribute of white gold and leopard skins was exempted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, Korea was exempted from its annual tribute of silver ingots and leopard skins.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，詔舉孝義。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, an edict ordered recommendation of filial and righteous conduct.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, an edict called for recommending the filial and righteous.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，命張鵬翮置獄揚州，按江南科場案。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, Zhang Penghe was ordered to set up a tribunal at Yangzhou to investigate the Jiangnan examination-hall case.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, Zhang Penghe was sent to Yangzhou to investigate the Jiangnan examination scandal.

sentences.zh: 壬午，鄂繕、耿額、齊世武、悟禮等有罪，褫職拘禁。

translations.literal: On day renwu, E Shan, Geng'e, Qi Shiwu, Wuli, and others were found guilty; their offices were stripped and they were confined.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, E Shan, Geng'e, Qi Shiwu, Wuli, and others were stripped of rank and imprisoned.

sentences.zh: 趙申喬疏劾新科編修戴名世恃才放蕩，語多悖逆，下部嚴審。

translations.literal: Zhao Shenqiao memorialized impeaching the newly appointed compiler Dai Mingshi for arrogant talent and many seditious words; the case was referred to the ministry for strict investigation.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Shenqiao impeached the new compiler Dai Mingshi for arrogant, seditious writings; the ministry was ordered to investigate strictly.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙戌，以殷特布為漢軍都統，隆科多為步軍統領，張谷貞為雲南提督。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day bingxu: Yintebu was made Han Chinese commander-in-chief, Longkedo infantry commander, and Zhang Guzhen Yunnan commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Yintebu became Han commander-in-chief, Longkedo infantry commander, and Zhang Guzhen Yunnan commander.

sentences.zh: 丁未，上謁陵，賜守陵官役馬匹白金。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, the Emperor visited the tombs and granted horses and silver to the tomb-guarding officials and staff.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, the Emperor visited the tombs and rewarded tomb guards with horses and silver.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸酉，上還宮。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day guiyou: the Emperor returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, the Emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 癸未，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, the joint seasonal sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day, the joint seasonal temple sacrifice was held.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸、安徽等省八州縣災賦有差。

translations.literal: This year, disaster land tax for eight prefectures and counties in Zhili, Anhui, and other provinces was remitted in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Tax relief was granted for disaster areas in Zhili, Anhui, and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、琉球入貢。

translations.literal: Korea and Ryukyu sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea and Ryukyu paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 丁戶二千四百六十二萬一千三百二十四，田地六百九十三萬三百四十四頃三十四畝，徵銀二千九百九十萬四千六百五十二兩八錢。

translations.literal: Registered households numbered 24,621,324; cultivated land 6,930,034 qing and 34 mou; collected silver 29,904,652 taels and 8 cash.
translations.idiomatic: The registers recorded 24.6 million households, 6.93 million qing of land, and 29.9 million taels of tax silver.

sentences.zh: 鹽課銀三百七十二萬九千二百二十八兩。

translations.literal: Salt tax silver amounted to 3,729,228 taels.
translations.idiomatic: Salt tax revenue was 3.73 million taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 鑄錢三萬七千四百九十三萬三千四百有奇。

translations.literal: Coins minted totaled more than 373,493,300 strings.
translations.idiomatic: Coinage exceeded 373 million strings.

sentences.zh: 五十一年壬辰春正月丙午，擢編修張逸少為翰林院侍讀學士，故大學士張玉書之子也。

translations.literal: Fifty-first year, spring, first month, day bingwu: Compiler Zhang Yishao was promoted to Hanlin Reader-in-waiting; he was the son of the late Grand Secretary Zhang Yushu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-first year, on bingwu day in the first month, Compiler Zhang Yishao, son of the late Grand Secretary Zhang Yushu, was promoted to Hanlin Reader.

sentences.zh: 壬子，命內外大臣具摺陳事。

translations.literal: On day renzi, inner and outer ministers were ordered to submit folded memorials reporting affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, civil and military ministers were ordered to submit folded memorials.

sentences.zh: 摺奏自此始。

translations.literal: Folded memorial reporting thus began.
translations.idiomatic: This marked the beginning of folded-memorial reporting.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，上巡幸畿甸。

translations.literal: On day guichou, the Emperor toured the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, the Emperor toured the capital region.

sentences.zh: 詔右衛將軍宗室費揚古辦事誠實，供職年久，且系王子，可封為輔國公。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Right Guard General of the imperial clan Feiyanggu has served honestly and long, and as he is a prince's son, he may be enfeoffed as Duke Who Assists the State."
translations.idiomatic: Feiyanggu, an imperial clansman serving as Right Guard General, was enfeoffed as Duke Who Assists the State for honest, long service.

sentences.zh: 二月丁巳，詔宋儒朱子配享孔廟，在十哲之次。

translations.literal: Second month, day dingsi: an edict ordered the Song Neo-Confucian Zhu Xi added to sacrifice in the Confucian temple, placed after the Ten Wise Ones.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, Zhu Xi was ordered enshrined in the Confucian temple after the Ten Wise Ones.

sentences.zh: 江蘇巡撫張伯行與總督噶禮互訐，俱解任，交張鵬翮、赫壽查審。

translations.literal: Jiangsu Governor Zhang Boxing and Governor-General Gali mutually impeached each other; both were dismissed and the case was referred to Zhang Penghe and He Shou for investigation.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Zhang Boxing and Governor-General Gali impeached each other; both were dismissed and Zhang Penghe and He Shou were sent to investigate.

sentences.zh: 福建浙江總督范時崇疏陳沿海漁船，只許單桅，不許越省行走，交地方文武鈐束。

translations.literal: Fujian-Zhejiang Governor-General Fan Shichong memorialized on coastal fishing boats: only single-masted vessels were permitted and they might not travel across provinces; local civil and military officials were to restrain them.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Shichong proposed restricting coastal fishing boats to single masts and confining them to their home provinces under local control.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「此事不可行。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "This measure cannot be carried out.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said the proposal would not do.

sentences.zh: 漁戶併入水師營，則兵弁侵欺之矣。

translations.literal: If fishing households were merged into naval camps, soldiers and officers would bully them.
translations.idiomatic: Merging fishermen into naval camps would invite abuse by officers and troops.

sentences.zh: 盜賊豈能盡除，竊發何地無之？

translations.literal: How can bandits be entirely eliminated? Theft arises everywhere.
translations.idiomatic: Bandits cannot be wholly eradicated; theft occurs everywhere.

sentences.zh: 只視有益於民者行之，不當以文法為捕具也。

translations.literal: Only do what benefits the people; one must not use written law as a snare."
translations.idiomatic: Only measures that truly benefit the people should be adopted; written law must not become a trap."

sentences.zh: 」戊寅，命卓異武官照文職引見。

translations.literal: " On day wuyin, outstanding military officers were ordered presented for audience like civil officials.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, distinguished military officers were presented at court like civil officials.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，上還京。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔曰：「承平日久，生齒日繁。

translations.literal: On day renwu, an edict said: "In long peace the population daily grows.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, an edict noted that in prolonged peace the population kept growing.

sentences.zh: 嗣後滋生戶口，勿庸更出丁錢，即以本年丁數為定額，著為令。

translations.literal: Henceforth for newly registered population do not again levy poll-tax head; use this year's poll count as the fixed quota, and establish this as a regulation."
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth newly registered households would pay no additional poll tax; the current head count would serve as the permanent quota."

translations.literal: " (closing quotation mark in the source.)
translations.idiomatic: The edict closed.

sentences.zh: 三月辛卯，諭大學士：「繙譯本章，甚有關係。

translations.literal: Third month, day xinmao: the Emperor instructed the Grand Secretaries: "Translating memorials is very important.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, the Emperor told the Grand Secretaries that translating memorials was crucial.

sentences.zh: 昨見本內『假官』二字，竟譯作『偽官』，舛錯殊甚。

translations.literal: Yesterday I saw in a text the two characters for 'acting official' rendered as 'false official'—the error is grave.
translations.idiomatic: He had seen 'acting official' mistranslated as 'false official' and called the mistake serious.

sentences.zh: 其嚴飭之。

translations.literal: Strictly admonish this."
translations.idiomatic: He ordered strict correction."

sentences.zh: 」丁酉，上御經筵。

translations.literal: " On day dingyou, the Emperor attended the Classics lecture.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, the Emperor held the Classics lecture.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁巳，賜王世琛等百七十七人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day dingsi: Wang Shichen and one hundred seventy-seven others were granted jinshi and other ranks with distinctions.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Wang Shichen and 177 others received jinshi degrees with distinctions.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以康泰為四川提督。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Kang Tai was made Sichuan commander.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, Kang Tai became Sichuan commander.

sentences.zh: 定會試分省取中例。

translations.literal: The rule for provincial quotas at the metropolitan examination was fixed.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial quotas for the metropolitan examination were fixed.

sentences.zh: 壬申，諭：「故大學士熊賜履夙學舊臣，身歿以後，時軫於懷。

translations.literal: On day renshen, an instruction said: "The late Grand Secretary Xiong Cilü was a scholar of long standing; after his death We often think of him.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, the Emperor recalled the late scholar-minister Xiong Cilü.

sentences.zh: 聞其子已長成，可令來京錄用。

translations.literal: Hearing that his son has grown up, he may be ordered to come to the capital for employment."
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Xiong's grown son summoned to Beijing for appointment."

sentences.zh: 」壬戌，予故一等待衛海青副都統銜，予祭葬，諡果毅。

translations.literal: " On day renxu, the late First-rank Guard Hai Qing was granted the designation of vice censor-in-chief of the Right, sacrificial burial honors were granted, and the posthumous title Guoyi was given.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, the late Guard Hai Qing received vice censor rank, burial honors, and the posthumous name Guoyi.

sentences.zh: 致仕大學士陳廷敬卒，命皇三子奠茶酒，御賦輓詩，命南書房翰林勵廷儀、張廷玉齎焚，予治喪銀一千，諡文貞。

translations.literal: Retired Grand Secretary Chen Tingjing died; the third imperial son was ordered to offer tea and wine, the Emperor composed an elegy, and Hanlin Academicians Li Tingyi and Zhang Tingyu were ordered to deliver it and burn it; one thousand taels of silver were granted for the funeral, and the posthumous title Wen Zhen was given.
translations.idiomatic: Retired Grand Secretary Chen Tingjing died; the third prince offered libations, the Emperor wrote an elegy sent by Li Tingyi and Zhang Tingyu, and he received funeral silver and the posthumous name Wen Zhen.

sentences.zh: 詔明年六旬萬壽，二月特行鄉試，八月會試。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that for the sixtieth-birthday longevity festival next year, a special provincial examination would be held in the second month and a metropolitan examination in the eighth month.
translations.idiomatic: Special provincial and metropolitan examinations were ordered for the Emperor's sixtieth-birthday year.

sentences.zh: 以嵩祝為大學士，黑碩咨為禮部尚書，滿篤為工部尚書，以王掞為大學士，陳詵為禮部尚書，起張廷樞為工部尚書。

translations.literal: Song Zhu was made Grand Secretary, Hei Shuo'e Minister of Rites, Man Du Minister of Works; Wang Yan was made Grand Secretary, Chen Shi Minister of Rites, and Zhang Tingchu was recalled as Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Song Zhu, Hei Shuo'e, Man Du, Wang Yan, Chen Shi, and Zhang Tingchu received new appointments.

sentences.zh: 丙子，上奉皇太后避暑熱河，啟鑾。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager to Rehe for the summer and set out on the journey.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager to Rehe and began the summer journey.

sentences.zh: 壬午，上駐蹕熱河。

translations.literal: On day renwu, the Emperor halted at Rehe.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, the Emperor halted at Rehe.

sentences.zh: 五月壬寅，命有司稽察流民徙邊種地者。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day renyin: officials were ordered to investigate drifting population who planted land on the frontiers.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, officials were ordered to investigate migrants farming on the frontiers.

sentences.zh: 以穆丹為左都御史，鄂代為蒙古都統。

translations.literal: Mu Dan was made Censor-in-chief of the Left, and E'dai Mongol commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Mu Dan became Censor-in-chief of the Left and E'dai Mongol commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 六月癸丑朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Sixth month, first day of the month on day guichou: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the sixth month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，命穆和倫、張廷樞覆按江南督撫互訐案。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, Mu Helun and Zhang Tingchu were ordered to re-investigate the mutual impeachment case between the Jiangnan governor-general and governor.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, Mu Helun and Zhang Tingchu were sent to re-investigate the Zhang Boxing–Gali case.

sentences.zh: 湖廣鎮筸紅苗吳老化率毛都塘等五十二寨內附。

translations.literal: In Huguang, Zhenjiang Red Miao leader Wu Laohua led Maodutang and fifty-two stockades to submit.
translations.idiomatic: Red Miao leader Wu Laohua of Zhenjiang led fifty-two stockades in Huguang to submit.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以張朝午為廣西提督。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Zhang Chaowu was made Guangxi commander.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, Zhang Chaowu became Guangxi commander.

sentences.zh: 秋八月癸丑，上行圍。

translations.literal: Autumn, eighth month, day guichou: the Emperor went on the hunting encirclement.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, the Emperor went hunting.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔朝鮮遇有中國漁船違禁至界汛，許拘執以聞。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, an edict ordered that when Korea encountered Chinese fishing boats violating prohibitions at border patrol posts, they might detain them and report.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, Korea was permitted to detain Chinese fishing boats that violated border rules and report them.

sentences.zh: 鎮筸苗民續內附八十三寨。

translations.literal: At Zhenbian, Miao people continued to submit inward—eighty-three stockades in all.
translations.idiomatic: Eighty-three more Miao stockades at Zhenbian submitted.

sentences.zh: 九月庚戌，上奉皇太后還宮。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day gengxu: the Emperor accompanied the Empress Dowager back to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day in the ninth month, the Emperor returned with the Empress Dowager to the palace.

sentences.zh: 皇太子胤礽復以罪廢，錮於咸安宮。

translations.literal: Crown Prince Yinreng was again deposed for crimes and confined in Xian'an Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Crown Prince Yinreng was deposed again and imprisoned in Xian'an Palace.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬戌，穆和倫等覆按江南獄上，上命奪噶禮職，張伯行復任。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day renxu: Mu Helun and others reported on their reinvestigation of the Jiangnan case; the Emperor ordered Gali stripped of office and Zhang Boxing restored to his post.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Mu Helun's team reported on the Jiangnan case; Gali was dismissed and Zhang Boxing restored.

sentences.zh: 以揆敘為左都御史，赫壽為江南江西總督。

translations.literal: Kuai Xu was made Censor-in-chief of the Left, and He Shou governor-general of Jiangnan and Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Kuai Xu became Left Censor-in-chief; He Shou became governor-general of Jiangnan and Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙酉，前福建提督藍理獄上，應死。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day yiyou: the case of former Fujian provincial commander Lan Li was reported upward; death was the sentence.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, former Fujian commander Lan Li's case called for execution.

sentences.zh: 上念征台灣功，特原之。

translations.literal: The Emperor, mindful of his merit in the Taiwan campaign, specially pardoned him.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor pardoned Lan Li for his Taiwan campaign merit.

sentences.zh: 己亥，群臣以萬壽六旬請上尊號，不許。

translations.literal: On day jihai, because of the sixtieth birthday, court ministers asked that an honorific title be conferred; this was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, ministers sought an honorific title for the sixtieth birthday; the Emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以復廢皇太子胤礽告廟，宣示天下。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, the re-deposition of Crown Prince Yinreng was announced at the imperial shrines and proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, Yinreng's second deposition was announced at the shrines and empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 己酉，上謁陵，賜守陵大臣白金。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, the Emperor paid respects at the imperial tombs and granted silver to the tomb-guard ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, the Emperor visited the tombs and granted silver to tomb guardians.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲戌，上還京。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiaxu: the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸、江南、山東、浙江等省二十三州縣災賦有差。

translations.literal: This year, disaster land tax for twenty-three prefectures and counties in Zhili, Jiangnan, Shandong, Zhejiang, and other provinces was remitted in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Tax relief was granted for disaster areas in twenty-three districts across several provinces.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮入貢。

translations.literal: Korea sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 五十二年癸巳春正月戊申，詔封后藏班禪胡土克圖喇嘛為班禪額爾得尼。

translations.literal: Fifty-second year, spring, first month, day wushen: an edict enfeoffed the post-Tibet Panchen Hutuktu Lama as Panchen Erdeni.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-second year, the Panchen Hutuktu Lama was enfeoffed as Panchen Erdeni.

sentences.zh: 二月庚戌，趙申喬疏言太子國本，應行冊立。
