translations.literal: Second month, day gengxu: Zhao Shenqiao memorialized that the heir apparent was the foundation of the state and investiture should proceed.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Shenqiao urged that the crown prince be formally invested.

sentences.zh: 上以建儲大事，未可輕定，宣諭廷臣，以原疏還之。

translations.literal: The Emperor, because establishing an heir is a grave matter not to be decided lightly, instructed the court and returned the memorial.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said investiture was too grave to decide hastily and returned Zhao's memorial.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，上巡幸畿甸。

translations.literal: On day yimao, the Emperor toured the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, the Emperor toured the capital districts.

sentences.zh: 編修戴名世以著述狂悖棄市。

translations.literal: Compiling-editor Dai Mingshi was executed by slicing for seditious writings.
translations.idiomatic: Dai Mingshi was executed for seditious writings.

sentences.zh: 進士方苞以作序干連，免死入旗，旋赦出之。

translations.literal: Jinshi Fang Bao, implicated for writing a preface, was spared death but entered the banner rolls; he was soon pardoned and released.
translations.idiomatic: Fang Bao, implicated by a preface, was spared death, entered the banners, then was pardoned.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，上還駐申昜春園。

translations.literal: On day yihai, the Emperor returned and halted at Changchun Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, the Emperor returned to Changchun Garden.

sentences.zh: 三月戊寅朔，諭王大臣：「朕昨還京，見各處為朕保釐乞福者，不計其數，實覺愧汗。

translations.literal: Third month, first day wuyin: the Emperor instructed princes and ministers: "Since We returned to the capital yesterday, We have seen countless people everywhere praying for Our health and longevity, and We truly feel ashamed.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, the Emperor told princes and ministers he was ashamed of the countless prayers for his health since returning to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 萬國安，即朕之安，天下福，即朕之福，祝延者當以茲為先。

translations.literal: When the myriad states are at peace, that is Our peace; when the realm is blessed, that is Our blessing—those who pray for long life should keep this foremost.
translations.idiomatic: He said the realm's peace and blessing were his own, and prayers should seek that first.

sentences.zh: 朕老矣，臨深履薄之念，與日俱增，敢滿假乎？

translations.literal: We are old; the thought of standing at the brink grows daily—how dare We be complacent?"
translations.idiomatic: He said he grew more cautious daily and dared not be complacent."

sentences.zh: 」又諭：「各省祝壽老人極多，倘有一二有恙者，可令太醫看治。

translations.literal: " He also instructed: "There are very many birthday celebrants in the provinces; if one or two are unwell, the Imperial Physicians may treat them.
translations.idiomatic: He also ordered Imperial Physicians to treat any aged celebrants who fell ill.

sentences.zh: 朕於十七日進宮經棚，老人已得從容瞻覲。

translations.literal: On the seventeenth We shall enter the palace scripture pavilion; the elders have already been able to pay respects at leisure.
translations.idiomatic: On the seventeenth he would receive elders at the palace scripture pavilion, where they could pay respects at leisure.

sentences.zh: 十八日正陽門行禮，不必再至龍棚。

translations.literal: On the eighteenth the ceremony is at Zhengyang Gate—they need not come again to the dragon pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: On the eighteenth, rites at Zhengyang Gate would suffice.

sentences.zh: 各省漢官傳諭知悉。

translations.literal: Han officials in each province are to transmit this so all know."
translations.idiomatic: Han officials in each province were to pass the notice along."

sentences.zh: 」甲午，上還宮，各省臣民夾道俯伏歡迎，上駐輦慰勞之。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, the Emperor returned to the palace; subjects from every province lined the road prostrate in welcome, and the Emperor halted the carriage to comfort them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, the Emperor returned to the palace and halted his carriage to comfort welcoming subjects from every province.

sentences.zh: 乙未，萬壽節，上朝慈寧宮，御太和殿受賀，頒詔覃恩，錫高年，舉隱逸，旌孝義，蠲逋負，鰥寡孤獨無告者，官為養之，罪非殊死，咸赦除焉。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, the Longevity Festival: the Emperor attended the Empress Dowager at Cining Palace, received congratulations in the Hall of Supreme Harmony, issued a grace edict granting favors to the aged, recommending recluses, honoring filial piety and righteousness, remitting arrears, providing state care for widows, orphans, and the destitute without support, and pardoning all crimes not punishable by death.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, the Longevity Festival brought a grace edict: honors for the aged and virtuous, tax relief, state care for the destitute, and a broad pardon.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，召直省官員士庶年六十五以上者，賜宴於申昜春園，皇子視食，宗室子執爵授飲。

translations.literal: On day renyin, officials and commoners aged sixty-five and above from all provinces were summoned to a feast at Changchun Garden; princes served food and clansmen presented cups.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, elders sixty-five and above from every province were feasted at Changchun Garden, with princes and clansmen serving.

sentences.zh: 扶掖八十以上老人至前，親視飲酒。

translations.literal: Elders over eighty were helped forward, and the Emperor personally watched them drink.
translations.idiomatic: He helped elders over eighty forward and watched them drink.

sentences.zh: 諭之曰：「古來以養老尊賢為先，使人人知孝知弟，則風俗厚矣。

translations.literal: He instructed them: "Since antiquity nourishing the aged and honoring the worthy comes first; if all know filial piety and brotherly duty, custom will be sound.
translations.idiomatic: He told them that honoring the aged and the worthy would thicken custom through filial piety and brotherly duty.

sentences.zh: 爾耆老當以此意告之鄉里。

translations.literal: You elders should convey this to your villages."
translations.idiomatic: He asked the elders to spread this in their villages."

sentences.zh: 昨日大雨，田野霑足。

translations.literal: Yesterday's great rain has thoroughly moistened the fields.
translations.idiomatic: He noted that yesterday's rain had soaked the fields.

sentences.zh: 爾等速回，無誤農時。

translations.literal: Return quickly and do not miss the farming season."
translations.idiomatic: He urged them to return quickly and not miss the farming season."

sentences.zh: 」是日，九十以上者三十三人，八十以上者五百三十八人，各賜白金。

translations.literal: " That day, thirty-three persons aged ninety or above and five hundred thirty-eight aged eighty or above were each granted silver.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty-three men over ninety and 538 over eighty received silver that day.

sentences.zh: 加祝釐老臣宋犖太子少師，田種玉太子少傅。

translations.literal: Song Luo, elder wishing longevity, was made Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent; Tian Zhongyu Junior Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: Song Luo and Tian Zhongyu received honorary tutor ranks.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，宴八旗官員、兵丁、閒散於申昜春園，視食授飲、視飲賜金同前。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, Banner officials, soldiers, and idlers were feasted at Changchun Garden, with food service, cup presentation, and silver gifts as before.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, Banner officers and soldiers were feasted at Changchun Garden with the same honors as before.

sentences.zh: 是日，九十以上者七人，八十以上者一百九十二人。

translations.literal: That day, seven persons aged ninety or above and one hundred ninety-two aged eighty or above.
translations.idiomatic: Seven men over ninety and 192 over eighty attended that day.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲寅，以鄂海為陝西四川總督，額倫特為湖廣總督，高其位為湖廣提督。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jiayin: Ehai was made governor-general of Shaanxi and Sichuan, Elunte governor-general of Huguang, and Gao Qiwei Huguang provincial commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Ehai, Elunte, and Gao Qiwei received new posts in the northwest and Huguang.

sentences.zh: 四川提督岳升龍請入籍四川，許之。

translations.literal: Sichuan provincial commander Yue Shenglong asked to register his household in Sichuan; this was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Yue Shenglong was permitted to register in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，遣官告祭山川、古陵、闕里。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, officers were sent to offer sacrifice at the mountains and rivers, ancient imperial tombs, and the temple of Confucius at Qufu.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, sacrifices were ordered at sacred sites and Qufu.

sentences.zh: 五月丙戌，上奉皇太后避暑熱河。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day bingxu: the Emperor accompanied the Empress Dowager to Rehe for the summer.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager to Rehe.

sentences.zh: 調張廷樞為刑部尚書，王頊齡為工部尚書。

translations.literal: Zhang Tinglu was transferred to Minister of Punishments and Wang Zhuiling to Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Tinglu and Wang Zhuiling received new ministerial posts.

sentences.zh: 頒賚蒙古老人白金。

translations.literal: Mongol elders were granted silver.
translations.idiomatic: Silver was granted to Mongol elders.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，詔停本年秋決。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, an edict halted autumn executions for this year.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, autumn executions were suspended for the year.

sentences.zh: 閏五月乙卯，賚熱河老人白金。

translations.literal: Intercalary fifth month, day yimao: Rehe elders were granted silver.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary fifth month, Rehe elders received silver.

sentences.zh: 御史陳汝咸招撫海寇陳尚義入見，詢海上情勢及洋船形質，命於金州安置，置水師營。

translations.literal: Censor Chen Ruqian induced the sea bandit Chen Shangyi to come for audience, inquired into coastal conditions and the form of foreign ships, and was ordered to settle him at Jinzhou and establish a naval camp.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Ruqian brought pirate Chen Shangyi to audience, questioned him on the seas, and settled him at Jinzhou with a naval camp.

sentences.zh: 六月丁丑，修律算書。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day dingchou: the calendrical and mathematical treatises were revised.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, calendrical and mathematical works were revised.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬子，詔宗人削屬籍者，子孫分別系紅帶、紫帶，載名玉牒。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day renzi: an edict ordered that descendants of imperial clansmen struck from the genealogy should respectively wear red or purple girdles and be recorded in the jade genealogy.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, descendants of clansmen removed from the rolls were ordered to wear red or purple girdles and be listed in the jade genealogy.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，上行圍。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, the Emperor went on the hunting encirclement.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, the Emperor went hunting.

sentences.zh: 八月丁丑，蒙古鄂爾多斯王松阿拉布請於察罕託灰游牧，不許，命游牧以黃河為界，從總兵范時捷請也。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day dingchou: the Ordos Mongol prince Song Alabu asked to pasture at Chahan Tuohui; this was not permitted, and grazing was ordered to take the Yellow River as boundary, following the request of garrison commander Fan Shijie.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, Ordos Prince Song Alabu was denied grazing beyond the Yellow River, per General Fan Shijie's request.

sentences.zh: 九月甲子，上奉皇太后還宮。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiazi: the Emperor accompanied the Empress Dowager back to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day in the ninth month, the Emperor returned with the Empress Dowager to the palace.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以江南漕米十萬石分運廣東、福建平糶。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, one hundred thousand shi of Jiangnan transport grain were sent in portions to Guangdong and Fujian for price stabilization.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, 100,000 shi of Jiangnan grain were sent south to stabilize prices.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙子，以張鵬翮為吏部尚書。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day bingzi: Zhang Penghe was made Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Zhang Penghe became Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，賜王敬銘等一百四十三人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, Wang Jingming and one hundred forty-three others were granted jinshi and other ranks with distinctions.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, Wang Jingming and 143 others received jinshi degrees.

sentences.zh: 十一月己酉，詔免廣東、福建、甘肅二十一州縣衛明年稅糧。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiyou: an edict remitted next year's tax grain for twenty-one prefectures, counties, and garrisons in Guangdong, Fujian, and Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, tax grain was remitted for twenty-one districts in the south and Gansu.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，上謁陵。

translations.literal: On day guihai, the Emperor paid respects at the imperial tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, the Emperor visited the imperial tombs.

sentences.zh: 十二月己卯，以赫奕為工部尚書。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jimao: He Yi was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, He Yi became Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，令文武科目原兼應者，許改試一科。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, those who had originally taken both civil and military examinations were permitted to change and sit for one stream only.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, candidates who had taken both civil and military exams could choose one stream.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，上還京。

translations.literal: On day renchen, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以五鬲為蒙古都統。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, Wuge was made Mongol commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, Wuge became Mongol commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, the seasonal collective sacrifice was performed at the imperial ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, the imperial ancestral temple received the seasonal collective rites.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免浙江十州縣災賦有差。

translations.literal: This year, disaster land tax for ten prefectures and counties in Zhejiang was remitted in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Tax relief was granted for disaster areas in ten Zhejiang districts.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、琉球入貢。

translations.literal: Korea and Ryukyu sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea and Ryukyu paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 五十三年甲午春正月己未，命修壇廟殿廷樂器。

translations.literal: Fifty-third year, spring, first month, day jiwei: repair of ritual instruments at altars, temples, halls, and courts was ordered.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-third year, altar and temple ritual instruments were ordered repaired.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，戶部請禁小錢。

translations.literal: On day guihai, the Ministry of Revenue asked to ban small coins.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, the Ministry of Revenue sought a ban on small coin.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「凡事必期便民，若不便於民，而惟言行法，雖厲禁何益。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "In all things one must aim to benefit the people; if it does not benefit the people and one only insists on enforcing the law, what good is a harsh ban?"
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said laws must benefit the people, or harsh bans were useless.

sentences.zh: 」戊辰，上巡幸畿甸。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, the Emperor toured the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, the Emperor toured the capital districts.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以何天培為京口將軍。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, He Tianpei was made general at Jingkou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, He Tianpei became Jingkou general.

sentences.zh: 二月甲戌，詔停今年秋審，矜疑人犯，審理具奏，配流以下，減等發落。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiaxu: an edict halted this year's autumn review; doubtful convicts were to be tried and reported, and those sentenced to exile or below were to be reduced one grade in punishment.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, the autumn review was halted and doubtful and minor offenders received reduced sentences.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，上還京。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，命侍郎常泰、少卿陳汝咸赴甘肅賑撫災民。

translations.literal: On day guichou, Vice Minister Chang Tai and Vice Director Chen Ruqian were ordered to Gansu to relieve and comfort disaster victims.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, Chang Tai and Chen Ruqian were sent to relieve Gansu famine victims.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，前尚書王鴻緒進明史列傳二百八十卷，命付史館。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, former Minister Wang Hongxu presented two hundred eighty juan of Ming History biographies; they were ordered delivered to the historiography office.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, Wang Hongxu submitted 280 juan of Ming History biographies to the historiography office.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊子，改師懿德為甘肅提督。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day wuzi: Shi Yide was transferred to Gansu provincial commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Shi Yide became Gansu provincial commander.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，上奉皇太后避暑熱河。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, the Emperor accompanied the Empress Dowager to Rehe for the summer.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager to Rehe.

sentences.zh: 六月乙亥，詔：「拉藏汗年近六十，二子在外，宜防外患，善自為謀。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day yihai, an edict said: "Lhabzang Khan is nearly sixty; his two sons are abroad—he should guard against outside trouble and look well to his own plans.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, an edict warned Lhabzang Khan, nearly sixty with sons abroad, to guard against outside threats.

sentences.zh: 」癸未，以炎暑免從臣晚朝。

translations.literal: " On day guiwei, because of the heat, late court for attending ministers was waived.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day, late court was waived for ministers because of the heat.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛卯，詔以江南又旱，浙江米貴，河南歉收，截漕三十萬石，分運三省平糶。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day xinmao: an edict, because Jiangnan was again in drought, Zhejiang rice was dear, and Henan had poor harvests, ordered three hundred thousand shi of transport grain diverted and sent in portions to the three provinces for price stabilization.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, 300,000 shi of grain were diverted to Jiangnan, Zhejiang, and Henan to ease drought and dearth.

sentences.zh: 八月乙亥，上行圍。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day yihai: the Emperor went on the hunting encirclement.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, the Emperor went hunting.

sentences.zh: 九月丙寅，上奉皇太后還宮。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day bingyin: the Emperor accompanied the Empress Dowager back to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day in the ninth month, the Emperor returned with the Empress Dowager to the palace.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己巳朔，命張鵬翮、阿錫鼐往按江南牟欽元獄。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, first day jisi: Zhang Penghe and Ashitai were ordered to reinvestigate the Mou Qinyuan case in Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: On the first of the tenth month, Zhang Penghe and Ashitai were sent to reinvestigate the Mou Qinyuan case in Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 己丑，命大學士、南書房翰林考定樂章。

translations.literal: On day jichou, grand secretaries and Hanlin of the Southern Study were ordered to fix the ritual hymns.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, grand secretaries and Southern Study Hanlin were ordered to fix ritual music.

sentences.zh: 十一月，敕戶部截漕三十餘萬石，於江南、浙江備賑。

translations.literal: Eleventh month: the Ministry of Revenue was ordered to divert more than three hundred thousand shi of transport grain from Jiangnan and Zhejiang for relief stores.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, over 300,000 shi of Jiangnan grain were set aside for relief.

sentences.zh: 戊申，免甘肅靖邊二十八州縣衛明年額賦。

translations.literal: On day wushen, next year's quota land tax for twenty-eight prefectures, counties, and garrisons in Jingbian, Gansu, was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, Jingbian districts in Gansu received tax relief for the coming year.

sentences.zh: 誠親王胤祉等以御制律呂正義進呈，得旨：「律呂、曆法、算法三書共為一部，名曰律歷淵源。

translations.literal: Prince Yin Zhi and others presented the imperially composed Correct Meaning of Pitch-pipes and received the rescript: "The three books on pitch-pipes, calendrical methods, and calculation are to form one work, titled Sources of Pitch-pipes, Calendar, and Calculation.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Yin Zhi presented the imperial Music Treatise; the Emperor ordered it combined with calendar and math works as Sources of Pitch-pipes, Calendar, and Calculation.

sentences.zh: 」甲寅，冬至，祀天於圜丘，奏新樂。

translations.literal: " On day jiayin, the winter solstice, Heaven was sacrificed to at the Round Mound Altar, and the new music was performed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, winter solstice sacrifice at the Round Mound used the new music.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，上巡幸塞外。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, the Emperor toured beyond the passes.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, the Emperor toured the frontier.

sentences.zh: 貝勒胤禩屬下人雅齊布有罪伏誅。

translations.literal: Under Beile Yin Si, the bondservant Yaqibu was guilty and executed.
translations.idiomatic: Yaqibu, a bondservant of Beile Yin Si, was executed for his crime.

sentences.zh: 遣何國棟測量廣東、雲南等省北極出地及日景。

translations.literal: He Guodong was sent to measure polar altitude and the sun's shadow in Guangdong, Yunnan, and other provinces.
translations.idiomatic: He Guodong was sent to measure polar altitude and solar altitude in the southern provinces.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸酉，上駐特布克，賜隨圍蒙古兵銀幣。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day guiyou: the Emperor halted at Tebuke and granted silver and coins to Mongol soldiers on the hunt.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, at Tebuke the Emperor granted silver to Mongol soldiers on the hunt.

sentences.zh: 己丑，上還京。

translations.literal: On day jichou, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，洮、岷邊外生番喇子等一十九族內附。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, nineteen raw-tribe Lamaist groups beyond the Tao-Min border submitted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, nineteen raw tribes beyond the Tao-Min frontier submitted.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免江南、河南、甘肅、浙江、湖廣等省百二十二州縣災賦有差。

translations.literal: This year, disaster land tax for one hundred twenty-two prefectures and counties in Jiangnan, Henan, Gansu, Zhejiang, Huguang, and other provinces was remitted in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Tax relief was granted for disaster areas in 122 districts across several provinces.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮入貢。

translations.literal: Korea sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 五十四年乙未春正月甲子，停五經中式例。

translations.literal: Fifty-fourth year, spring, first month, day jiazi: the quota rule for passing by the Five Classics examination was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-fourth year, the Five Classics pass quota was suspended.

sentences.zh: 封阿巴垓台吉德木楚克為輔國公。

translations.literal: Abaghai taiji Demuchuke was enfeoffed as Assistant State Duke.
translations.idiomatic: Demuchuke of Abaghai was enfeoffed as Assistant State Duke.

sentences.zh: 詔貝勒胤禩、延壽溺職，停食俸。

translations.literal: An edict said Beile Yin Si and Yanshou had neglected duty and their salaries were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: Beile Yin Si and Yanshou were suspended from salary for negligence.

sentences.zh: 二月戊辰朔，張伯行緣事解任，交張鵬翮審理。

translations.literal: Second month, first day wuchen: Zhang Boxing was removed from office over a matter and the case was referred to Zhang Penghe for trial.
translations.idiomatic: On the first of the second month, Zhang Boxing was removed pending trial by Zhang Penghe.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以施世綸為漕運總督。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Shi Shilun was made director-general of grain transport.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, Shi Shilun became grain transport director-general.

sentences.zh: 辛未，上巡幸畿甸，諭巡撫趙弘燮曰：「去年臘雪豐盈，今年春雨應節，民田想早播種。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, the Emperor made an inspection tour of the capital region and instructed Governor Zhao Hongxie: "Last year's late snows were abundant and this year's spring rains are seasonable; the people's fields should have been sown early.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, touring the capital region, the Emperor told Governor Zhao Hongxie that abundant snow and timely spring rain should have let farmers sow early.

sentences.zh: 但慮起發太盛，或有二疸之虞。

translations.literal: But We fear that if sprouts come up too thickly, there may be risk of double blight.
translations.idiomatic: He warned that overly dense sprouting might bring double blight.

sentences.zh: 可示農民芸耨宜疏，以防風霾。

translations.literal: You should instruct farmers that hoeing and weeding should be rather sparse, to guard against wind and dust storms.
translations.idiomatic: Farmers should be told to weed thinly to guard against wind and dust.

sentences.zh: 」又諭：「朕時巡畿甸，見民生差勝於前。

translations.literal: " The Emperor also instructed: "On Our tours of the capital region We see the people's livelihood somewhat better than before.
translations.idiomatic: He added that on his tours he saw livelihoods somewhat improved.

sentences.zh: 但誦讀者少，風俗攸關。

translations.literal: But few read and recite—customs are at stake.
translations.idiomatic: Yet few studied, which touched on public morals.

sentences.zh: 宜令窮僻鄉壤廣設義學，勸令讀書。

translations.literal: You should order charity schools widely set up in remote villages and encourage reading.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered charity schools in remote villages and urged study.

sentences.zh: 爾有司其留意。

translations.literal: You officials should take heed."
translations.idiomatic: Local officials were to take heed."

sentences.zh: 」甲午，以杜呈泗為江南提督，穆廷栻為福建陸路提督。

translations.literal: " On day jiawu, Du Chengsi was made Jiangnan provincial commander and Mu Tingxue Fujian land-route provincial commander.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, Du Chengsi became Jiangnan commander and Mu Tingxue Fujian land commander.

sentences.zh: 三月己亥，以蒙古吳拉忒等部十四旗雪災，命尚書穆和倫運米往賑，教之捕魚為食。

translations.literal: Third month, day jihai: because of snow disaster in the fourteen banners of the Mongol Urad and other tribes, Minister Mu Helun was ordered to transport grain for relief and teach them to fish for food.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, Mu Helun was sent with grain to relieve fourteen snow-stricken Urad banners and teach them to fish.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以趙弘燮為直隸總督，任巡撫事。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Zhao Hongxie was made governor-general of Zhili, retaining provincial governor duties.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Zhao Hongxie became Zhili governor-general while keeping governor duties.

sentences.zh: 以睦森為寧古塔將軍。

translations.literal: Musen was made Ningguta general.
translations.idiomatic: Musen became Ningguta general.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚午，賜徐陶璋等一百九十人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day gengwu: Xu Taozhang and one hundred ninety others were granted jinshi and other ranks with distinctions.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Xu Taozhang and 190 others received jinshi degrees.

sentences.zh: 己卯，師懿德奏策旺阿拉布坦兵掠哈密，游擊潘至善擊敗之。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Shi Yide memorialized that Tsewang Arabtan's troops had raided Hami; Guerrilla Commander Pan Zhishan defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, Shi Yide reported Tsewang Arabtan's raid on Hami and Pan Zhishan's victory.

sentences.zh: 命尚書富寧安、將軍席柱率師援剿，祁里德赴推河，諭喀爾喀等備兵。

translations.literal: Minister Fu Ning'an and General Xi Zhu were ordered to lead troops in relief and suppression; Qilide was sent to the Tuhe River; Khalkha and others were instructed to ready troops.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Ning'an and Xi Zhu were ordered to campaign; Qilide went to the Tuhe River; Khalkha was told to ready troops.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，徵外籓兵集歸化城，調打牲索倫兵赴推河。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, foreign-banner troops were summoned to assemble at Guihua City; Solon hunting troops were dispatched to the Tuhe River.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, frontier troops gathered at Guihua City and Solon hunters were sent to the Tuhe River.

sentences.zh: 己丑，諭議政大臣：「朕曾出塞親征，周知要害。

translations.literal: On day jichou, the Emperor instructed the Council of Princes: "We once campaigned beyond the passes in person and know the strategic points thoroughly.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, the Emperor told the Council of Princes he knew the frontier from personal campaigns.

sentences.zh: 今討策旺阿拉布坦進兵之路有三：一由噶斯直抵伊里河源，趨其巢穴；

translations.literal: Now in punishing Tsewang Arabtan there are three routes of advance: one from Gas straight to the source of the Ili River, pressing on his lair;
translations.idiomatic: To attack Tsewang Arabtan he proposed three routes: from Gas to the Ili headwaters and his lair;

sentences.zh: 一越哈密、吐魯番，深略敵境；

translations.literal: one crossing Hami and Turfan to raid deep into enemy territory;
translations.idiomatic: one through Hami and Turfan deep into enemy country;

sentences.zh: 一取道喀爾喀，至博克達額倫哈必爾漢，度嶺扼險。

translations.literal: one by way of Khalkha to Bokeduo E'lun Habierhan, crossing the pass to seize commanding ground.
translations.idiomatic: one via Khalkha to Bokeduo E'lun Habierhan to hold the passes.

sentences.zh: 三路並進，大功必成。

translations.literal: Advancing on three roads at once, great success is certain."
translations.idiomatic: A three-pronged advance would surely succeed."

sentences.zh: 」壬午，漕運總督郎廷極卒，上稱其撫恤運丁，歷運無阻，予祭葬，諡溫勤。

translations.literal: " On day renwu, Grain Transport Governor Lang Tingji died; the Emperor praised his care for transport boatmen and unobstructed shipments, granted sacrificial rites and burial honors, and gave the posthumous title Wenqin.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, Lang Tingji died; the court praised his care for boatmen, granted funeral honors, and gave posthumous name Wenqin.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，上奉皇太后避暑熱河。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, the Emperor accompanied the Empress Dowager to Rehe for summer retreat.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager to Rehe.

sentences.zh: 乙未，命富寧安分兵戍噶斯口，總兵路振聲駐防哈密。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Fu Ning'an was ordered to divide troops to garrison Gas Pass; Regional Commander Lu Zhensheng was stationed at Hami.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, Fu Ning'an garrisoned Gas Pass and Lu Zhensheng was posted at Hami.

sentences.zh: 五月丙午，黑龍江將軍宗室楊福卒，賜銀一千兩，命侍衛尚崇義、傅森馳驛賜奠，諡襄毅，命其子三官保暫署父任。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day bingwu: Heilongjiang General, imperial clansman Yang Fu, died; one thousand taels of silver were granted; Guards Shang Chongyi and Fu Sen were hurried by post-horse to offer sacrifice; posthumous title Xiangyi; his son Sanguanbao was ordered temporarily to act in his father's post.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Heilongjiang General Yang Fu died; guards were sent to sacrifice; posthumous name Xiangyi; his son Sanguanbao acted in his place.

sentences.zh: 戊午，內閣侍讀圖理琛使於鄂羅斯，使備兵。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, Inner Secretariat Reader Tulichen was sent as envoy to Russia to have them ready troops.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, Tulichen was sent to Russia to arrange troop readiness.

sentences.zh: 六月壬申，命都統圖斯海等赴湖灘河朔運糧。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day renshen: Commander-in-chief Tusihai and others were ordered to the Hutang rivers north to transport grain.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Tusihai and others were ordered north of the Hutang to move grain.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，富寧安、席柱疏報進兵方略。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, Fu Ning'an and Xi Zhu memorialized on the strategy of advance.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, Fu Ning'an and Xi Zhu reported their advance strategy.

sentences.zh: 得旨，明年進兵。

translations.literal: An imperial rescript was received: advance troops next year.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor ordered the campaign deferred until the next year.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，兵部尚書孫徵灝卒，賜鞍馬二、散馬二、銀五百兩，諡清端。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, Minister of War Sun Zhenghao died; he was granted two saddled horses, two unsaddled horses, and five hundred taels of silver; posthumous title Qingduan.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, Minister of War Sun Zhenghao died with funeral gifts and posthumous name Qingduan.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲午朔，命和托輝特公博貝招撫烏梁海。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, first day jiayin: Duke Bobei of the KhotoGirats was ordered to win over the Uriankhai.
translations.idiomatic: On the first of the seventh month, Duke Bobei was ordered to win over the Uriankhai.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，命公傅爾丹往烏蘭古等處屯田。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Duke Furdan was ordered to open farming colonies at Ulan Gu and other places.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, Duke Furdan was sent to farm at Ulan Gu and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 八月辛未，大學士李光地乞假歸，上賦詩送之。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day xinwei: Grand Secretary Li Guangdi asked leave to return home; the Emperor composed a poem seeing him off.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, Li Guangdi took leave; the Emperor wrote a farewell poem.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，上行圍。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, the Emperor went on the hunting encirclement.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, the Emperor went hunting.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，撤噶斯口戍兵還肅州。

translations.literal: On day renchen, garrison troops at Gas Pass were withdrawn back to Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, the Gas Pass garrison withdrew to Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 九月己酉，博貝招撫烏梁海部來歸。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiyou: the Uriankhai tribes won over by Bobei came to submit.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Uriankhai tribes won over by Bobei submitted.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙寅，上諭大學士：「朕右手病不能寫字，用左手執筆批答奏摺，期於不泄漏也。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day bingyin: the Emperor told Grand Secretaries: "Our right hand is ill and cannot write; We use the left hand to hold the brush and endorse memorials, aiming at no leakage."
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, the Emperor said his right hand was too ill to write and he endorsed memorials left-handed to avoid leaks.

sentences.zh: 」辛巳，上奉皇太后還宮。

translations.literal: " On day xinsi, the Emperor accompanied the Empress Dowager back to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, the Emperor returned with the Empress Dowager to the palace.

sentences.zh: 詔順天、保定、河間、永平、宣化今歲雨溢，穀耗不登，所有五府應完五十五年稅糧，悉蠲除之。

translations.literal: An edict: because Shuntian, Baoding, Hejian, Yongping, and Xuanhua had excessive rain this year and grain failed, all tax grain due for the fifty-fifth year from the five prefectures was wholly remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Tax grain for the fifty-fifth year was remitted in five rain-stricken prefectures.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲午，以范時崇為左都御史，覺羅滿保為浙江福建總督，宗室巴塞為蒙古都統。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiawu: Fan Shichong was made Left Censor-in-chief; Aisin Gioro Manbao governor-general of Zhejiang and Fujian; imperial clansman Base Mongol commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Fan Shichong, Manbao, and Base received new posts.

sentences.zh: 庚子，停京師決囚。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, executions in the capital were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, capital executions were halted.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以宋臣范仲淹從祀孔廟。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Song minister Fan Zhongyan was ordered enshrined in the Confucian temple.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, Fan Zhongyan was added to the Confucian temple sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 己未，冬至，祀天於圜丘，始用御定雅樂。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, winter solstice: Heaven was sacrificed to at the Round Altar; the imperially fixed court ritual music was used for the first time.
translations.idiomatic: On the winter solstice the court used the new imperial ritual music at the Round Altar.

sentences.zh: 十二月己巳，以塔拜為杭州將軍。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jisi: Tabai was made Hangzhou general.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Tabai became Hangzhou general.

sentences.zh: 命護軍統領晏布帥師駐西寧。

translations.literal: Guard-commander Yanbu was ordered to lead troops stationed at Xining.
translations.idiomatic: Yanbu was ordered to command troops at Xining.

sentences.zh: 甲申，張伯行以疑贓誣參論罪應死，上原之，起為倉場侍郎。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, Zhang Boxing, convicted on a charge of slanderously impeaching over suspect bribes and sentenced to death, was pardoned by the Emperor and reappointed Granary Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, Zhang Boxing, sentenced to death for a slander charge, was pardoned and made Granary Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免江南、湖南二省二十四州縣衛災賦有差。

translations.literal: This year, disaster land tax for twenty-four districts in Jiangnan and Hunan was remitted in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Tax relief was granted for twenty-four disaster districts in Jiangnan and Hunan.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、琉球入貢。

translations.literal: Korea and Ryukyu sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea and Ryukyu paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 五十五年丙申春正月壬子，上幸湯泉。

translations.literal: Fifty-fifth year, spring, first month, day renzi: the Emperor visited the hot springs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-fifth year, on the first day of spring, the Emperor visited the hot springs.

sentences.zh: 二月乙丑，命副都統蘇爾德經理圖呼魯克等處屯田。

translations.literal: Second month, day yichou: Vice Commander-in-chief Su Erde was ordered to manage farming colonies at Tuhuluoke and other places.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, Su Erde was assigned to open farms at Tuhuluoke and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，上還駐申昜春園。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, the Emperor returned and halted at Shenyang Spring Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, the Emperor returned to Shenyang Spring Garden.

sentences.zh: 丙子，詔免安南歲貢犀角、象牙。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, an edict exempted Annam from annual tribute of rhinoceros horn and ivory.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, Annam was exempted from rhinoceros horn and ivory tribute.

sentences.zh: 己卯，上巡幸畿甸。

translations.literal: On day jimao, the Emperor toured the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, the Emperor toured the capital region.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，定丁隨地出例。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, regulations were fixed for corvée labor drafts according to locality.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, corvée draft rules were set by locality.

sentences.zh: 三月丁酉，恤贈廣西右江剿瑤傷亡參將王啟雲官廕。

translations.literal: Third month, day dingyou: posthumous honors were granted and an official sinecure to Provincial Commander Wang Qiyun of Right River, Guangxi, killed suppressing Yao rebels.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, Wang Qiyun, killed fighting Yao rebels, received posthumous honors and a sinecure for his son.

sentences.zh: 庚子，上還宮。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, the Emperor returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, the Emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，召席柱還，以晏布代之，路振聲參軍事。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Xi Zhu was recalled; Yanbu replaced him; Lu Zhensheng assisted military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, Xi Zhu was recalled, Yanbu replaced him, and Lu Zhensheng assisted command.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，蒙古圖爾胡特貝子阿拉布珠爾請從軍。

translations.literal: On day guichou, Mongol Tu'erhute Beile Alabuzhu'er asked to join the campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, Tu'erhute Beile Alabuzhu'er asked to join the campaign.

sentences.zh: 命率蒙古兵戍噶斯口。

translations.literal: He was ordered to lead Mongol troops to garrison Gas Pass.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to garrison Gas Pass with Mongol troops.

sentences.zh: 貴州巡撫劉廕樞疏請罷兵，命乘傳詣軍周閱議奏。

translations.literal: Guizhou Governor Liu Yishu memorialized asking to halt troops; he was ordered to travel post-haste to the army, inspect on circuit, and memorialize discussion.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yishu asked to halt the campaign and was sent post-haste to inspect the army and report.

sentences.zh: 閏三月癸亥，以額倫特署西安將軍，滿丕署湖廣總督。

translations.literal: Intercalary third month, day guihai: Erlunte was made acting Xi'an general; Manbao acting Huguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary third month, Erlunte and Manbao received acting frontier posts.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以左世永為廣西提督。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, Zuo Shiyong was made Guangxi provincial commander.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, Zuo Shiyong became Guangxi commander.

sentences.zh: 壬午，發京倉米二十萬石賑順天、永平。

translations.literal: On day renwu, two hundred thousand shi of capital-granary grain were distributed to relieve Shuntian and Yongping.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, 200,000 shi of grain were sent to relieve Shuntian and Yongping.

sentences.zh: 五城粥廠展期至秋。

translations.literal: The Five Cities porridge kitchens were extended until autumn.
translations.idiomatic: Capital porridge kitchens were extended through autumn.

sentences.zh: 命禮部祈雨。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Rites was ordered to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Rites was ordered to pray for rain.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸卯，上奉皇太后避暑熱河。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day guimao: the Emperor accompanied the Empress Dowager to Rehe.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager to Rehe.

sentences.zh: 五月庚申，上駐熱河，齋居祈雨。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day gengshen: the Emperor halted at Rehe, living in abstinence and praying for rain.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, at Rehe the Emperor fasted and prayed for rain.

sentences.zh: 起馬齊為大學士，穆和倫為戶部尚書。

translations.literal: Ma Qi was recalled as Grand Secretary; Mu Helun Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Qi became Grand Secretary; Mu Helun Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，發倉米平糶。

translations.literal: On day renxu, granary grain was sold at fair price.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, granary grain was sold at fair price.

sentences.zh: 預發八旗兵糧。

translations.literal: Banner troops' grain rations were issued in advance.
translations.idiomatic: Banner grain rations were issued early.

sentences.zh: 甲子，雨。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, rain fell.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, it rained.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「宋儒云：『求雨得雨，旱豈無因。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "Song Confucians said: 'Pray for rain and get rain—can drought be without cause?'
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor quoted Song Confucians: prayer for rain succeeds because drought has causes.

sentences.zh: 』此言可味也。

translations.literal: " This remark is worth savoring."
translations.idiomatic: He said the remark was worth pondering."

sentences.zh: 」己巳，京師遠近雨足，上復常膳。

translations.literal: " On day jisi, rain was sufficient near and far around the capital; the Emperor resumed his normal diet.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, rain was ample around the capital and the Emperor resumed normal meals.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，赫奕免，以孫渣齊為工部尚書。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, He Yi was dismissed; Sun Zhaji was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, He Yi left office and Sun Zhaji became Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 六月丙辰，上幸湯泉。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day bingchen: the Emperor visited the hot springs.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, the Emperor visited the hot springs.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛未，命移噶斯口防軍分戍察罕烏蘇、噶順。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day xinwei: garrison troops at Gas Pass were ordered moved to be stationed in part at Chahan Usu and Gasun.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, the Gas Pass garrison was split between Chahan Usu and Gasun.

sentences.zh: 癸未，上行圍。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, the Emperor went on the hunting encirclement.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day, the Emperor went hunting.

sentences.zh: 八月乙卯，前奉天府尹董弘毅坐將承德等九州縣米豆改徵銀兩，致倉儲闕乏，黜官。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day yimao: former Fengtian intendant Dong Hongyi, because he had changed grain and beans levies to silver in nine Chengde districts and counties, causing granary shortfalls, was dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, Dong Hongyi was dismissed for converting Chengde grain levies to silver and depleting stores.

sentences.zh: 九月庚午，以蔣陳錫為雲南貴州總督。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day gengwu: Jiang Chenxi was made governor-general of Yunnan and Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Jiang Chenxi became Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general.

sentences.zh: 甲申，上奉皇太后還宮。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, the Emperor accompanied the Empress Dowager back to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, the Emperor returned with the Empress Dowager to the palace.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁亥朔，詔刑部積歲緩決長系人犯，分別減釋之。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, first day dinghai: an edict ordered the Ministry of Punishments to reduce or release in categories prisoners under the delayed-execution procedure long held for many years.
translations.idiomatic: On the first of the tenth month, long-held prisoners awaiting review were to be reduced or released by category.

sentences.zh: 停本年秋決。

translations.literal: This year's autumn executions were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn executions were halted for the year.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以托留為黑龍江將軍，趙弘燦為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, Tuoliu was made Heilongjiang general; Zhao Hongcan Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, Tuoliu became Heilongjiang general and Zhao Hongcan Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，詔：「近以策旺阿拉布坦侵入哈密，徵兵備邊，一切飛芻輓粟經過邊境，不無藉資民力。

translations.literal: On day guisi, an edict said: "Recently, because Tsewang Arabtan invaded Hami, troops were levied and the frontier prepared; all rushed transport of fodder and grain passing through border regions necessarily draws on the people's strength.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, an edict cited frontier mobilization against Tsewang Arabtan and the burden on border populations.

sentences.zh: 所有山西、陝西、甘肅四十八州縣衛應徵明年銀米穀草及積年逋欠，悉與蠲除。

translations.literal: All silver, grain, fodder, and grass due next year from forty-eight districts in Shanxi, Shaanxi, and Gansu, together with years of arrears, are wholly remitted."
translations.idiomatic: Next year's levies and arrears in forty-eight Shanxi, Shaanxi, and Gansu districts were wholly remitted."

sentences.zh: 」丁酉，詔肅州與布隆吉爾毗連迤北西吉木、達里圖、金塔寺等處，招民墾種。

translations.literal: " On day dingyou, an edict ordered that north of Jiuquan, places adjoining Bulongji'er such as Xijimu, Dalitu, and Jintasi, bordering Suzhou, recruit settlers for farming.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, settlers were recruited to farm north of Suzhou near Bulongji'er.

sentences.zh: 以楊琳為廣東廣西總督。

translations.literal: Yang Lin was made governor-general of Guangdong and Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Lin became Guangdong-Guangxi governor-general.

sentences.zh: 以宗室巴賽為滿洲都統，晏布為蒙古都統。

translations.literal: Imperial clansman Base was made Manchu commander-in-chief; Yanbu Mongol commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Base became Manchu commander-in-chief; Yanbu Mongol commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 丙午，策旺阿拉布坦執青海台吉羅卜藏丹濟布，犯噶斯口，官兵擊走之。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Tsewang Arabtan seized Qinghai taiji Lobzang Danjinbu, attacked Gas Pass, and government troops drove him off.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, Tsewang Arabtan seized a Qinghai taiji, attacked Gas Pass, and was repulsed.

sentences.zh: 命額倫特駐師西寧，分兵戍噶斯口，布隆吉爾散秩大臣阿喇衲赴巴爾庫爾參贊軍事。

translations.literal: Erlunte was ordered to station troops at Xining; troops were divided to garrison Gas Pass; Bulongji'er Courtier without Rank Alana was sent to Barkul to assist in military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Erlunte was posted at Xining, troops garrisoned Gas Pass, and Alana was sent to Barkul as military aide.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙丑，以傅爾丹、額爾錦為領侍衛內大臣。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day yichou: Furdan and E'erjin were made chief imperial bodyguard ministers.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Furdan and E'erjin became chief bodyguard ministers.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，上謁陵。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, the Emperor paid respects at the imperial tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, the Emperor visited the imperial tombs.

sentences.zh: 甲申，上巡行塞外。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, the Emperor toured beyond the passes.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, the Emperor toured the frontier.

sentences.zh: 盜發明陵，命置之法。

translations.literal: The Ming imperial tombs were robbed; an order was issued to punish by law.
translations.idiomatic: Robbers broke into the Ming tombs; the court ordered punishment.

sentences.zh: 十二月己酉，上還京。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiyou: the Emperor returned to Beijing.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 詔免順天、永平三十五州縣明年地丁稅糧，其積年逋賦併除之。

translations.literal: An edict remitted land tax and corvée grain for thirty-five districts in Shuntian and Yongping for the coming year, and arrears were also cleared.
translations.idiomatic: Land tax was remitted for thirty-five Shuntian and Yongping districts, with arrears cleared.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸、江南、山東、浙江、江西、湖廣等省六十三州縣災賦有差。

translations.literal: This year, disaster land tax for sixty-three districts in Zhili, Jiangnan, Shandong, Zhejiang, Jiangxi, Huguang, and other provinces was remitted in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Tax relief was granted for sixty-three disaster districts across several provinces.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、安南入貢。

translations.literal: Korea and Annam sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea and Annam paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 五十六年丁酉春正月丁卯，修周易折中成，頒行學宮。

translations.literal: Fifty-sixth year, spring, first month, day dingmao: compilation of the Zhouyi zhezong was completed and issued to the schools.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-sixth year, on the first day of spring, the Zhouyi zhezong was completed and issued to schools.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以徐元夢為左都御史，朱軾為浙江巡撫。

translations.literal: On day renwu, Xu Yuanmeng was made Left Censor-in-chief; Zhu Shi Zhejiang provincial governor.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, Xu Yuanmeng became Left Censor-in-chief and Zhu Shi Zhejiang governor.

sentences.zh: 二月丙戌朔，上巡幸畿甸。

translations.literal: Second month, first day bingxu: the Emperor made an inspection tour of the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the second month, the Emperor toured the capital region.

sentences.zh: 乙未，徵奉天、吉林兵益祁里德軍。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, troops from Fengtian and Jilin were levied to reinforce Qilide's army.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, Fengtian and Jilin troops reinforced Qilide's army.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，上還駐申昜春園。

translations.literal: On day guimao, the Emperor returned and halted at Shenyang Spring Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, the Emperor returned to Shenyang Spring Garden.

sentences.zh: 丁未，定盜案法無可寬、情有可原例。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, precedents were fixed for theft cases of "no grounds for leniency" and "grounds for mercy."
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, theft-case rules were set for cases with and without grounds for mercy.

sentences.zh: 順承郡王諾羅布薨，諡曰忠，子錫保襲封。

translations.literal: Prince of the Commandery Norobu of Shuncheng died; posthumous name Zhong; his son Xibao succeeded to the title.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Norobu of Shuncheng died; posthumous name Zhong; his son Xibao inherited the title.

sentences.zh: 左都御史揆敘卒，予祭葬，諡文端。

translations.literal: Left Censor-in-chief Kui Xu died; sacrificial rites and burial were granted; posthumous name Wenduan.
translations.idiomatic: Left Censor-in-chief Kui Xu died with funeral honors and posthumous name Wenduan.

sentences.zh: 三月丁巳，上御經筵。

translations.literal: Third month, day dingsi: the Emperor attended the Classics lecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on dingsi day, the Emperor held the Classics lecture.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以富寧安為靖逆將軍，傅爾丹為振武將軍，祁里德為協理將軍，視師防邊。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, Fu Ning'an was made Pacification-general, Furdan Shock-the-Enemy general, and Qilide coordinating general, to take command on the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, Fu Ning'an, Furdan, and Qilide were appointed frontier generals to oversee border defense.

sentences.zh: 壬午，上巡視河西務堤。

translations.literal: On day renwu, the Emperor inspected the dikes at Hexiwu.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, the Emperor inspected the Hexiwu dikes.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙酉，上還駐申昜春園。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day yiyou: the Emperor returned and halted at Shenyang Spring Garden.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, the Emperor returned to Shenyang Spring Garden.

sentences.zh: 乙未，發通州倉米分貯直隸州縣備賑。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, grain from the Tongzhou granary was distributed to Zhili prefectures and counties for famine relief stores.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, Tongzhou grain was sent to Zhili districts for relief reserves.

sentences.zh: 丙申，碣石鎮總兵陳昂奏天主教堂各省林立，宜行禁止，從之。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Jieshi garrison commander Chen Ang memorialized that Catholic churches stand in every province and should be banned; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, Chen Ang asked to ban Catholic churches nationwide; the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 以孫柱、范時崇為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: Sun Zhu and Fan Shichong were made Ministers of War.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Zhu and Fan Shichong became Ministers of War.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，上奉皇太后避暑熱河。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager to Rehe for summer retreat.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, the Emperor took the Empress Dowager to Rehe.

sentences.zh: 五月庚申，九卿議王貝勒差人出外，查無勘合，即行參究。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day gengshen: the Nine Ministers ruled that when princes and beile send agents abroad without credentials, they are at once impeached.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, princes' agents without credentials were to be impeached at once.

sentences.zh: 六月壬子，傅爾丹襲擊厄魯特博羅布爾哈蘇，斬俘而還。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day renzi: Furdan raided the Dzungar Borobulhasu, killed and captured, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Furdan raided Borobulhasu, took captives, and returned.

sentences.zh: 兵部尚書趙弘燦卒，予祭葬，諡清端。

translations.literal: Minister of War Zhao Hongcan died; sacrificial rites and burial were granted; posthumous name Qingduan.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of War Zhao Hongcan died with funeral honors and posthumous name Qingduan.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙辰，策旺阿拉布坦遣其將策零敦多布侵掠拉藏。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day bingchen: Tsewang Arabtan sent his general Tsering Dondob to raid Lhasa territory.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Tsewang Arabtan sent Tsering Dondob to raid Lhasa.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，富寧安襲擊厄魯特於通俄巴錫，進及烏魯木齊，毀其田禾，還軍遇賊畢留圖，擊敗之。

translations.literal: On day guihai, Fu Ning'an raided the Dzungars at Tong'eobaxi, advanced to Urumqi, and destroyed their crops; on the return march he met bandits at Bilutu and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, Fu Ning'an raided Dzungars near Urumqi, destroyed crops, and defeated bandits at Bilutu on the return.

sentences.zh: 陣亡灰特台吉扎穆畢，追封輔國公。

translations.literal: Huite taiji Zhamubi, killed in battle, was posthumously enfeoffed Assistant-state Duke.
translations.idiomatic: Zhamubi, a Huite taiji killed in battle, was posthumously made Assistant-state Duke.

sentences.zh: 八月壬午朔，上行圍。

translations.literal: Eighth month, first day renwu: the Emperor went on the hunting encirclement.
translations.idiomatic: On the first of the eighth month, the Emperor went hunting.

sentences.zh: 九月辛未，以路振揚署四川提督。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day xinwei: Lu Zhenyang was appointed acting Sichuan provincial commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Lu Zhenyang became acting Sichuan commander.

sentences.zh: 河南奸民亢珽滋事，官兵捕之，珽走死。

translations.literal: The rogue Kang Ting stirred trouble in Henan; government troops pursued him; Ting fled and died.
translations.idiomatic: Henan rebel Kang Ting was pursued by troops and died in flight.

sentences.zh: 命尚書張廷樞、學士勒什布往鞫，得前巡撫李錫貪虐激變狀以聞。

translations.literal: Ministers Zhang Tingshu and Academician Leshibu were sent to try the case; they found former governor Li Xi's greed and cruelty had provoked the uprising and reported it.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Tingshu and Leshibu investigated and reported that Li Xi's cruelty had provoked the revolt.

sentences.zh: 李錫褫職論死，賊黨伏誅。

translations.literal: Li Xi was stripped of office and sentenced to death; rebel partisans were executed.
translations.idiomatic: Li Xi was removed and sentenced to death; his followers were executed.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙酉，命侍郎梁世勛、海壽往督巴爾庫爾屯田。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day yiyou: Vice ministers Liang Shixun and Haishou were ordered to supervise Barkul farming colonies.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Liang Shixun and Haishou were sent to oversee Barkul colonies.

sentences.zh: 庚子，上奉皇太后還宮。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, the Emperor returned with the Empress Dowager to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, the Emperor and Empress Dowager returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，命內大臣公策旺諾爾布、將軍額倫特、侍衛阿齊圖等率師戍青海。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Inner ministers Gongscewang Norbu, General Erlunte, guardsman Aqitu, and others were ordered to lead troops to garrison Qinghai.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, Norbu, Erlunte, Aqitu, and others were sent to garrison Qinghai.

sentences.zh: 以宗室公吞珠為禮部尚書，蔡升元為左都御史。

translations.literal: Imperial clansman Base was made Minister of Rites; Cai Shengyuan Left Censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Base became Minister of Rites; Cai Shengyuan became Left Censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬子，命停決囚。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day renzi: executions were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, executions were halted.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，皇太后不豫，上省疾慈寧宮。

translations.literal: On day yichou, the Empress Dowager fell ill; the Emperor visited her at Cining Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, the Empress Dowager fell ill and the Emperor visited Cining Palace.

sentences.zh: 辛未，詔曰：「帝王之治，必以敬天法祖為本。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, an edict said: "In governing, emperors must take revering Heaven and honoring ancestors as the foundation.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, an edict said imperial rule rests on revering Heaven and honoring ancestors.

sentences.zh: 合天下之心以為心，公四海之利以為利，制治於未亂，保邦於未危，夙夜兢兢，所以圖久遠也。

translations.literal: Take the hearts of all under Heaven as one's heart, take the benefits of the four seas as public benefit, govern disorder before it arises, secure the realm before peril comes—diligent night and day, thus planning for the long term.
translations.idiomatic: The edict urged taking the people's hearts as one's own and securing the realm before danger arose.

sentences.zh: 朕八齡踐祚，在位五十餘年，今年近七旬矣。

translations.literal: We ascended the throne at eight and have reigned more than fifty years; this year We approach seventy.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said he had reigned over fifty years and was nearing seventy.

sentences.zh: 當二十年時，不敢逆計至三十。

translations.literal: At twenty years We dared not reckon ahead to thirty.
translations.idiomatic: At twenty he had not dared plan for thirty.

sentences.zh: 三十年時，不敢逆計至四十。

translations.literal: At thirty We dared not reckon ahead to forty.
translations.idiomatic: At thirty he had not dared plan for forty.

sentences.zh: 賴宗社之靈，今已五十七年矣，非涼德所能致也。

translations.literal: By the fortune of the altars of state We have now reached fifty-seven years—not what meager virtue could achieve.
translations.idiomatic: By state fortune he had reached fifty-seven years, not by his virtue alone.

sentences.zh: 齒登耆壽，子孫眾多。

translations.literal: Our teeth have reached old age; descendants are many.
translations.idiomatic: He had reached old age with many descendants.

sentences.zh: 天下和樂，四海乂安。

translations.literal: All under Heaven is harmonious; the four seas are at peace.
translations.idiomatic: The realm was peaceful and the four seas secure.

sentences.zh: 雖未敢謂家給人足，俗易風移，而欲使民安物阜之心，始終如一。

translations.literal: Though We dare not say every household is provided for and customs are wholly transformed, Our wish to secure the people and enrich goods has been one from first to last.
translations.idiomatic: Though he could not claim full prosperity, his wish to secure the people had never changed.

sentences.zh: 占竭思慮，耗敝精力，殆非勞苦二字所能盡也。

translations.literal: Exhausting thought and wearing out strength—hardly can the word toilsome fully express it.
translations.idiomatic: His labors of mind and body could hardly be called merely toilsome.

sentences.zh: 古帝王享年不永，書生每致譏評。

translations.literal: Ancient emperors often did not live long; bookish men often sneer.
translations.idiomatic: Scholars often mocked short-lived ancient emperors.

sentences.zh: 不知天下事煩，不勝其勞慮也。

translations.literal: They do not know how taxing affairs of empire are, beyond bearing in worry and labor.
translations.idiomatic: They did not know how exhausting imperial affairs were.

sentences.zh: 人臣可仕則仕，可止則止，年老致仕而歸，猶得抱子弄孫，優遊自適。

translations.literal: Ministers may serve when they should serve, stop when they should stop; retiring in old age they still hold grandchildren and enjoy ease.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers could retire and enjoy grandchildren; emperors could not.

sentences.zh: 帝王仔肩無可旁委，舜歿蒼梧，禹殂會稽，不遑寧處，終鮮止息。

translations.literal: For emperors the burden cannot be delegated elsewhere—Shun died at Cangwu, Yu died at Kuaiji, without leisure to rest, scarcely any pause to the end.
translations.idiomatic: Emperors could not delegate their burden—Shun and Yu died on duty without rest.

sentences.zh: 洪範五福，終於考終命，以壽考之難得也。

translations.literal: The Hong Fan Five Blessings end in dying a natural death—because long life is hard to attain.
translations.idiomatic: The Hong Fan ends with natural death because long life is rare.

sentences.zh: 易遯六爻，不及君主，人君無退藏之地也。

translations.literal: The six lines of Dun in the Changes do not apply to the ruler; a sovereign has no place to withdraw and hide.
translations.idiomatic: The Changes' Dun hexagram does not apply to rulers, who have nowhere to withdraw.

sentences.zh: 豈當與臣民較安逸哉！

translations.literal: How could one compare ease with ministers and commoners!
translations.idiomatic: An emperor could not compare his lot with subjects' ease.

sentences.zh: 朕自幼讀書，尋求治理。

translations.literal: From youth We have read books and sought good governance.
translations.idiomatic: From youth he had studied and sought good government.

sentences.zh: 年力勝時，挽強決拾。

translations.literal: When strength exceeded today, We drew the bow and wrestled.
translations.idiomatic: In his prime he had drawn the bow and wrestled.

sentences.zh: 削平三籓，綏輯漠北，悉由一心運籌，未嘗妄殺一人。

translations.literal: Pacifying the Three Feudatories and bringing order to the northern deserts—all by Our single-minded planning, never killing anyone recklessly.
translations.idiomatic: He had pacified the Three Feudatories and the northern deserts without reckless killing.

sentences.zh: 府庫帑金，非出師賑飢，未敢妄費。

translations.literal: Treasury gold was not spent rashly except for campaigns and famine relief.
translations.idiomatic: Treasury funds were spent only for war and famine relief.

sentences.zh: 巡狩行宮，不施采繢。

translations.literal: On tour and at palaces We used no colorful decoration.
translations.idiomatic: His touring palaces were not lavishly decorated.

sentences.zh: 少時即知聲色之當戒，佞倖之宜遠，幸得粗致謐安。

translations.literal: From youth We knew to shun licentious sound and favor and keep sycophants far—by fortune attaining rough tranquility.
translations.idiomatic: From youth he had shunned pleasure and flatterers and attained rough peace.

sentences.zh: 今春頗苦頭暈，形漸羸瘦。

translations.literal: This spring We have suffered much dizziness; the form grows lean.
translations.idiomatic: That spring dizziness had left him thin.

sentences.zh: 行圍塞外，水土較佳，體氣稍健，每日騎射，亦不疲乏。

translations.literal: Hunting beyond the passes the soil and water are rather better; vital energy improved somewhat; daily riding and archery without fatigue.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond the passes his health improved and daily riding did not weary him.

sentences.zh: 復以皇太后違和，頭暈復作，步履艱難。

translations.literal: Then because the Empress Dowager was unwell, dizziness returned and walking grew difficult.
translations.idiomatic: When the Empress Dowager fell ill, dizziness returned and walking grew hard.

sentences.zh: 倘一時不諱，不得悉朕衷曲。

translations.literal: If at an unlucky hour We should pass, We could not fully express Our inmost mind.
translations.idiomatic: If death came suddenly, he could not fully express his mind.

sentences.zh: 死者人之常理，要當於明爽之時，舉平生心事一為吐露，方為快耳。

translations.literal: Death is human constant—what matters is to pour out a lifetime's heart at a lucid hour; only then is it satisfaction.
translations.idiomatic: Death is natural; what mattered was to speak one's whole heart while still lucid.

sentences.zh: 昔人每雲帝王當舉大綱，不必兼綜細務。

translations.literal: Formerly people often said emperors should grasp great outlines and need not handle every detail.
translations.idiomatic: Some said emperors need only grasp great outlines, not every detail.

sentences.zh: 朕不謂然，一事不謹，即貽四海之憂；

translations.literal: We do not think so: one matter not careful at once brings worry to the four seas;
translations.idiomatic: He disagreed: one careless matter could trouble the realm;

sentences.zh: 一念不謹，即貽百年之患。

translations.literal: one thought not careful at once brings a century's harm.
translations.idiomatic: one careless thought could harm generations.

sentences.zh: 朕從來蒞事無論鉅細，莫不慎之又慎。

translations.literal: From first to last in every affair great or small We have been ever more careful.
translations.idiomatic: In great and small affairs he had always been careful.

sentences.zh: 惟年既衰暮，祗懼五十七年憂勤惕勵之心，隳於末路耳。

translations.literal: Only now that age is declining We fear lest the mind of anxious diligence cultivated fifty-seven years collapse in the last stretch.
translations.idiomatic: Now aged, he feared his fifty-seven years of diligence might fail at the end.

sentences.zh: 立儲大事，豈不在念。

translations.literal: The great matter of establishing an heir—is it not always in mind?
translations.idiomatic: Choosing an heir was always on his mind.

sentences.zh: 但天下大權，當統於一，神器至重，為天下得人至難，是以朕垂老而惓惓不息也。

translations.literal: Yet the great power of empire must be unified; the sacred vessel is weightiest; to find the right man for all under Heaven is hardest—thus though aged We are earnest without cease.
translations.idiomatic: Yet unifying power and choosing the right heir was hardest, so even in old age he did not cease.

sentences.zh: 大小臣工能體朕心，則朕考終之事畢矣。

translations.literal: If great and small ministers can enter Our heart, then Our business of a natural end is complete.
translations.idiomatic: If ministers understood his heart, his final duty would be done.

sentences.zh: 茲特召諸子諸卿士詳切言之。

translations.literal: Now We especially summon Our sons and all ministers to speak plainly.
translations.idiomatic: He summoned his sons and ministers to speak plainly.

sentences.zh: 他日遺詔，備於此矣。

translations.literal: A future testament is fully prepared herein.
translations.idiomatic: His future testament was fully set forth therein.

sentences.zh: 」甲戌，免八旗借支銀二百萬兩。

translations.literal: " On day jiaxu, two million taels of Banner advance debt were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, two million taels of Banner debt were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 丙子，詔免直隸、安徽、江蘇、浙江、湖廣、陝西、甘肅等省積年逋賦，江蘇、安徽並免漕項銀米十分之五。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, an edict remitted years of arrears in Zhili, Anhui, Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Huguang, Shaanxi, and Gansu; Jiangsu and Anhui also had half of grain-transport silver and rice remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, tax arrears were remitted in several provinces; Jiangsu and Anhui also had half their transport grain forgiven.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲申，皇太后病勢漸增，上疾七十餘日矣，腳面浮腫，扶掖日朝寧壽宮。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiashen: the Empress Dowager's illness worsened; the Emperor had been ill more than seventy days, feet and face swollen, supported daily to visit Ningshou Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, the Empress Dowager worsened; the swollen, ailing Emperor visited Ningshou Palace daily.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，皇太后崩，頒遺誥，上服衰割辮，移居別宮。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, the Empress Dowager died; a testamentary edict was issued; the Emperor wore mourning and cut his queue, moving to a separate palace.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, the Empress Dowager died; the Emperor mourned, cut his queue, and moved out.

sentences.zh: 己酉，上還宮。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, the Emperor returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, the Emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 是歲，朝鮮入貢。

translations.literal: This year Korea sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea paid tribute this year.

sentences.zh: 五十七年戊戌春正月乙卯，上有疾，幸湯泉。

translations.literal: Fifty-seventh year, spring, first month, day yimao: the Emperor was ill and went to the hot springs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-seventh year, on the first day of spring, the ailing Emperor went to the hot springs.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，賜防邊軍士衣二萬襲。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, twenty thousand sets of clothing were granted to frontier troops.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, frontier troops received twenty thousand sets of clothing.

sentences.zh: 二月庚寅，拉藏乞師，命侍衛色楞會青海兵往援。

translations.literal: Second month, day gengyin: the Lhasa ruler begged for troops; guard Seleng was ordered to unite Qinghai troops in relief.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, Lhasa sought aid and Seleng was sent with Qinghai troops.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以路振聲為甘肅提督。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Lu Zhensheng was made Gansu provincial commander.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Lu Zhensheng became Gansu commander.

sentences.zh: 檢討朱天保上疏請復立胤礽為皇太子，上於行宮親訊之曰：「爾何知而違旨上奏？

translations.literal: Compiler Zhu Tianbao memorialized asking to restore Yinreng as Crown Prince; at the traveling palace the Emperor personally examined him: "How do you know to defy Our order and memorialize?
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Tianbao asked to restore Yinreng as Crown Prince; at the traveling palace the Emperor questioned him sharply.

sentences.zh: 」朱天保曰：「臣聞之臣父，臣父令臣言之。

translations.literal: " Zhu Tianbao said: "Your servant heard from his father; my father bade me speak."
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Tianbao said his father had told him to speak.

sentences.zh: 」上曰：「此不忠不孝之人也。

translations.literal: " The Emperor said: "This is a disloyal, unfilial man."
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor called him disloyal and unfilial.

sentences.zh: 」命誅之。

translations.literal: " He was ordered executed."
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Tianbao was ordered executed."

sentences.zh: 丁未，上還宮。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, the Emperor returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, the Emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 碣石鎮陳昂疏請洋船入港，先行查取大砲，方許進口貿易，部議不行。

translations.literal: Jieshi commander Chen Ang asked that foreign ships entering port first have great cannon seized before trade; the Ministry discussion rejected it.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Ang wanted foreign ships disarmed before trade; the ministry rejected the proposal.

sentences.zh: 三月癸丑，減大興、宛平門廠房稅。

translations.literal: Third month, day guichou: gate-factory taxes were reduced in Daxing and Wanping.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, gate-factory taxes were cut in Daxing and Wanping.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，上大行皇后諡曰孝惠仁憲端懿純德順天翊聖章皇后。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, the late Empress was given the posthumous title Empress Xiaohui Renxian Duanyi Chunde Shuntian Yisheng Zhang.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, the late Empress received her full posthumous title.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以顏壽為右衛將軍，黃秉鉞為福州將軍。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, Yan Shou was made Right Guard general; Huang Bingyue Fuzhou general.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, Yan Shou and Huang Bingyue received military appointments.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，裁起居注官。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, Daily Record offices were cut.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, the Daily Record staff was reduced.

sentences.zh: 甄別不職學政叢澍等七員，俱褫職。

translations.literal: Seven delinquent education intendants including Cong Shu were identified and all stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: Seven incompetent education intendants, including Cong Shu, were dismissed.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，命浙江南北新關稅交同知管理。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, Zhejiang north and south new customs duties were assigned to sub-prefect management.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, Zhejiang customs were placed under sub-prefects.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，浙江巡撫朱軾請修海寧石塘，從之。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, Zhejiang Governor Zhu Shi asked to repair the Haining stone seawall; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, Zhu Shi's request to repair the Haining seawall was approved.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙酉，葬孝惠章皇后於孝東陵。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day yiyou: Empress Xiaohui Zhang was buried at Xiaodong Tomb.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Empress Xiaohui Zhang was buried at Xiaodong Tomb.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，賜汪應銓等一百七十一人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, Wang Yingquan and one hundred seventy-one others were granted jinshi and other ranks with distinctions.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, Wang Yingquan and 171 others received jinshi degrees.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，上幸熱河。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, the Emperor went to Rehe.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, the Emperor went to Rehe.

sentences.zh: 穆和倫免，以孫渣齊為戶部尚書。

translations.literal: Mu Helun was removed; Sun Zhaji was made Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Mu Helun left office; Sun Zhaji became Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 五月癸丑，以徐元夢為工部尚書。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day guichou: Xu Yuanmeng was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Xu Yuanmeng became Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，額倫特奏拉藏汗被陷身亡，二子被殺，達賴、班禪均被拘。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, Erlunte memorialized that the Lhasa khan had been trapped and killed, his two sons slain, and the Dalai and Panchen both detained.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, Erlunte reported the Lhasa khan dead, his sons killed, and Dalai and Panchen detained.

sentences.zh: 己未，浙江福建總督滿保疏台灣一郡有極衝口岸九處，次衝口岸十五處，派人修築，酌移員弁，設淡水營守備，從之。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Zhejiang-Fujian Governor-General Manbao memorialized that Taiwan had nine critical ports and fifteen secondary ones; men were sent to repair them, officers relocated, and a Tamsui camp garrison established; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, Manbao's plan to fortify Taiwan's ports and establish a Tamsui garrison was approved.

sentences.zh: 六月壬辰，遣使冊封琉球故王曾孫尚敬為中山王。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day renchen: an envoy was sent to invest former Ryukyu king's great-grandson Shang Jing as King of Zhongshan.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Shang Jing was invested King of Zhongshan for Ryukyu.

sentences.zh: 己丑，大學士李光地卒，命皇五子恆親王胤祺往奠茶酒，賜銀一千兩，徐元夢還京護其喪事，諡文貞。

translations.literal: On day jichou, Grand Secretary Li Guangdi died; the fifth imperial son, Prince Heng Yinqi, was ordered to offer libations; one thousand taels of silver were granted; Xu Yuanmeng was ordered back to the capital to oversee the funeral; posthumous title Wenzhen.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, Li Guangdi died; Prince Heng Yinqi offered libations; Xu Yuanmeng oversaw the funeral; posthumous name Wenzhen.

sentences.zh: 丁未，賜哈密軍士衣四百襲。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, four hundred suits of clothing were granted to Hami soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, Hami troops received four hundred suits of clothing.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己未，打箭爐外墨里喇嘛內附。

translations.literal: Summer, seventh month, day jiwei: a lama of Moli outside Dajianlu submitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, a Moli lama beyond Dajianlu submitted.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，修省方盛典。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, the ceremonial regulations for provincial inspection were revised.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, provincial inspection ceremonial regulations were revised.

sentences.zh: 八月壬子，索倫水災，遣官賑之。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day renzi: Solon suffered flood disaster; officials were sent to relieve it.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, Solon flood victims were relieved by dispatched officials.

sentences.zh: 孟光祖伏誅。

translations.literal: Meng Guangzu was executed.
translations.idiomatic: Meng Guangzu was put to death.

sentences.zh: 戊子，上行圍。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, the Emperor went on the autumn hunt.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, the Emperor went hunting.

sentences.zh: 甲午，禮部尚書吞珠卒，予祭葬，諡恪敏。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, Minister of Rites Tunzhu died; sacrificial rites and burial were granted; posthumous title Kemin.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, Minister of Rites Tunzhu died with funeral honors and posthumous name Kemin.

sentences.zh: 總兵官仇機有罪伏誅。

translations.literal: Regional commander Qiu Ji, guilty of a crime, was executed.
translations.idiomatic: Regional commander Qiu Ji was executed for his crime.

sentences.zh: 閏八月戊辰，詔曰：「夷虜跳梁，大兵遠駐西邊，一切征繕，秦民甚屬勞苦。

translations.literal: Intercalary eighth month, day wuchen, an edict said: "Barbarian raiders are in revolt; the main army is stationed far on the western frontier; all levies and supplies weigh heavily on the people of Qin.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary eighth month, an edict cited frontier war burdens on Shaanxi and Gansu.

sentences.zh: 所有陝西、甘肅明年地丁糧稅俱行蠲免，歷年逋賦亦盡除之。

translations.literal: All land-poll and grain-tax quotas for Shaanxi and Gansu for next year are to be remitted, and overdue levies of past years are to be cleared entirely.
translations.idiomatic: Next year's land tax and all arrears in Shaanxi and Gansu were remitted.

translations.literal: " (closing quotation mark in the source.)
translations.idiomatic: The edict continued.

sentences.zh: 九月己卯，命都統阿爾納、總兵李耀率師赴噶斯口、柴旦木駐防。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jimao: Commander-in-chief Arna and regional commander Li Yao were ordered to lead troops to garrison Gas Pass and Chaidamu.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Arna and Li Yao were posted at Gas Pass and Chaidamu.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以王頊齡為大學士，陳元龍為工部尚書。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Wang Xunling was made Grand Secretary; Chen Yuanlong Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, Wang Xunling became Grand Secretary and Chen Yuanlong Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，上還京。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, the Emperor returned to Beijing.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 將軍額倫特、侍衛色楞會師喀喇烏蘇，屢敗賊，賊愈進，師無後繼，矢竭力戰，歿於陣。

translations.literal: General Erlunte and guard Seleng joined forces at Karakunusu, repeatedly defeated the enemy; the enemy pressed on; the army had no reinforcements; fighting until arrows were spent and strength exhausted, they died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Erlunte and Seleng won repeated victories at Karakunusu but, without reinforcements, were killed when the enemy pressed on.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲寅，停本年決囚。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day jiayin: executions for this year were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, executions were halted for the year.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，命皇十四子貝子胤禵為撫遠大將軍，視師青海。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, the fourteenth imperial son, Beizi Yinti, was made Pacification-general-in-chief of the Far Reaches to oversee the army in Qinghai.
