translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, the fourteenth son Yinti was made Pacification-general-in-chief for Qinghai.

sentences.zh: 命殉難總督甘文焜、知府黃庭柏建祠列祀。

translations.literal: Orders were issued to build shrines and enroll in the sacrifice rolls for Governor-general Gan Wenkui and prefect Huang Tingbai, who died for the state.
translations.idiomatic: Shrines were ordered for Governor-general Gan Wenkui and Prefect Huang Tingbai, who died for the state.

sentences.zh: 甲子，詔四川巡撫年羹堯，軍興以來，辦事明敏，即升為總督。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, an edict to Sichuan governor Nian Gengyao said that since the war began he had handled affairs with intelligence and perspicacity; he was at once promoted to governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, Nian Gengyao was praised for wartime efficiency and promoted to governor-general of Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 命翰林、科道輪班入直。

translations.literal: Hanlin academicians and censorate officials were ordered to attend in rotating shifts.
translations.idiomatic: Hanlin and censorate officials were ordered to attend court in rotation.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，上駐湯泉。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, the Emperor halted at the hot springs.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, the Emperor stayed at the hot springs.

sentences.zh: 命皇七子胤祐、皇十子胤蓪、皇十二子胤祹分理正黃、正白、正藍滿、蒙、漢三旗事務。

translations.literal: The seventh son Yinyou, tenth son Yin'e, and twelfth son Yinti were ordered to administer the affairs of the Plain Yellow, Plain White, and Plain Blue banners among Manchu, Mongol, and Han.
translations.idiomatic: Yinyou, Yin'e, and Yinti were ordered to manage the three Plain banners for Manchu, Mongol, and Han.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙子，上還駐申昜春園。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day bingzi: the Emperor returned and halted at Shenyang Spring Garden.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, the Emperor returned to Shenyang Spring Garden.

sentences.zh: 福建巡撫陳璸卒，贈禮部尚書，諡清端。

translations.literal: Fujian governor Chen Bin died; he was posthumously made Minister of Rites; posthumous title Qingduan.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian Governor Chen Bin died and received posthumous rank and name Qingduan.

sentences.zh: 以宜兆熊為漢軍都統。

translations.literal: Yi Zhaoxiong was made Han Chinese commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Yi Zhaoxiong became Han commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙辰，上謁陵。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day bingchen: the Emperor paid respects at the imperial tombs.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, the Emperor visited the imperial tombs.

sentences.zh: 己未，孝惠章皇后升祔太廟，位於孝康章皇后之左，頒詔天下。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Empress Xiaohuizhang was enshrined in the Imperial Ancestral Temple, her place to the left of Empress Xiaokangzhang; an edict was promulgated throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, Empress Xiaohuizhang entered the Ancestral Temple and the decree was published empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 雲南撒甸苗人歸順。

translations.literal: Miao people of Sadian in Yunnan submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan Sadian Miao submitted.

sentences.zh: 己巳，上還宮。

translations.literal: On day jisi, the Emperor returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, the Emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免江南、福建、甘肅、湖廣等省二十六州縣衛災賦有差。

translations.literal: This year, disaster land tax for twenty-six prefectures, counties, and garrisons in Jiangnan, Fujian, Gansu, Huguang, and other provinces was remitted in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Tax relief was granted for twenty-six disaster districts in several provinces.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、琉球、安南入貢。

translations.literal: Korea, Ryukyu, and Annam sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea, Ryukyu, and Annam paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 五十八年己亥春正月甲戌朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Fifty-eighth year, spring, first month, day jiaxu, first day of the month: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-eighth year, on the first day of spring, a solar eclipse occurred.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「日食三始，垂象維昭。

translations.literal: An edict said: "A solar eclipse at the three beginnings is a sign clearly displayed on high.
translations.idiomatic: An edict on the eclipse urged moral self-correction.

sentences.zh: 宜修人事，以儆天戒。

translations.literal: Human affairs should be rectified to heed Heaven's warning.
translations.idiomatic: Officials were to reform conduct to heed Heaven's warning.

sentences.zh: 臣工其舉政事闕失以聞。

translations.literal: Ministers are to report administrative omissions and faults."
translations.idiomatic: Ministers were to report governmental faults."

sentences.zh: 」乙未，上幸湯泉。

translations.literal: " On day yiwei, the Emperor went to the hot springs.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, the Emperor went to the hot springs.

sentences.zh: 庚子，上還駐申昜春園。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, the Emperor returned and halted at Shenyang Spring Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, the Emperor returned to Shenyang Spring Garden.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，詔立功之臣退閒，世職准子弟承襲。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, an edict ordered that meritorious officials in retirement might have their hereditary offices inherited by sons and younger brothers.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, retired meritorious officials' hereditary posts could pass to sons or brothers.

sentences.zh: 若無應襲之人，給俸終其身。

translations.literal: If there was no heir to inherit, salary was to be paid for life.
translations.idiomatic: Without an heir, salary continued for life.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，命截漕米四十三萬石，留江蘇、安徽備荒。

translations.literal: On day renyin, an order was issued to divert four hundred thirty thousand shi of transport grain and retain it in Jiangsu and Anhui against famine.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, 430,000 shi of grain transport were held in Jiangsu and Anhui for famine relief.

sentences.zh: 二月己巳，上巡幸畿甸。

translations.literal: Second month, day jisi: the Emperor made an inspection tour of the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, the Emperor toured the capital region.

sentences.zh: 己卯，學士蔣廷錫表進皇輿全覽圖，頒賜廷臣。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Academician Jiang Tingxi presented the Imperial Carriage Complete Survey Map and it was bestowed on court ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, Jiang Tingxi presented the Imperial Carriage Complete Survey Map to the court.

sentences.zh: 庚申，上還駐申昜春園。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, the Emperor returned and halted at Shenyang Spring Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, the Emperor returned to Shenyang Spring Garden.

sentences.zh: 辛未，命都統法喇撫輯里塘、巴塘，護軍統領噶爾弼同理軍事。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, Commander-in-chief Fala was ordered to pacify Litang and Batang; guard commander Galib was likewise ordered to handle military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, Fala was sent to pacify Litang and Batang; Galib shared military command.

sentences.zh: 三月乙未，侍郎色爾圖以運饟遲延罷，命巡撫噶什圖接管。

translations.literal: Third month, day yiwei: Vice Minister Se'ertu was dismissed for delay in transport of provisions; Governor Gashitu was ordered to take over.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, Se'ertu was dismissed for supply delays; Gashitu took over transport.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙巳，命撫遠大將軍胤禵駐師西寧。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day yisi: Pacification-general-in-chief Yinti was ordered to station the army at Xining.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Yinti was ordered to camp at Xining.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，上巡幸熱河。

translations.literal: On day guichou, the Emperor toured to Rehe.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, the Emperor went to Rehe.

sentences.zh: 五月戊寅，以麥大熟，命民間及時收貯。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day wuyin: because wheat had ripened abundantly, the people were ordered to harvest and store in good time.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, the people were urged to harvest the abundant wheat promptly.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以揚都為蒙古都統。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, Yang Du was made Mongol commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, Yang Du became Mongol commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 浙江正考官索泰賄賣關節，在籍學士陳恂說合，陳鳳墀夤緣中式，均論死，並罪其保薦索泰為考官者。

translations.literal: Zhejiang chief examiner Suotai sold examination favors; retired academician Chen Xun acted as go-between; Chen Fengdi gained the degree by improper influence—all were sentenced to death, and those who had recommended Suotai as examiner were also punished.
translations.idiomatic: Examiner Suotai, Chen Xun, and Chen Fengdi were executed in the Zhejiang examination bribery case, with punishments for their patrons.

sentences.zh: 南陽標兵執辱知府沈淵，總兵高成革職，游擊王洪道論死，兵處斬。

translations.literal: Nanyang garrison soldiers seized and insulted prefect Shen Yuan; regional commander Gao Cheng was dismissed from office; guerrilla Wang Hongdao was sentenced to death; the soldiers were executed.
translations.idiomatic: Nanyang troops insulted Prefect Shen Yuan; Gao Cheng was dismissed, Wang Hongdao sentenced to death, and the soldiers executed.

sentences.zh: 六月甲辰，以貝勒滿篤祜為滿洲都統。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiachen: imperial clansman Beile Manduhu was made Manchu commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Beile Manduhu became Manchu commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 丁未，年羹堯、噶爾弼、法喇先後奏副將岳鍾琪招輯里塘、巴塘就撫。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, Nian Gengyao, Galib, and Fala in succession memorialized that Vice Commander Yue Zhongqi had won the submission of Litang and Batang.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, Nian Gengyao, Galib, and Fala reported Yue Zhongqi's pacification of Litang and Batang.

sentences.zh: 命法喇進駐巴塘，年羹堯撥兵接應。

translations.literal: Fala was ordered to advance and station at Batang; Nian Gengyao was to detach troops to support him.
translations.idiomatic: Fala advanced to Batang with troops detached by Nian Gengyao.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以馬見伯為固原提督。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, Ma Jianbo was made Gansu commander at Guyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, Ma Jianbo became Guyuan commander.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸未，以宗查木為西安將軍。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day guiwei: imperial clansman Zongchamu was made Xi'an general.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Zongchamu became Xi'an general.

sentences.zh: 八月庚戌，上行圍。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day gengxu: the Emperor went on the autumn hunt.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, the Emperor went hunting.

sentences.zh: 庚申，振威將軍傅爾丹奏鄂爾齋圖二處築城設站。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, Pacification-general Furdan memorialized that at two places in Erqitu cities and stations were to be built.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, Furdan reported building cities and stations at Erqitu.

sentences.zh: 命尚書范時崇往董其役。

translations.literal: Minister Fan Shichong was ordered to go and supervise the work.
translations.idiomatic: Minister Fan Shichong was sent to supervise construction.

sentences.zh: 九月乙未，諭西寧現有新胡畢勒罕，實系達賴後身，令大將軍遣官帶兵前往西藏安禪。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day yiwei: an instruction said that at Xining there was now a new Khutuktu who was in fact the reincarnation of the Dalai Lama; the great general was ordered to send an officer with troops to Tibet to install him on the throne.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, the court recognized a new Dalai reincarnation at Xining and ordered troops to install him in Tibet.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，安郡王華颺薨，諡曰節。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, Prince An Hua Yang died; posthumous title Jie.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Prince An Hua Yang died; posthumous name Jie.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁未，上還京。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day dingwei: the Emperor returned to Beijing.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 壬子，命蒙養齋舉人王蘭生修正音韻圖。

translations.literal: On day renzi, licentiate Wang Lansheng of the Hall of Cultivating Harmony was ordered to revise the Rhyme Chart.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, Wang Lansheng was ordered to revise the Rhyme Chart.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，固原提督潘育龍卒，贈太子少保，予祭葬，諡襄勇。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, Gansu commander at Guyuan Pan Yulong died; he was posthumously made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent; sacrificial rites and burial were granted; posthumous title Xiangyong.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, Pan Yulong died with posthumous honors and name Xiangyong.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙子，禮部尚書陳詵致仕。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day bingzi: Minister of Rites Chen Shen retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Minister of Rites Chen Shen retired.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，增江西解額。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, the quota for successful candidates at the provincial examinations in Jiangxi was increased.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, Jiangxi provincial examination quotas were raised.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬寅，以蔡升元為禮部尚書，田從典為左都御史。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day renyin: Cai Shengyuan was made Minister of Rites; Tian Congdian Censor-in-chief of the Left.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Cai Shengyuan became Minister of Rites and Tian Congdian Left Censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 戊申，西安將軍額倫特之喪至京，命皇五子恆親王胤祺、皇十二子貝子胤祹迎奠。

translations.literal: On day wushen, the coffin of Xi'an general Erlunte reached the capital; the fifth son Prince Heng Yinqi and twelfth son Beizi Yinti were ordered to meet it and offer libations.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, Erlunte's coffin reached Beijing; Yinqi and Yinti met it with libations.

sentences.zh: 庚申，命截湖廣漕糧十萬石留於本省備荒。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, an order was issued to divert one hundred thousand shi of Huguang transport grain and retain it in the province against famine.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, 100,000 shi of Huguang grain transport were held in the province for famine relief.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔曰：「比年興兵西討，遠歷邊陲，居送行賚，民力勞瘁。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, an edict said: "In recent years troops have been raised for the western campaign, ranging far along the frontier; transport and supplies have worn out the people's strength.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, an edict cited frontier war burdens along the campaign route.

sentences.zh: 所有沿邊六十六州縣衛所明年額徵銀米，俱行蠲免。

translations.literal: All scheduled silver and grain quotas for next year for the sixty-six prefectures, counties, and garrisons along the frontier are to be remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Next year's tax quotas for sixty-six frontier districts were remitted.

translations.literal: " (closing quotation mark in the source.)
translations.idiomatic: The edict continued.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免江蘇、安徽等省十三州縣災賦有差。

translations.literal: This year, disaster land tax for thirteen prefectures and counties in Jiangsu, Anhui, and other provinces was remitted in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Tax relief was granted for thirteen disaster districts in Jiangsu and Anhui.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、琉球入貢。

translations.literal: Korea and Ryukyu sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea and Ryukyu paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 五十九年庚子春正月丁酉，命撫遠大將軍胤禵移師穆魯斯烏蘇。

translations.literal: Fifty-ninth year, spring, first month, day dingyou: Pacification-general-in-chief Yinti was ordered to move the army to Merususu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-ninth year, Yinti was ordered to move his army to Merususu.

sentences.zh: 以宗室延信為平逆將軍，領兵進藏，以公策旺諾爾布參贊軍務。

translations.literal: Imperial clansman Yansin was made Pacification-general for the Rebellion and ordered to lead troops into Tibet; Duke Cewang Norbu was made military aide.
translations.idiomatic: Yansin became Pacification-general for the Rebellion for Tibet; Cewang Norbu was his aide.

sentences.zh: 命西安將軍宗查木駐西寧，平郡王訥爾素駐古木。

translations.literal: Xi'an general Zongchamu was ordered to station at Xining; Prince of the Commandery of Peace Nersu at Gumu.
translations.idiomatic: Zongchamu was posted at Xining; Prince Nersu at Gumu.

sentences.zh: 二月甲辰，上巡幸畿甸。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiachen: the Emperor made an inspection tour of the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, the Emperor toured the capital region.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，命噶爾弼為定西將軍，率四川、雲南兵進藏，冊封新胡畢勒罕為六世達賴喇嘛。

translations.literal: On day guichou, Galib was made Pacification-general of the West and ordered to lead Sichuan and Yunnan troops into Tibet and invest the new Khutuktu as the Sixth Dalai Lama.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, Galib became Pacification-general of the West to enter Tibet and install the Sixth Dalai Lama.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，上還駐申昜春園。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, the Emperor returned and halted at Shenyang Spring Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, the Emperor returned to Shenyang Spring Garden.

sentences.zh: 三月己丑，命雲南提督張谷貞駐防麗江、中甸。

translations.literal: Third month, day jichou: Yunnan commander Zhang Guzhen was ordered to garrison Lijiang and Zhongdian.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, Zhang Guzhen was posted at Lijiang and Zhongdian.

sentences.zh: 丙申，命靖逆將軍富寧安進師烏魯木齊，散秩大臣阿喇衲進師吐魯番，祁里德領七千兵從布婁爾，傅爾丹領八千兵從布拉罕，同時進擊準噶爾。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Pacification-general Funing'an was ordered to advance on Urumqi; Minister without Rank Arana to advance on Turfan; Qilide to lead seven thousand men from Buluer; Furdan eight thousand from Bulahan—all to strike Dzungar at the same time.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, Funing'an, Arana, Qilide, and Furdan were ordered on simultaneous advances against Dzungar.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊申，上巡幸熱河。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day wushen: the Emperor toured to Rehe.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, the Emperor went to Rehe.

sentences.zh: 五月辛巳，以旱求言。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day xinsi: because of drought, the court sought memorials and advice.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, drought led the court to invite memorials.

sentences.zh: 壬午，雨。

translations.literal: On day renwu, rain fell.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, it rained.

sentences.zh: 六月己亥，陝西飢，運河南積穀往賑。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jihai: Shaanxi suffered famine; stored grain from Henan was transported for relief.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Henan grain was sent to relieve famine in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，保安、懷來地震，遣官賑之。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Bao'an and Huailai suffered earthquake; officials were sent to relieve.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, earthquake relief was sent to Bao'an and Huailai.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙寅朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day bingyin, first day of the month: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first of the seventh month, a solar eclipse occurred.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，富寧安擊賊於阿克塔斯、伊爾布爾和韶，敗之，擒其台吉垂木拍爾。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, Funing'an attacked the enemy at Aktas and Yierbuheshao, defeated them, and captured their taiji Cuimupaier.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, Funing'an defeated the enemy at Aktas and captured taiji Cuimupaier.

sentences.zh: 阿喇衲師至齊克塔木，遇賊，擊破之，盡虜其眾。

translations.literal: Arana's army reached Qiketamu, met the enemy, routed them, and captured the entire force.
translations.idiomatic: Arana routed the enemy at Qiketamu and took all captive.

sentences.zh: 進擊皮禪城，降之。

translations.literal: Pressing the attack, he reduced Pichan City.
translations.idiomatic: He then took Pichan City.

sentences.zh: 師至吐魯番，番酋阿克蘇爾坦率眾迎降。

translations.literal: When the army reached Turfan, tribal chief Aksuer led the people in welcome and submission.
translations.idiomatic: At Turfan, chief Aksuer submitted with his followers.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，傅爾丹擊賊于格爾厄爾格，斬獲六百，陣擒寨桑貝肯，焚其積聚而還，貝肯送京。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Furdan attacked the enemy at Geererge, killed and captured six hundred, seized in battle the zaisang Saikan Beiken, burned their stores, and returned; Beiken was sent to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, Furdan defeated the enemy at Geererge, captured Beiken, and sent him to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 祁里德敗賊於鏗額爾河，降其寨桑色布騰等二千餘人。

translations.literal: Qilide defeated the enemy on the Kenggeer River and received the submission of zaisang Sebuteng and more than two thousand others.
translations.idiomatic: Qilide won on the Kenggeer River; over two thousand including Sebuteng submitted.

sentences.zh: 八月戊戌，上行圍。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day wuxu: the Emperor went on the autumn hunt.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, the Emperor went hunting.

sentences.zh: 庚子，琉球請令其陪臣子弟入國子監讀書，許之。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Ryukyu asked that sons of its attendant ministers be admitted to study in the Imperial Academy; this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Ryukyu's request to enroll ministerial sons at the Academy was granted.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，平逆將軍延信連敗賊眾於卜克河。

translations.literal: On day guichou, Pacification-general Yansin repeatedly defeated enemy forces on the Boke River.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, Yansin repeatedly defeated the enemy on the Boke River.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，又敗賊眾於綽馬喇，賊將策零敦多布遁。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, he again defeated enemy forces at Chuomala; the enemy general Tsering Donrub fled.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, Yansin won again at Chuomala; Tsering Donrub fled.

sentences.zh: 定西將軍噶爾弼率副將岳鍾琪自拉里進兵。

translations.literal: Pacification-general of the West Galib, with Vice Commander Yue Zhongqi, advanced troops from Lali.
translations.idiomatic: Galib and Yue Zhongqi advanced from Lali.

sentences.zh: 戊午，克西藏，執附賊喇嘛百餘，斬其渠五人，撫諭唐古特、土伯特，西藏平。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, Tibet was taken; over a hundred rebel lamas who had sided with the enemy were seized, five ringleaders were beheaded, the Tangut and Tubet peoples were reassured, and Tibet was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, Tibet was conquered; rebel lamas were captured and five leaders executed, local peoples were reassured, and the region was pacified.

sentences.zh: 以高其倬為廣西巡撫。

translations.literal: Gao Qizhuo was made governor of Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Qizhuo became Guangxi governor.

sentences.zh: 九月壬申，平逆將軍延信以兵送達賴喇嘛入西藏坐床。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day renshen: Pacification General Yensin escorted the Dalai Lama into Tibet for enthronement.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renshen day, Yensin escorted the Dalai Lama to Tibet for enthronement.

sentences.zh: 富寧安兵入烏魯木齊，哈西哈回人迎降，軍回至烏蘭烏蘇。

translations.literal: Fu Ning'an's army entered Urumchi; Khazakh Muslims came forward to submit; the army returned to Ulan Usu.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Ning'an entered Urumchi, the Khazakhs submitted, and the army withdrew to Ulan Usu.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，雲貴總督蔣陳錫、巡撫甘國璧以饋饟後期褫職，仍令運米入藏。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, Yunnan-Guizhou Governor-General Jiang Chenxi and Governor Gan Guobi were stripped of office for late grain transport, but were still ordered to convey grain into Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Chenxi and Gan Guobi were dismissed for late Tibet grain shipments but ordered to continue transport.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸卯，上還京。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day guimao: the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 詔再以河南積穀運往陝西放賑。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that Henan stored grain again be sent to Shaanxi for relief.
translations.idiomatic: The court again ordered Henan granary grain sent to relieve Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 明年，河南漕糧照數補還倉穀，其餘漕糧留貯河南。

translations.literal: Next year the Henan transport grain was to be fully replenished to the granaries; the remaining transport grain was to be kept in storage in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Henan was to restore its granaries the next year and keep surplus transport grain in the province.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，朝鮮國王李焞薨。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, the King of Korea, Li Hun, died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, Korean King Li Hun died.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「李焞襲封五十年，奉籓恭謹，撫民慈愛。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Li Hun held his enfeoffment for fifty years, served the court as tributary with respect, and governed his people with kindness.
translations.idiomatic: An edict praised Li Hun's fifty years as a dutiful, benevolent Korean king.

sentences.zh: 茲聞溘逝，惻悼實深，即令王子李昀襲封。

translations.literal: Now hearing of his sudden death, Our grief is deep; his son Li Yun is at once ordered to succeed to the title.
translations.idiomatic: Grieving his death, the Emperor ordered Prince Li Yun to succeed.

sentences.zh: 所進貢物悉數帶回，仍查恤典具奏。

translations.literal: The tribute goods presented are all to be taken back, and funeral honors are to be examined and memorialized in full."
translations.idiomatic: Tribute was returned and funeral honors were to be reported."

sentences.zh: 」詔陝西、甘肅兩省康熙六十年地丁銀一百八十八萬兩零，通行蠲免。

translations.literal: " An edict wholly remitted the Kangxi sixtieth-year land-poll tax silver of 1,880,000-odd taels for Shaanxi and Gansu provinces.
translations.idiomatic: Land-poll tax for Shaanxi and Gansu was wholly remitted for Kangxi year 60.

sentences.zh: 沿邊歉收，米價昂貴，兵力拮据，並豫發本年兵饟。

translations.literal: Along the frontier the harvest was poor, rice prices were high, and military funds were strained; this year's military pay was also issued in advance.
translations.idiomatic: Frontier poor harvests strained funds; military pay was advanced for the year.

sentences.zh: 賚進藏官兵。

translations.literal: Gifts were bestowed on the officers and soldiers who had entered Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: Troops who had entered Tibet received imperial gifts.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，戶部尚書趙申喬卒，予祭葬，諡恭毅。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, Minister of Revenue Zhao Shenqiao died; sacrificial rites and burial honors were granted, posthumous title Gongyi.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Revenue Zhao Shenqiao died and received posthumous name Gongyi.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，詔撫遠大將軍胤禵會議明年師期。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, an edict ordered Pacification General Yinti to confer on next year's campaign schedule.
translations.idiomatic: Yinti was ordered to plan the next year's campaign schedule.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以陝西、甘肅歉收，命銀糧兼賑，以麥收為止。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, because Shaanxi and Gansu had poor harvests, an order was issued for combined silver-and-grain relief until the wheat harvest.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi and Gansu received combined silver and grain relief until the wheat harvest.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛未，遣官致祭朝鮮國王李焞，特諡僖順，冊封世子李昀為朝鮮國王。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day xinwei: officials were sent to offer sacrifice for the late King of Korea Li Hun; the special posthumous title Xishun was granted, and the heir Li Yun was enfeoffed as King of Korea.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, envoys sacrificed for Li Hun, gave posthumous name Xishun, and enfeoffed Li Yun as king.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以田從典為戶部尚書，朱軾為左都御史，以楊名時為雲南巡撫。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, Tian Congdian was made Minister of Revenue, Zhu Shi Left Censor-in-chief, and Yang Mingshi governor of Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Congdian, Zhu Shi, and Yang Mingshi received new appointments.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，詔：「大兵入藏，其地俱入版圖，山川名號番、漢異同，應即考訂明覈，傳信後世。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, an edict said: "When the great army entered Tibet, all its lands entered the territory under Our rule; where Tibetan and Chinese place-names differ, they should at once be examined and fixed clearly to transmit certainty to later ages.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Tibetan and Chinese place-names in the new territories verified for posterity.

sentences.zh: 」上因與大學士講論河源、江源，及於禹貢三危。

translations.literal: " The Emperor then discussed with the Grand Secretaries the sources of the Yellow River and Yangtze, reaching also to Sanwei in the Yugong."
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor then discussed river sources and Sanwei in the Yugong with his Grand Secretaries.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以隆科多為理籓院尚書，仍兼步軍統領。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Longkodo was made Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs while continuing as commander of the Metropolitan Banners.
translations.idiomatic: Longkodo became Lifan Yuan minister and kept command of the Metropolitan Banners.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲辰，廷臣再請行六十年慶賀禮。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiachen: the court ministers again asked to perform the sixtieth-year celebration rites.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, ministers again sought sixtieth-year celebration rites.

sentences.zh: 不允。

translations.literal: This was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 壬子，授先賢子夏後裔五經博士。

translations.literal: On day renzi, the descendant of the ancient sage Zixia was granted the office of Five Classics Doctor.
translations.idiomatic: A descendant of Zixia received the Five Classics doctorate.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以誠親王胤祉子弘晟、恆親王胤祺子弘升為世子。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, Hongshi, son of Prince Cheng Yinqi, and Hongsheng, son of Prince Heng Yinqi, were made heir sons.
translations.idiomatic: Hongshi of Prince Cheng and Hongsheng of Prince Heng were named heir sons.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, the combined seasonal sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, the combined sacrifice was held at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸、江蘇、陝西、浙江、四川等省五十六州縣衛災賦有差。

translations.literal: This year, disaster land tax for fifty-six prefectures, districts, and garrisons in Zhili, Jiangsu, Shaanxi, Zhejiang, Sichuan, and other provinces was remitted in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Tax relief was granted for fifty-six disaster districts across several provinces.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、琉球入貢。

translations.literal: Korea and Ryukyu sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea and Ryukyu paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 六十年辛丑春正月乙亥，上以御極六十年，遣皇四子胤禛、皇十二子胤祹、世子弘晟告祭永陵、福陵、昭陵。

translations.literal: Sixtieth year, spring, first month, day yihai: because the Emperor had ruled for sixty years, the fourth imperial son Yinzhen, the twelfth imperial son Yinxiang, and the heir son Hongshi were sent to announce the occasion at the Yong, Fu, and Zhao tombs.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixtieth year, Yinzhen, Yinxiang, and heir Hongshi were sent to announce the reign milestone at the imperial tombs.

sentences.zh: 二月乙未，上謁孝庄山陵、孝陵、孝東陵，行告祭禮。

translations.literal: Second month, day yiwei: the Emperor visited the tombs of Empress Xiaozhuang, the Xiaoling, and the Xiaodong tombs and performed the announcement rites.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, the Emperor performed announcement rites at the Xiaozhuang and related tombs.

sentences.zh: 遣官告祭郊廟社稷。

translations.literal: Officials were sent to announce the occasion at the suburban altars and the altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys announced the occasion at suburban temples and altars.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，上還京。

translations.literal: On day yimao, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 山東鹽徒王美公等作亂，捕斬之。

translations.literal: Shandong salt laborers Wang Meigong and others rose in revolt; they were captured and executed.
translations.idiomatic: Shandong salt rebels led by Wang Meigong were captured and executed.

sentences.zh: 己未，命公策旺諾爾布駐防西藏。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Prince Gongsewang Norbu was ordered to garrison Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: Gongsewang Norbu was ordered to garrison Tibet.

sentences.zh: 論取藏功，封第巴阿爾布巴、康濟鼐為貝子，第巴隆布奈為輔國公。

translations.literal: Discussing merit in recovering Tibet, Depa Arabpa and Kangji Nai were enfeoffed as beile, and Depa Longbunai as Fuguo Duke.
translations.idiomatic: For the Tibet campaign, Arabpa and Kangji Nai became beile and Longbunai Fuguo Duke.

sentences.zh: 三月乙丑，群臣請上萬壽節尊號，上不許，曰：「加上尊號，乃相沿陋習，不過將字面上下轉換，以欺不學之君耳。

translations.literal: Third month, day yichou: the ministers asked that a honorific title be conferred for the Longevity Festival; the Emperor did not permit it, saying: "Adding a honorific title is a vulgar custom handed down from habit, nothing more than turning words about to deceive rulers who do not study.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, ministers sought a Longevity Festival honorific; the Emperor refused, calling it a deceitful custom.

sentences.zh: 本朝家法，惟以愛民為事，不以景星、慶雲、芝草、甘露為瑞，亦無封禪改元之舉。

translations.literal: Our dynasty's house law takes loving the people as its business and does not take propitious stars, auspicious clouds, sacred fungus, or sweet dew as omens; there is also no fengshan or change of reign title.
translations.idiomatic: He said the Qing cared for the people, not omens, and held no fengshan or era change.

sentences.zh: 現今西陲用兵，兵久暴露，民苦轉輸。

translations.literal: At present troops have long been exposed on campaign in the western marches, and the people suffer from transport.
translations.idiomatic: Western campaigns had long exposed troops and burdened transport.

sentences.zh: 朕方修省經營之不暇，何賀之有？

translations.literal: We are busy with self-examination and governance—what is there to celebrate?"
translations.idiomatic: He asked what there was to celebrate while war still burdened the realm."

sentences.zh: 」庚午，賜舉人王蘭生、留保進士，一體殿試。

translations.literal: " On day gengwu, the licentiates Wang Lansheng and Liubao were granted jinshi status and admitted to the palace examination on equal terms.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Lansheng and Liubao, compiler licentiates, were granted jinshi and palace examination status.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，先是，大學士王掞密疏復儲。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu: earlier, Grand Secretary Wang Yan had submitted a secret memorial to restore the heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, it was recalled that Wang Yan had secretly urged restoring the heir.

sentences.zh: 至是御史陶彝、任坪、范長發、鄒圖雲、陳嘉猷、王允晉、李允符、范允𨧨、高玢、高怡、趙成簁、孫紹曾疏請建儲，上不悅，並掞切責之，命其子詹事王奕清及陶彝等十二人為額外章京，軍前效力。

translations.literal: At this time the censors Tao Yi, Ren Ping, Fan Changfa, Zou Tuyun, Chen Jiayou, Wang Yunjin, Li Yunfu, Fan Yuntao, Gao Bin, Gao Yi, Zhao Chengsi, and Sun Shaozeng memorialized asking that an heir be established; the Emperor was displeased and sharply rebuked Wang Yan together with them, ordering his son, the Household Minister Wang Yiqing, and Tao Yi and the other twelve men to serve as extra Zhangjing on campaign at the front.
translations.idiomatic: Censors led by Tao Yi asked to establish an heir; the Emperor rebuked Wang Yan and sent him, his son, and twelve censors to serve at the front.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲午，以李麟為固原提督。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jiawu: Li Lin was made commander at Guyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Li Lin became Guyuan commander.

sentences.zh: 乙未，賜鄧鍾岳等一百六十三人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Deng Zhongyue and one hundred sixty-three others were granted jinshi and other ranks with distinctions.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, Deng Zhongyue and 163 others received jinshi degrees.

sentences.zh: 丙申，詔釐定歷代帝王廟崇祀祀典。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, an edict ordered the regulations for worship at the Temple of Former Kings to be fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, dynastic temple worship regulations were ordered revised.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，命張鵬翮、陳鵬年赴山東閱河。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Zhang Penghe and Chen Pengnian were ordered to go to Shandong to inspect the rivers.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Penghe and Chen Pengnian were sent to inspect Shandong rivers.

sentences.zh: 以賴都為禮部尚書，托賴為刑部尚書。

translations.literal: Lai Du was made Minister of Rites and Tolai Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: Lai Du became Minister of Rites and Tolai Minister of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 丙午，上幸熱河。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, the Emperor went to Rehe.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, the Emperor went to Rehe.

sentences.zh: 戊午，命定西將軍噶爾弼駐藏。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, General Garbi was ordered to garrison Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: Garbi was ordered to garrison Tibet.

sentences.zh: 五月壬戌，命撫遠大將軍胤禵移師甘州。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day renxu: Pacification General Yinti was ordered to move his army to Ganzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Yinti was ordered to move his army to Ganzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，台灣奸民朱一貴作亂，戕總兵官歐陽凱。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, the Taiwan ruffian Zhu Yigui rose in revolt and killed the regional commander Ouyang Kai.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Yigui rebelled in Taiwan and killed Commander Ouyang Kai.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以署參將管永寧協副將岳鍾琪為四川提督。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, Acting Deputy Commander Yue Zhongqi, commanding the Yongning Brigade, was made commander of Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Yue Zhongqi became Sichuan commander.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，改思明土州歸廣西太平府。

translations.literal: On day yihai, the native prefecture of Siming was transferred to Taiping prefecture in Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Siming native prefecture was placed under Guangxi's Taiping prefecture.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔停本年進兵。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, an edict halted this year's advance of troops.
translations.idiomatic: An edict halted campaigning for the year.

sentences.zh: 以常授為理籓院額外侍郎，辦事西寧。

translations.literal: Chang Shou was made an extra vice minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs to handle affairs at Xining.
translations.idiomatic: Chang Shou became extra Lifan Yuan vice minister at Xining.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以年羹堯為四川陝西總督，賜弓矢。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, Nian Gengyao was made governor-general of Sichuan and Shaanxi and was granted a bow and arrows.
translations.idiomatic: Nian Gengyao became Sichuan-Shaanxi governor-general and received bow and arrows.

sentences.zh: 發帑金五十萬賑山西、陝西，命朱軾、盧詢董其事。

translations.literal: Five hundred thousand taels from the treasury were issued to relieve Shanxi and Shaanxi; Zhu Shi and Lu Xun were ordered to supervise the matter.
translations.idiomatic: Five hundred thousand taels were issued for Shanxi-Shaanxi relief under Zhu Shi and Lu Xun.

sentences.zh: 六月壬辰，改高其位為江南提督，魏經國為湖廣提督。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day renchen: Gao Qiwei was made commander of Jiangnan, and Wei Jingguo commander of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Gao Qiwei became Jiangnan commander and Wei Jingguo Huguang commander.

sentences.zh: 丙申，詔曰：「平逆將軍延信，朕之侄也。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, an edict said: "Pacification General Yensin is Our nephew.
translations.idiomatic: An edict praised Yensin as the Emperor's nephew.

sentences.zh: 統兵歷從古未到之煙瘴絕域，殲滅巨虜，平定藏地，允稱不辱宗支，可封為輔國公。

translations.literal: Leading troops through miasma lands never reached by armies of old, he destroyed a great foe and pacified Tibet—truly he has not disgraced the imperial clan; he may be enfeoffed as Fuguo Duke."
translations.idiomatic: For pacifying Tibet through deadly frontier country, Yensin was enfeoffed Fuguo Duke."

sentences.zh: 」乙卯，吐魯番回人拖克拖麻穆克等來歸，命散秩大臣阿喇衲率兵護之。

translations.literal: " On day yimao, Turfan Muslims including Toktuomuk came to submit; an order was issued for the rank minister Arna to lead troops to escort them.
translations.idiomatic: Turfan Muslims submitted and Arna was sent with troops to escort them.

sentences.zh: 福建水師提督施世驃平台灣，擒朱一貴解京。

translations.literal: Fujian naval commander Shi Shilang pacified Taiwan, captured Zhu Yigui, and sent him to the capital under guard.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Shilang pacified Taiwan and sent Zhu Yigui to Beijing as a prisoner.

sentences.zh: 詔獎淡水營守備陳策固守功，超擢台灣總兵。

translations.literal: An edict praised Defender Chen Ce of the Freshwater garrison for holding firm and promoted him to Taiwan commander.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Ce was promoted to Taiwan commander for his defense of Freshwater.

sentences.zh: 閏六月庚申朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Intercalary sixth month, first day gengshen: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the intercalary sixth month, a solar eclipse occurred.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，令刑部弛輕系，戊辰，以噶爾弼為蒙古都統。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, the Ministry of Punishments was ordered to relax punishment for light offenses; on day wuchen, Garbi was made Mongol commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Light prisoners were released and Garbi became Mongol commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己酉，上行圍。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day jiyou: the Emperor went on the hunting encampment.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, the Emperor went on the autumn hunt.

sentences.zh: 八月甲戌，命副都統庄圖率兵二千進駐吐魯番，益阿喇衲軍。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiaxu: Vice Commander Zhuang Tu was ordered to lead two thousand troops to advance and garrison Turfan and reinforce Arna's army.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuang Tu was sent with two thousand men to Turfan to reinforce Arna.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，河決武陟入沁水。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, the Yellow River broke through at Wuyang and entered the Qin River.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, the Yellow River broke at Wuyang into the Qin River.

sentences.zh: 九月辛卯，命副都統穆克登將兵二千赴吐魯番。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day xinmao: Vice Commander Mukedeng was ordered to lead two thousand troops to Turfan.
translations.idiomatic: Mukedeng was sent with two thousand troops to Turfan.

sentences.zh: 甲午，噶爾弼以病罷，命公策旺諾爾布署定西將軍，駐藏，以阿寶、武格參軍事。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, Garbi was dismissed because of illness; Prince Gongsewang Norbu was ordered to act as Pacification General of the West and garrison Tibet, with Abao and Wuge to assist in military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Garbi retired ill; Gongsewang Norbu acted as western commander in Tibet with Abao and Wuge assisting.

sentences.zh: 丙申，策旺阿拉布坦犯吐魯番，阿喇衲擊走之。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Tsewang Arabtan attacked Turfan; Arna attacked and drove him off.
translations.idiomatic: Tsewang Arabtan raided Turfan and was repulsed by Arna.

sentences.zh: 丙午，賑河南、山東、直隸水災。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, flood disasters in Henan, Shandong, and Zhili were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Flood relief was granted in Henan, Shandong, and Zhili.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，上還京。

translations.literal: On day yimao, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，命副都御史牛鈕、侍講齊蘇勒、員外郎馬泰築黃河決口，引沁水入運河。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Vice Censor-in-chief Niu Niu, Lecturer Qi Sule, and Clerk Ma Tai were ordered to build the Yellow River breach and channel the Qin River into the Grand Canal.
translations.idiomatic: Niu Niu, Qi Sule, and Ma Tai were ordered to repair the breach and send the Qin into the Grand Canal.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以阿喇衲為協理將軍。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, Arna was made assistant general.
translations.idiomatic: Arna became assistant general.

sentences.zh: 上制平定西藏碑文。

translations.literal: The Emperor composed the stele inscription on the pacification of Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor wrote the Pacification of Tibet stele inscription.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬戌，置巡察台灣御史。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day renxu: an inspector censor for Taiwan was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, a Taiwan inspection censor was appointed.

sentences.zh: 詔：「本年秋審俱已詳覽，其直省具題緩決之案，九卿已加核定，朕不忍覆閱，恐審求之或致改重也。

translations.literal: An edict said: "This year's autumn review cases have all been examined in detail; as for the provincial cases submitted for delayed execution, the Nine Ministers have already added their approval—we cannot bear to review them again, lest careful re-examination lead to heavier sentences.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said autumn review cases were complete and the Emperor would not re-read delayed cases lest sentences grow harsher.

sentences.zh: 」丙寅，召撫遠大將軍胤禵來京。

translations.literal: " On day bingyin, Pacification General Yinti was summoned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Yinti was summoned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 辛未，詔：「大學士熊賜履服官清正，學問博通，朕久而弗忘，常令周恤其家。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, an edict said: "Grand Secretary Xiong Cilü served in office with upright conduct and broad learning; We have long not forgotten him and often ordered his household aided.
translations.idiomatic: An edict praised the late Xiong Cilü and ordered care for his family.

sentences.zh: 今其二子來京，觀其氣質，尚可讀書，宜加造就，可傳諭九卿知之。

translations.literal: Now his two sons have come to the capital; observing their temperament, they can still study and should be given further cultivation; this may be transmitted to the Nine Ministers."
translations.idiomatic: His two sons were to be educated, as the Nine Ministers were told."

sentences.zh: 」以鍾世臣為浙江提督，姚堂為福水師提督，馮毅署廣東提督。

translations.literal: " Zhong Shichen was made commander of Zhejiang, Yao Tang commander of the Fujian naval forces, and Feng Yi acting commander of Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: Zhong Shichen, Yao Tang, and Feng Yi received military appointments.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛卯，以陳鵬年署河道總督。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day xinmao: Chen Pengnian was made acting director-general of river conservancy.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Pengnian became acting river conservancy director-general.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以馬武、伊爾哈岱為蒙古都統。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, Ma Wu and Irkadai were made Mongol commanders-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Wu and Irkadai became Mongol commanders-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 己酉，上幸南苑。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, the Emperor visited the Southern Park.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, the Emperor visited the Southern Park.

sentences.zh: 詔將軍額倫特、侍衛色楞、副都統查禮渾、提督康泰等，殺敵殉國，俱賜恤。

translations.literal: An edict granted posthumous favors to General Erlunte, Guard Seleng, Vice Commander Cha Lihun, Commander Kang Tai, and others who died fighting the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: Officers who died in battle, including Erlunte and Kang Tai, received posthumous honors.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬申，四川提督岳鍾琪征郭羅克番人，平之。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day renshen: Sichuan Commander Yue Zhongqi campaigned against the Golok tribesmen and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: Yue Zhongqi campaigned against the Golok and pacified them.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，上還駐申昜春園。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, the Emperor returned and halted at Changchun Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, the Emperor returned to Changchun Garden.

sentences.zh: 遣鄂海、永泰往視吐魯番屯田。

translations.literal: E Hai and Yongtai were sent to inspect military colonies at Turfan.
translations.idiomatic: E Hai and Yongtai were sent to inspect Turfan garrison farms.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免江南、河南、陝西、甘肅、福建、浙江、湖廣等省一百二十三州縣災賦有差，朝鮮、琉球、安南入貢。

translations.literal: This year, disaster land tax for one hundred twenty-three prefectures and districts in Jiangnan, Henan, Shaanxi, Gansu, Fujian, Zhejiang, Huguang, and other provinces was remitted in varying degrees; Korea, Ryukyu, and Annam sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Tax relief was granted for 123 disaster districts; Korea, Ryukyu, and Annam paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 丁戶二千九百一十四萬八千三百五十九，又永不加賦後滋生人丁四十六萬七千八百五十，徵銀二千八百七十九萬零。

translations.literal: Registered households numbered 29,148,359; additional persons registered after the perpetual no-increase policy numbered 467,850; tax silver collected was 28,790,000-odd taels.
translations.idiomatic: Registered households stood at 29.1 million, with 467,850 additional persons and 28.79 million taels in tax silver.

sentences.zh: 鹽課銀三百七十七萬二千三百六十三兩零。

translations.literal: Salt tax silver was 3,772,363 taels and a fraction.
translations.idiomatic: Salt tax revenue was 3.77 million taels.

sentences.zh: 鑄錢四萬三千七百三十二萬五千八百有奇。

translations.literal: Coinage cast amounted to 437,327,580-odd strings.
translations.idiomatic: Coinage totaled over 437 million strings.

sentences.zh: 六十一年壬寅春正月戊子，召八旗文武大臣年六十五以上者六百八十人，已退者咸與賜宴，宗室授爵勸飲。

translations.literal: Sixty-first year, spring, first month, day wuzi: the Emperor summoned six hundred eighty civil and military officials of the Eight Banners aged sixty-five and above; those already retired were all included in the imperial feast, and ranks were granted to clansmen who urged drinking.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixty-first year, the Emperor feasted 680 Banner officials aged sixty-five and above, retired men included.

sentences.zh: 越三日，宴漢官年六十五以上三百四十人亦如之。

translations.literal: Three days later, three hundred forty Han officials aged sixty-five and above were feasted in the same way.
translations.idiomatic: Three days later, 340 Han officials of the same age were feasted likewise.

sentences.zh: 上賦詩，諸臣屬和，題曰千叟宴詩。

translations.literal: The Emperor composed a poem, and the ministers responded in rhyme; the title was "Poem of the Thousand Elder Banquet."
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor and ministers exchanged poems titled "Thousand Elder Banquet."

sentences.zh: 戊申，上巡幸畿甸。

translations.literal: On day wushen, the Emperor toured the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, the Emperor toured the capital region.

sentences.zh: 二月庚午，以高其倬署雲南貴州總督。

translations.literal: Second month, day gengwu: Gao Qizhuo was made acting governor-general of Yunnan and Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, Gao Qizhuo became acting Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general.

sentences.zh: 丙子，上還駐申昜春園。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, the Emperor returned and halted at Changchun Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, the Emperor returned to Changchun Garden.

sentences.zh: 三月丙戌，以阿魯為荊州將軍。

translations.literal: Third month, day bingxu: Alu was made general at Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on bingxu day, Alu became Jingzhou general.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲子，遣使封朝鮮國王李昀弟昑為世弟。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jiazi: envoys were sent to invest Bing, younger brother of the King of Korea Li Yun, as royal younger-brother heir.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, envoys invested Li Yun's brother Bing as Korean royal younger-brother heir.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，上巡幸熱河。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, the Emperor made an inspection tour to Rehe.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, the Emperor toured Rehe.

sentences.zh: 己巳，撫遠大將軍胤禵復蒞軍。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Pacification Commissioner-in-chief Yinti again took command of the army.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, Pacification Commissioner Yinti resumed army command.

sentences.zh: 癸未，福州駐防兵嘩，將軍黃秉鉞不能約束，褫職，斬為首者。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, the garrison troops at Fuzhou mutinied; General Huang Bingyue could not restrain them, was stripped of office, and the ringleaders were beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day, Fuzhou garrison troops mutinied; Huang Bingyue was dismissed and the leaders executed.

sentences.zh: 五月戊戌，施世綸卒，以張大有署漕運總督。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day wuxu: Shi Shilun died; Zhang Dayou was appointed acting director-general of grain transport.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Shi Shilun died and Zhang Dayou became acting grain transport director-general.

sentences.zh: 六月，以奉天連歲豐稔，弛海禁。

translations.literal: Sixth month: because Fengtian had had good harvests several years running, the maritime ban was relaxed.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Fengtian's successive harvests led to relaxation of the maritime ban.

sentences.zh: 暹羅米賤，聽入內地，免其稅。

translations.literal: Siamese rice was cheap; entry into the interior was permitted and its tax was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Cheap Siamese rice was allowed inland tax-free.

sentences.zh: 辛未，命直隸截漕二十萬石備賑。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, Zhili was ordered to divert two hundred thousand shi of tribute grain for relief reserves.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, Zhili was told to set aside two hundred thousand shi of tribute grain for relief.

sentences.zh: 丙子，趙弘燮卒，以其兄子郎中趙之垣加僉都御史銜，署直隸巡撫。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, Zhao Hongxie died; his elder brother's son, Director Zhao Zhiyuan, was given the additional rank of Vice Censor-in-chief and appointed acting Zhili governor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, Zhao Hongxie died; his nephew Zhao Zhiyuan became acting Zhili governor with vice censor rank.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁酉，征西將軍祁里德上言烏蘭古木屯田事宜。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day dingyou: Western Expedition general Qilide memorialized on garrison-farming matters at Ulan Gumu.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Qilide reported on farming garrisons at Ulan Gumu.

sentences.zh: 請益兵防守。

translations.literal: He asked for increased troops for defense.
translations.idiomatic: He requested more troops for defense.

sentences.zh: 命都統圖拉率兵赴之。

translations.literal: Commander-in-chief Tula was ordered to lead troops there.
translations.idiomatic: Commander-in-chief Tula was sent with troops.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，命色爾圖赴西藏統四川防兵。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Sertu was ordered to proceed to Tibet to take overall command of Sichuan frontier troops.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Sertu was ordered to Tibet to command Sichuan frontier forces.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以蔡珽為四川巡撫。

translations.literal: On day wushen, Cai Ting was made governor of Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, Cai Ting became Sichuan governor.

sentences.zh: 予故直隸總督趙弘燮祭葬，諡肅敏。

translations.literal: Sacrificial rites and burial honors were granted to the late Zhili governor Zhao Hongxie, posthumous title Su Min.
translations.idiomatic: The late Zhao Hongxie received sacrificial honors and posthumous name Su Min.

sentences.zh: 八月丙寅，停今年決囚。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day bingyin: judicial executions for this year were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, executions were halted for the year.

sentences.zh: 故提督藍理妻子先以有罪入旗，至是，上念平台灣功，貰還原籍，交★免追。

translations.literal: The wife and children of the late Commander Lan Li had earlier been enrolled in the banner for crimes; now, the Emperor, mindful of his merit at Taiwan, pardoned them to return to their native place and exempted further pursuit.
translations.idiomatic: Lan Li's family, once banished to the banners, were pardoned home for his Taiwan merit and freed from further recovery.

sentences.zh: 己卯，上駐蹕汗特木爾達巴漢昂阿。

translations.literal: On day jimao, the Emperor halted at Khantemur Dabahan Ang'a.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, the Emperor camped at Khantemur Dabahan Ang'a.

sentences.zh: 賜來朝外籓銀幣鞍馬，隨圍軍士銀幣。

translations.literal: Coming foreign vassals were granted silver, coins, saddles, and horses; accompanying hunt troops received silver and coins.
translations.idiomatic: Visiting vassals and hunt troops received silver, coins, saddles, and horses.

sentences.zh: 九月甲申，上駐熱河。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiashen: the Emperor halted at Rehe.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiashen day, the Emperor was at Rehe.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，諭大學士曰：「有人謂朕塞外行圍，勞苦軍士。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, the Emperor instructed the Grand Secretaries, saying: "Some say that Our hunting beyond the passes in the north wears out the troops.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, the Emperor told the Grand Secretaries some claimed his northern hunts exhausted the army.

sentences.zh: 不知承平日久，豈可遂忘武備？

translations.literal: They do not know that in long peace one must not forget military preparedness.
translations.idiomatic: He said long peace must not erase readiness for war.

sentences.zh: 軍旅數興，師武臣力，克底有功，此皆勤於訓練之所致也。

translations.literal: When campaigns arise repeatedly, through martial discipline and ministers' strength success is achieved—all this comes from diligent training."
translations.idiomatic: Repeated campaigns succeeded through discipline and training, he said.

sentences.zh: 」甲午，年羹堯、噶什圖請量加火耗，以補有司虧帑。

translations.literal: " On day jiawu, Nian Gengyao and Gasitu asked to increase the surcharge proportionally to make up deficits in official treasuries.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, Nian Gengyao and Gasitu sought a higher surcharge to cover official deficits.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「火耗只可議減，豈可加增？

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "The surcharge should only be discussed for reduction—how can it be increased?
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said surcharges should be reduced, not raised.

sentences.zh: 此次虧空，多由用兵。

translations.literal: Most of this deficit arose from military use.
translations.idiomatic: Most deficits came from military needs.

sentences.zh: 官兵過境，或有餽助。

translations.literal: When officers and soldiers passed through, there were sometimes gifts of support.
translations.idiomatic: Troops passing through sometimes received local gifts.

sentences.zh: 其始挪用公款，久之遂成虧空，昔年曾有寬免之旨。

translations.literal: At first public funds were diverted; over time this became deficit; in former years there was already an edict for remission.
translations.idiomatic: Diverted public funds had become chronic deficits; earlier edicts had already granted relief.

sentences.zh: 現在軍需正急，即將戶部庫帑撥送西安備用。

translations.literal: Now military needs are urgent; the Ministry treasury will at once be allocated and sent to Xi'an for ready use.
translations.idiomatic: With military needs urgent, treasury funds would be sent to Xi'an at once.

sentences.zh: 」戊戌，上迴鑾。

translations.literal: " On day wuxu, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, the Emperor returned to the capital."

sentences.zh: 丁未，次密雲，閱河堤。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, the court halted at Miyun and inspected the river dikes.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, the entourage stopped at Miyun to inspect dikes.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，上還京。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, the Emperor returned to Beijing.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛酉，命雍親王胤禛、弘升、延信、孫渣齊、隆科多、查弼納、吳爾占察視倉廒。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day xinyou: Prince Yong Yinzhen, Hongsheng, Yanxin, Sun Zhaji, Longkodo, Zhabina, and Wu'erzhan were ordered to inspect the granaries.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Yinzhen, Hongsheng, Yanxin, Sun Zhaji, Longkodo, Zhabina, and Wu'erzhan inspected granaries.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以覺羅德爾金為蒙古都統，安鮐為杭州將軍。

translations.literal: On day renxu, Aisin Gioro De'erjin was made Mongol commander-in-chief, and An Yu general at Hangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, De'erjin became Mongol commander-in-chief and An Yu Hangzhou general.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以查弼納為江南江西總督。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, Zhabina was made governor-general of Jiangnan and Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, Zhabina became governor-general of Jiangnan and Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，上幸南苑行圍。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, the Emperor visited the Southern Park for the hunt.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, the Emperor hunted at the Southern Park.

sentences.zh: 以李樹德為福州將軍，黃國材為福建巡撫。

translations.literal: Li Shude was made general at Fuzhou, and Huang Guocai governor of Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shude became Fuzhou general and Huang Guocai Fujian governor.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊子，上不豫，還駐暢春園。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day wuzi: the Emperor fell ill and returned to halt at Changchun Garden.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, the Emperor fell ill and withdrew to Changchun Garden.

sentences.zh: 以貝子胤祹、輔國公吳爾佔為滿洲都統。

translations.literal: Imperial Prince Yinyin and State-Founding Duke Wu'erzhan were made Manchu commanders-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Yinyin and Duke Wu'erzhan became Manchu commanders-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，命皇四子胤禛恭代祀天。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, the fourth imperial son Yinzhen was ordered to perform the Heaven sacrifice in the Emperor's stead.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, the fourth son Yinzhen was ordered to sacrifice to Heaven for the Emperor.

sentences.zh: 甲午，上大漸，日加戌，上崩，年六十九。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, the Emperor grew critically ill; at the hour jiaxu of that day, the Emperor died, aged sixty-nine.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day the Emperor fell gravely ill; at the jiaxu hour he died, aged sixty-nine.

sentences.zh: 即夕移入大內發喪。

translations.literal: That same evening he was moved into the inner palace and mourning was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: That night his body was moved to the inner palace and mourning began.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年二月，恭上尊諡。

translations.literal: Second month of the first year of Yongzheng, the posthumous honorific title was respectfully submitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Yongzheng 1, the posthumous title was conferred.

sentences.zh: 九月丁丑，葬景陵。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day dingchou: interment at Jing Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on dingchou day, he was buried at Jing Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 論曰：聖祖仁孝性成，智勇天錫。

translations.literal: The commentators say: The Sagely Ancestor was benevolent and filial by nature, with wisdom and courage heaven-bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: The annalists say Kangxi was naturally benevolent, filial, wise, and brave.

sentences.zh: 早承大業，勤政愛民。

translations.literal: He early received the great enterprise and was diligent in government and loving toward the people.
translations.idiomatic: He took the throne young, ruled diligently, and loved the people.

sentences.zh: 經文緯武，寰宇一統，雖曰守成，實同開創焉。

translations.literal: He ordered the classics and marshaled military affairs; the realm was unified—though called a reign of consolidation, it was in truth like a founding.
translations.idiomatic: He unified the realm through culture and arms—a consolidation reign that was almost a founding.

sentences.zh: 聖學高深，崇儒重道。

translations.literal: His sagely learning was profound and he honored Confucianism and valued the Way.
translations.idiomatic: His learning was deep; he honored Confucianism and the Way.

sentences.zh: 幾暇格物，豁貫天人，尤為古今所未覯。

translations.literal: In spare moments he investigated things and penetrated Heaven and man—a thing unseen in any age before or since.
translations.idiomatic: In leisure he studied nature and united Heaven and humanity as none had before.

sentences.zh: 而久道化成，風移俗易，天下和樂，克致太平。

translations.literal: Over time the Way transformed customs; wind shifted and habits changed; all under Heaven were harmonious and great peace was attained.
translations.idiomatic: Long rule reformed customs until the empire was harmonious and at peace.

sentences.zh: 其雍熙景象，使後世想望流連，至於今不能已。

translations.literal: That prosperous and serene scene makes later ages gaze back with longing even to this day without ceasing.
translations.idiomatic: Later ages still long for that prosperous, peaceful age.

sentences.zh: 傳曰：「為人君，止於仁。

translations.literal: The Classic says: "As a ruler, one stops at benevolence.
translations.idiomatic: The Classic says a ruler rests in benevolence.

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「道盛德至善，民之不能忘。

translations.literal: " It also says: "When the Way flourishes and virtue reaches utmost goodness, the people cannot forget."
translations.idiomatic: It also says flourishing virtue makes the people never forget."

sentences.zh: 」於戲，何其盛歟！

translations.literal: " Alas, how grand!
translations.idiomatic: Alas, how magnificent!"
